patutlah 表示恍然大悟，相当于“难怪”。
口语省略 berada 等可由语境补足的成分。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah nampak panggilan kau. Telefon aku dalam mod bisu tadi, patutlah tak dengar.
messages.ms_standard: Aku sudah melihat panggilan kamu. Telefon aku berada dalam mod bisu tadi. Itulah sebabnya aku tidak mendengarnya.
messages.zh: 我看到你的来电了。刚才手机静音，难怪没听到。
messages.en: I’ve seen your missed call. My phone was on silent earlier, so I didn’t hear it.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Oh, tak apa. Aku nak tanya pukul berapa kita jumpa je.
messages.ms_standard: Oh, tidak mengapa. Aku hanya mahu bertanya pada pukul berapa kita akan berjumpa.
messages.zh: 哦，没事。我就想问问咱们几点见。
messages.en: Oh, no worries. I just wanted to ask what time we’re meeting.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于人的时候须特别注意尊重，避免拿说话障碍开玩笑。不能用 bisu 表达“愚蠢”；英文释义也宜用 unable to speak，避免有贬义歧义的 dumb。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: filem bisu、mod bisu 属于中性用语。质问别人“你哑了吗”式的 Bisu ke? 容易构成侮辱；想请对方回应，可说 Boleh beri respons?

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 用于人的时候须特别注意尊重，避免拿说话障碍开玩笑。不能用 bisu 表达“愚蠢”；英文释义也宜用 unable to speak，避免有贬义歧义的 dumb。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: filem bisu、mod bisu 属于中性用语。质问别人“你哑了吗”式的 Bisu ke? 容易构成侮辱；想请对方回应，可说 Boleh beri respons?

etymology.historical_story: The Austronesian Comparative Dictionary records bisu and similar forms in Malay, Javanese, Sundanese, and several Bornean languages, grouping them in a loan set. This distribution does not establish a single borrowing route into Malay. Within Malay, the word also appears in filem bisu, linking descriptions of speech with the cultural history of cinema before recorded dialogue. [Comparative dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/valuesets/325-99e1e85bae70b99ffc8a1e94e6ae80eb), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=bisu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bi-su 可借音联想“闭住声音”：人无法说话、人物沉默、手机静音，分别看语境判断。

morphology.pattern_note: 以输入包的直接词基 anggapan 分析，ber- 表示具有某种看法；anggapan 本身可进一步拆为 anggap + -an。元音前 r 可在音节划分中归入后一音节，词基不发生辅音脱落。此分析针对现代常用义。

senses.zh_definition: 对某事持有某种看法或判断；认为，心想，推想。
senses.en_definition: To hold an opinion or belief; to think or suppose that something is the case.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai anggapan bahawa sesuatu demikian; menyangka atau berpendapat.
senses.nuances: 常用 beranggapan bahawa 引出完整命题。既可表达一般意见，也可表达尚未证实的推想，不必然表示判断错误。与 menganggap seseorang sebagai...（把某人视为……）的及物结构区分。[DBP：beranggapan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=beranggapan)。

senses.zh_definition: 轮流跳舞等；属于古典语境中与邀请、轮替有关的另一个词义。
senses.en_definition: In classical usage, to take turns dancing or participating in similar activities.
senses.ms_definition: Berganti-ganti menari dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Pelajar》另收此义，属于 anggap 的邀请、轮替义系，与现代“认为”义分开理解。现代高频搭配不适用；以下搭配仅展示古典语境，不能当作当代常用表达。[DBP：beranggapan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=beranggapan)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak pengurusan beranggapan bahawa tempoh pelaksanaan yang dicadangkan masih memerlukan penelitian lanjut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 管理层认为，拟议的实施期限仍需进一步研究。
dual_scenarios.en: Management considers that the proposed implementation timeline requires further examination.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku beranggapan mesyuarat tu dah batal, sebab tak ada orang balas kat grup.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya beranggapan bahawa mesyuarat itu sudah dibatalkan kerana tiada sesiapa memberikan maklum balas dalam kumpulan sembang.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我以为会议已经取消了，因为群里都没人回复。
dual_scenarios.en: I thought the meeting had been cancelled because nobody replied in the group chat.
spoken_features: 口语可省略引出命题的 bahawa。
tu、dah、tak 分别对应 itu、sudah、tidak。
beranggapan 在聊天中略显郑重；同一情境也常说 ingat 或 rasa。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku beranggapan mesyuarat tu dah batal. Betul ke?
messages.ms_standard: Saya beranggapan bahawa mesyuarat itu sudah dibatalkan. Adakah anggapan itu betul?
messages.zh: 我以为会议已经取消了，是吗？
messages.en: I thought the meeting had been cancelled. Has it?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum, kita nak mula pukul tiga kat bilik biasa je.
messages.ms_standard: Belum dibatalkan. Kita akan bermula pada pukul tiga di bilik mesyuarat yang biasa digunakan.
messages.zh: 没取消，三点开始，还是在平常那间会议室。
messages.en: No, it's still on. We're starting at three in the usual meeting room.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Saya beranggapan bahawa... 可将判断表述为个人看法，适合会议讨论；但语气不自动变委婉，仍需避免武断评价他人。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合分析、评论和澄清误会。Jangan beranggapan buruk（别往坏处想）可能带有责备感，对长辈或客户可改用 Mungkin terdapat salah faham（可能存在误会）。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Saya beranggapan bahawa... 可将判断表述为个人看法，适合会议讨论；但语气不自动变委婉，仍需避免武断评价他人。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合分析、评论和澄清误会。Jangan beranggapan buruk（别往坏处想）可能带有责备感，对长辈或客户可改用 Mungkin terdapat salah faham（可能存在误会）。

etymology.historical_story: Beranggapan makes an abstract opinion into something a person possesses: ber- combines with anggapan, itself formed from anggap and -an. This structure helps explain its place in reflective prose and formal argument. DBP also records a separate older dancing sense under the same spelling; that homograph should not be used to explain the modern meaning.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: anggapan 是“看法”，ber- 是“具有”：心里有一个看法，就是 beranggapan。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 加于 teman，表示交友或处于有人陪伴的状态；词根首辅音 t 保留，不发生 meN-、peN- 式的鼻音替换。

senses.zh_definition: 与人交朋友、结交或保持朋友关系。
senses.en_definition: To be friends or associate as friends.
senses.ms_definition: Berkawan atau bersahabat.
senses.nuances: 强调人与人的友谊或交往关系，常用 berteman dengan seseorang。不能仅凭此词推断为恋爱关系；在马来西亚日常聊天中，berkawan 也很常见。[DBP：berteman](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=berteman)。

senses.zh_definition: 有人作伴、陪同，不是独自一人。
senses.en_definition: To have company or be accompanied rather than alone.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak seorang diri; ada kawannya.
senses.nuances: 强调当时有伴的状态，不必表示双方长期是朋友。若要表达主动陪伴某人，使用及物动词 menemani，如 menemani ibu。[DBP：berteman](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=berteman)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Para peserta dinasihatkan supaya berteman ketika melalui kawasan yang sunyi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 主办方建议参与者经过偏僻地区时结伴同行。
dual_scenarios.en: Participants are advised to have someone with them when passing through isolated areas.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak pergi berteman je, tak nak jalan sorang malam-malam.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya hanya mahu pergi jika ada teman kerana saya tidak mahu berjalan seorang diri pada waktu malam.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我想找个人一起去，不想晚上一个人走。
dual_scenarios.en: I only want to go if someone's coming with me. I don't want to walk alone at night.
spoken_features: nak、je、tak 分别对应 hendak或mahu、sahaja、tidak。
sorang 是 seorang 的口语缩略形式。
malam-malam 在此指夜间这一情境，不必理解为每个晚上。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak pergi berteman je. Kau boleh ikut tak?
messages.ms_standard: Saya hanya mahu pergi jika ada teman. Bolehkah kamu ikut bersama?
messages.zh: 我想找个人一起去，你能陪我吗？
messages.en: I'd rather go with someone. Can you come with me?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Boleh, tunggu kat lobi je. Aku dah nak sampai.
messages.ms_standard: Boleh. Tunggu sahaja di lobi. Saya hampir sampai.
messages.zh: 可以，你就在大厅等吧，我快到了。
messages.en: Sure. Just wait in the lobby. I'm almost there.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 邀请别人陪同时，可说 Boleh teman saya?；更完整、较正式的表达是 Bolehkah anda menemani saya?。是否使用 aku、kau，应依双方熟悉程度决定。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合谈友谊、出行和陪伴。不要把普通的 berteman 自动解读为恋爱；涉及感情关系时，应根据上下文或明确的 pasangan、teman lelaki、teman wanita 等表达判断。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 邀请别人陪同时，可说 Boleh teman saya?；更完整、较正式的表达是 Bolehkah anda menemani saya?。是否使用 aku、kau，应依双方熟悉程度决定。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合谈友谊、出行和陪伴。不要把普通的 berteman 自动解读为恋爱；涉及感情关系时，应根据上下文或明确的 pasangan、teman lelaki、teman wanita 等表达判断。

etymology.historical_story: Berteman grows from teman, a word covering friends, companions, and those who share an activity. Adding ber- expresses either friendship or the state of having company. Malay pantun also uses berteman in lines about companionship and parting, illustrating how an ordinary social word can carry emotional weight without necessarily referring to romance.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: teman 是“同伴”，berteman 就是“有伴”；menemani 则把镜头转向“去陪某个人”。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接 empat，词根首元音为央元音 /ə/；连贯语音可按 be.rem.pat 分节，词素边界则为 ber.emp at 所对应的 ber- + empat。此处 ber- 表示合计四个或四人结伴，不表示第四或四分之一。

senses.zh_definition: 共四个；通常指四个人一起或一行四人。
senses.en_definition: Four in number, especially together as a group of four people.
senses.ms_definition: Yang empat jumlahnya; berjumlah empat.
senses.nuances: 马来语语法上属集合数词 kata bilangan himpunan；本架构未提供 numeral，故按“一起行动”的常见功能映射为 adverb。kami berempat 是“我们四人”，不含听话人；kita berempat 则包含听话人。参见 [PRPM：berempat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=berempat)。

collocations.zh: 我们四个人（不包括听话人）
collocations.en: the four of us, excluding the listener
go as a group of four

collocations.zh: 我们四个人（包括听话人）
collocations.en: the four of us, including the listener

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Kami berempat telah menjalankan pemeriksaan tapak dan menyediakan laporan untuk pihak pengurusan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我们四人已完成现场检查，并为管理层准备了报告。
dual_scenarios.en: The four of us have conducted the site inspection and prepared a report for management.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kita pergi berempat je, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kita pergi berempat sahaja, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 就我们四个一起去，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: It's just the four of us going, right?
spoken_features: je 是 sahaja 的口语形式，表示人数仅为四人。
句末 kan 用于寻求确认。
kita 包括听话人，kami 不包括听话人。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kita pergi berempat je, kan?
messages.ms_standard: Kita pergi berempat sahaja, bukan?
messages.zh: 就我们四个一起去，对吧？
messages.en: It's just the four of us going, right?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, aku, kau, Siti dengan Hakim. Kita jumpa kat stesen pukul lapan.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya, kamu, Siti dan Hakim. Kita berjumpa di stesen pada pukul lapan.
messages.zh: 对，我、你、Siti 和 Hakim。我们八点在车站见。
messages.en: Yes, you, me, Siti and Hakim. Let's meet at the station at eight.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 该词语气中性，可用于朋友聊天和正式汇报。安排活动时应正确选择 kita 或 kami，避免让对方误以为自己被邀请或被排除。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合说明同行人数、用餐人数和团队规模。订位时说明 Untuk empat orang 通常更直接；berempat-empat 表示每组四人，与总共只有四人不同。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 该词语气中性，可用于朋友聊天和正式汇报。安排活动时应正确选择 kita 或 kami，避免让对方误以为自己被邀请或被排除。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合说明同行人数、用餐人数和团队规模。订位时说明 Untuk empat orang 通常更直接；berempat-empat 表示每组四人，与总共只有四人不同。

etymology.historical_story: Berempat shows how Malay builds a social grouping from a number. Empat supplies four, while ber- presents people as a group of that size, following the familiar pattern of berdua and bertiga. The word is useful when arranging transport, meals or visits because it communicates the group's total without listing everyone's name.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: empat 是“四”，ber- 把四个人组成一队：berempat＝四人同行。keempat 才是“第四”。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接在 debat 前，词根首辅音 d 保留，不发生鼻音同化；ber 读 /bər/，debat 的 e 为 /e/。

senses.zh_definition: 就某个问题交换通常相互对立的意见，并以理由或论据维护各自立场；辩论，争辩。
senses.en_definition: To exchange opposing views on an issue, presenting reasons to defend a position.
senses.ms_definition: Bertukar pandangan yang berbeza tentang sesuatu perkara dengan mengemukakan alasan atau hujah bagi mempertahankan pendirian masing-masing.
senses.nuances: 可用于正式辩论，也可指日常争论；本身不必然表示吵架。通常用 berdebat tentang/mengenai 某议题、berdebat dengan 某人；直接带议题宾语时可用 mendebatkan 或 memperdebatkan。[DBP：debat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=debat)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Wakil kedua-dua pihak akan berdebat tentang cadangan dasar itu dalam forum awam pada minggu hadapan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 双方代表将于下周在公共论坛上就该政策建议展开辩论。
dual_scenarios.en: Representatives of both sides will debate the policy proposal at a public forum next week.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Korang dah berdebat pasal benda ni dari tadi, rehat kejap lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kamu semua sudah berdebat tentang perkara ini sejak tadi. Berehatlah sebentar.
dual_scenarios.zh: 你们这事都争论好一会儿了，先歇一下吧。
dual_scenarios.en: You've been debating this for a while now. Take a quick break.
spoken_features: korang 是 kamu semua 的非正式口语形式。
dah 对应 sudah；pasal 在这里对应 tentang。
kejap 对应 sebentar；lah 使劝说语气更自然。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Korang dah berdebat pasal benda ni dari tadi, rehat kejap lah.
messages.ms_standard: Kamu semua sudah berdebat tentang perkara ini sejak tadi. Berehatlah sebentar.
messages.zh: 你们这事都争论好一会儿了，先歇一下吧。
messages.en: You've been debating this for a while now. Take a quick break.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Betul juga. Kita minum dulu je, nanti sambung.
messages.ms_standard: Betul juga. Kita minum dahulu, kemudian kita sambung perbincangan ini.
messages.zh: 也是。先喝点东西，等下再接着聊。
messages.en: Fair point. Let's get a drink first and carry on later.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 与长辈、上司或初识者表达异议时，可先说 Dengan izin, saya ingin mengemukakan pandangan yang berbeza，给对方保留表达和回应的空间。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于课堂、论坛、会议和朋友间的观点交锋。评价他人 suka berdebat 可能暗示对方爱争辩；邀请合作讨论时，berbincang 通常更温和。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 与长辈、上司或初识者表达异议时，可先说 Dengan izin, saya ingin mengemukakan pandangan yang berbeza，给对方保留表达和回应的空间。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于课堂、论坛、会议和朋友间的观点交锋。评价他人 suka berdebat 可能暗示对方爱争辩；邀请合作讨论时，berbincang 通常更温和。

etymology.historical_story: The root debat is recorded as a borrowing from Dutch debat, whose earlier European history connects argument with contention. Malay adds its productive prefix ber- to express participation in the activity. The resulting verb covers both organized exchanges of arguments and everyday disagreements, bringing an international debate term into an ordinary Malay grammatical pattern. [Etymological reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/debat#Malay)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ber- 就想到参与活动，看到 debat 就联想到 debate：berdebat＝参与辩论。

morphology.pattern_note: berus 是完整词根，开头 ber- 不是此词的前缀；memberus 中 meN- 遇 b 取 mem-，保留 b。音标沿用输入所列读音。

senses.zh_definition: 刷子；将毛、纤维、塑料丝或金属丝固定于柄或底座上，用于清洁、梳理、涂漆或作画的工具。
senses.en_definition: A tool with bristles, fibres, or wire fixed to a handle or base, used for cleaning, grooming, or applying paint.
senses.ms_definition: Alat berbulu, berserabut atau berdawai yang digunakan untuk membersihkan, merapikan atau menyapukan cat dan warna.
senses.nuances: 具体用途通常由后面的名词限定，如 berus gigi、berus rambut、berus cat。梳子通常称 sikat。释义据 [PRPM：berus](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=berus) 改写。

senses.zh_definition: 刷；用刷子清洁或梳理，常见于祈使句及口语省略前缀的表达。
senses.en_definition: To brush or scrub, especially as an imperative or an informal form of memberus.
senses.ms_definition: Membersihkan atau merapikan sesuatu dengan berus, khususnya dalam bentuk perintah atau pertuturan tidak formal.
senses.nuances: 这是工具义对应的动作用法；正式主动陈述通常使用 memberus，如 Dia memberus kasut。祈使句可说 Berus kasut itu。标准动作义参见 [PRPM：memberus](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=berus)。

senses.zh_definition: 柱果木榄；一种红树林乔木，学名 Bruguiera cylindrica。
senses.en_definition: Bruguiera cylindrica, a mangrove tree also called bakau belukap.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis pokok bakau yang dikenali juga sebagai bakau belukap atau bosang, dengan nama saintifik Bruguiera cylindrica.

etymology.historical_story: The tool name berus is an adaptation of English brush. Swettenham's historical vocabulary already records brus and labels it English, providing evidence of the borrowing. Modern Malay also builds memberus from the noun. A separate botanical homonym names a mangrove tree; the tool's English origin should not automatically be assigned to that plant name. [Historical vocabulary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/b2/Vocabulary_of_the_English_and_Malay_languages_with_notes_%28IA_vocabularyofengl01swet%29.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 English brush 放慢，联想成两拍 be-rus，再想象刷毛来回刷；这是记音提示，不是精确音变公式。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，作为独立词素记忆；无马来语词缀。下列词族成员为复合术语。

senses.zh_definition: 债券：政府或公司为筹借资金而发行、载明本金偿还及利息支付义务的债务凭证。
senses.en_definition: A debt security issued by a government or corporation, acknowledging borrowed money and specifying repayment and interest obligations.
senses.ms_definition: Sijil pelaburan yang dikeluarkan oleh kerajaan atau perbadanan sebagai pengakuan bahawa sejumlah wang telah dipinjam dan akan dibayar balik berserta faedah.
senses.nuances: 属于金融用语，持有人是债权人，区别于代表股权的 saham。bon kerajaan 指政府债券，bon syarikat 指公司债券。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bon)

senses.zh_definition: 保证履行付款、合同或其他约定义务的书面担保；常见于履约保证等专业术语。
senses.en_definition: A written guarantee securing payment or the performance of a contractual obligation.
senses.ms_definition: Dokumen jaminan bagi memastikan sesuatu kewajipan atau syarat kontrak dipenuhi, seperti bon pelaksanaan.
senses.nuances: 此义常见于合同和工程采购，尤其是 bon pelaksanaan；不能一律译为可投资买卖的“债券”。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bon)

senses.zh_definition: 赊购单；确认已领取货物、约定日后付款的小单据。
senses.en_definition: A slip acknowledging receipt of goods to be paid for later.
senses.ms_definition: Surat kecil yang mengakui pengambilan barang yang akan dibayar kemudian.
senses.nuances: DBP 标注为印度尼西亚用法；在马来西亚日常购物中，收据通常称 resit，不能把此义当作通用的“收据”。以下搭配限于赊购单语境。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bon)

etymology.historical_story: Malay financial bon is borrowed from English bond. Its documentary character links two familiar uses: a security records a borrowing obligation, while a performance bond guarantees contractual performance. DBP also records an Indonesian credit-slip sense, preserving another setting in which a small written document represents an obligation to pay. [Etymology](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/bon); [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bon).

senses.zh_definition: 争执或失和后重新和好；恢复友好关系。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 劝人和好可说 Kalau awak sudi, mungkin boleh cuba berbaik semula，给对方保留选择空间。直接命令 Berbaiklah! 可能显得居高临下。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于朋友、亲属、邻里或团体之间的友好关系与和解。谈私人矛盾时宜避免当众追问，也应尊重当事人是否愿意恢复来往。

etymology.historical_story: Berbaik combines baik, meaning good, with ber-, forming a verb about relationships. The root's positive quality becomes a social condition: being on good terms. Adding semula makes the return explicit, turning friendliness into reconciliation. This compact expression captures the everyday movement from disagreement back to peaceful interaction.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: baik＝好；berbaik＝关系处得好；再加 semula“重新”，就是“重新和好”。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 表示处于某种状态；接 waspada 时保留词根的全部音段，前缀中的 e 读 /ə/。

senses.zh_definition: 保持警觉并谨慎行事，留意可能出现的危险、欺骗或失误。
senses.en_definition: To remain alert and exercise caution against possible danger, deception, or error.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak cuai, berawas-awas, berhati-hati, berjaga-jaga dan beringat-ingat.
senses.nuances: 强调持续保持警惕，不必然表示害怕或怀疑某个人。常接 terhadap 引出防范对象，也可接 ketika 或 semasa 引出需要谨慎的情境。词义依据 [DBP：waspada](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=waspada)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Orang ramai dinasihatkan supaya berwaspada terhadap mesej yang meminta maklumat perbankan peribadi.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 提醒长辈、客户或公众时，可用 Sila berwaspada 或 请托式的 dinasihatkan supaya berwaspada；直接说 Awak kena berwaspada 适合熟人之间。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于防诈骗、交通、天气及工作风险提醒。若针对具体人物，最好说明可核实的行为，避免让提醒变成无根据的指控。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 提醒长辈、客户或公众时，可用 Sila berwaspada 或 请托式的 dinasihatkan supaya berwaspada；直接说 Awak kena berwaspada 适合熟人之间。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于防诈骗、交通、天气及工作风险提醒。若针对具体人物，最好说明可核实的行为，避免让提醒变成无根据的指控。

etymology.historical_story: Berwaspada combines Malay ber- with waspada, expressing a state of alertness. Waspada also appears in the Javanese cultural teaching eling lan waspada, which joins self-awareness with vigilance. This regional association makes the word memorable: watchfulness concerns both outside dangers and one's own conduct. See [Sektiadi, Universitas Gadjah Mada](https://sektiadi.staff.ugm.ac.id/2025/04/eling-lan-waspadha/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 waspada 想成脑中的警示灯：ber- 让灯持续亮着，berwaspada 就是保持警觉。

morphology.pattern_note: 本词是不可按现代词缀拆分的词根，bua- 不是前缀。y 表示 /j/；部分马来西亚口音将词尾 a 弱化为 [ə]，可读作 [buajə]。

word_family.gloss: 像鳄鱼般爬行或滑行；像花花公子般行事
玩弄女性感情的习性或行为

senses.zh_definition: 鳄鱼：体形长大、皮肤厚实、主要栖居水域的大型爬行动物。
senses.en_definition: A large, thick-skinned reptile with a long body and tail that lives mainly in and around water; a crocodile.
senses.ms_definition: Reptilia besar yang berkulit tebal, berbadan panjang dan hidup terutama di kawasan berair.
senses.nuances: 这是动物本义，不是 biawak（巨蜥）。buaya tembaga 指湾鳄；buaya jolong-jolong 指马来长吻鳄。lidah buaya 是芦荟的固定植物名称，不能按字面理解成动物。义项依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》第四版](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=buaya)。

senses.zh_definition: 〈比喻，贬义〉花花公子；反复更换女性伴侣、玩弄或利用女性感情的男子。
senses.en_definition: A womanizer who repeatedly changes female partners and exploits their affection.
senses.ms_definition: Lelaki yang gemar bertukar-tukar pasangan wanita dan mempermainkan atau mengambil kesempatan terhadap mereka.
senses.nuances: 常见于 buaya darat，也可在口语中单用 buaya。带有明显责备意味，不只是中性的‘异性缘好’。传统词典释义还包含侵犯女性贞操后将其抛弃的道德评价。参见 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》第四版](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=buaya)。

collocations.zh: 玩弄女性感情的花花公子

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 动物报道、生态介绍和安全提醒可直接使用 buaya。比喻义适合解释文学、影视或明确语境中的人物评价；职场或正式交往中，不宜随意用它给真人贴标签。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 动物报道、生态介绍和安全提醒可直接使用 buaya。比喻义适合解释文学、影视或明确语境中的人物评价；职场或正式交往中，不宜随意用它给真人贴标签。

etymology.historical_story: Buaya is inherited vocabulary: comparative linguists reconstruct the ancestral Austronesian form *buqaya. Related words name crocodiles across widely separated island languages. The animal also acquired associations with greed and dangerous behavior. Malay preserves this figurative tradition in buaya darat, literally a land crocodile, now a disparaging term for a womanizer. Sources: [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/25730) and [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=buaya).

word_family.gloss: 具有潜力；有可能产生某种结果

senses.zh_definition: 具有实现某种目标、发挥能力或进一步发展的潜力。
senses.en_definition: To have the capacity or potential to achieve something or develop further.

senses.nuances: 属于表示状态的不及物动词，中文常译为“有潜力的”。可修饰人才、市场、产品或地区；不表示已经取得成果。常用结构为 berpotensi untuk + 动词。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=berpotensi)

senses.zh_definition: 具有引发某种情况或产生某种结果的可能性，包括不利结果。
senses.en_definition: To have the potential to bring about a particular outcome, including an undesirable one.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai potensi atau keupayaan untuk menghasilkan atau menyebabkan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是核心义在结果预测中的延伸，马来文释义为据核心义整理的说明。berpotensi 本身不保证结果发生，也不一定表示发生概率很高；后接负面结果时不能译为“有前途”。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies potensi as an English borrowing. Malay adds its productive prefix ber-, expressing possession of a quality or capacity, to create berpotensi. The formation turns the abstract idea of potential into a description of someone or something that possesses it. Its structure remains transparent even when used in modern business or education. [DBP word origin](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=103260&keyword=potensi)

etymology.historical_story: Bermata combines the possession prefix ber- with mata, whose meanings include eyes, cutting edges, and gemstones. Malay jewellery traditions offer a vivid cultural example: a ring can be described as bermata satu because it carries one stone. The shared word connects bodily appearance with the prominent features of crafted objects. [DBP jewellery discussion](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2025/09/30/20156/)

etymology.historical_story: Malay butir connects small physical units, such as grains, with small units of information. Butiran belongs to this lexical family. A useful semantic bridge is to imagine an account assembled grain by grain: each particular contributes to the whole. This explains the connection between material grains and detailed descriptions without requiring an invented origin legend. [DBP: butir](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=75076&keyword=butir)

etymology.historical_story: Bermalam makes the familiar noun malam, meaning night, into a verb through the prefix ber-. Its two dictionary meanings share the same passage of time: a traveller spends a night somewhere, while a cooked dish remains through the night. This everyday connection links hospitality and household food vocabulary without suggesting that the prefix itself means sleep.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: malam 是“夜晚”；ber- 让它成为经历或活动：bermalam 就是“在那里过一夜”。

etymology.historical_story: The sambung family connects physical joining with continuation in time. A rope can receive another length, while a conversation or story can receive another part. Bersambung presents the resulting connection or continuation. Its dictionary senses therefore offer a useful cultural reading of the familiar installment ending: the story still has another piece to come. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bersambung)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sambung 想成“接上下一段”：绳子接上是相连，故事接上是继续；看到 Bersambung 就记“待续”。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节完整词，词尾 k 在所给读音中实现为喉塞音 /ʔ/。比较义没有常用的生产性派生词族，故不虚构词族成员；其他名词义属于同形词。

etymology.historical_story: Bak shows how one spelling can hold separate lexical histories. DBP distinguishes the familiar comparison word from a Dutch-derived container noun and a Chinese-derived word for ink. The comparison use lives on in proverbs and bak kata, a compact way to invoke another person's words. These homonyms should be learned separately rather than forced into one origin story. See [DBP: bak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=bak).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bak /baʔ/ 短短一拍，像口头竖起一个比喻等号：A bak B＝A 如同 B；bak kata＝如某人所说。

senses.nuances: 规范书写为 Beckett。没有上下文时不能直接认定为 Samuel Beckett；文学例句中的指称不构成新的普通名词义。英语发音参见[Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/beckett)。以下搭配展示文学语境中的自然用法，未作频率认证。本条马来语释义为编写释义，非 DBP 引文；status 按指定输出标签保留，不代表 DBP 收录或认证。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于文学课堂、书评和人物介绍。不要因姓氏相同便认定与作家有亲属关系；Beckett 与 Becket 也不应擅自互换拼写。

etymology.historical_story: Beckett is treated here as a whole surname, without assigning an unverified ancestral meaning. A useful cultural association is Samuel Beckett, the Irish writer whose Waiting for Godot brought him international recognition. He received the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1969. This literary association explains a possible referent, rather than the surname's historical derivation. [Biography](https://samuelbeckettsociety.org/biography/); [Nobel award](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/literature/1969/summary/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Beckett、贝克特和《等待戈多》的封面连成一张记忆卡；这是人物联想，不是姓氏词源。

senses.zh_definition: 站在某一方，支持某个阵营、群体或立场。
senses.en_definition: To take the side of, support, or align oneself with a particular party or group.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebelahi salah satu pihak atau memasuki salah satu kumpulan atau golongan.
senses.nuances: 通常是不及物动词，以 kepada 引出所支持的一方。可表示正当支持，也可在批评语境中表示偏袒；tidak berpihak 表示不选边或保持中立。

collocations.en: not take sides with any party

senses.zh_definition: 比喻运气、形势或结果有利于某一方。
senses.en_definition: Of luck, circumstances, or an outcome: to favour a particular person or side.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, memberikan kelebihan atau membawa hasil yang menguntungkan sesuatu pihak.
senses.nuances: 这是“站在某方”义的拟人化延伸，常用于体育报道和叙事。主语可以是 nasib、tuah 等，不表示它们真的作出了立场选择。

etymology.historical_story: Pihak names a side, direction, or group; adding ber- produces the act of taking a side. Its lexical story connects physical position with social allegiance: standing on someone’s side becomes supporting their cause. The dictionary records both spatial and group meanings of pihak, making this connection visible within the Malay word family. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=pihak)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pihak 是“一方”，berpihak 就是“站到某一方”：berpihak kepada siapa？——站谁那边？

senses.zh_definition: 形容动物凶猛、具有攻击性，通常带有野性。

senses.zh_definition: 形容人或其行为凶残、残暴、毫不仁慈。

senses.zh_definition: 形容欲望或冲动失去约束，强烈而放纵。

senses.nuances: 多见于文学、评论及道德批评，带明显贬义。nafsu buas 有时涉及性欲，但也可泛指强烈而失控的欲望，须结合上下文。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 把人称为 buas 是强烈负面评价，容易构成侮辱。描述严格的老师或主管通常用 tegas；描述凶巴巴的态度可按语境用 garang。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合描述猛兽、严重暴行或文学中的失控欲望。避免用来概括某个族群、社群或文化；nafsu buas 带强烈道德批评，不宜随意用于轻松社交。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan illustrates buas with a classical-style sentence about a fearsome thief in Melaka, alongside its familiar animal sense. This gives the word a vivid cultural range: a beast may be fierce, a person cruel, and desire uncontrolled. These attested uses connect physical ferocity with moral judgment and the language of restraint. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=buas)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 bu-as 时想象猛兽张口露牙：动物是“凶猛”，人是“凶残”，欲望则是“失控”。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接 baris 时保持完整形式，词干不变。ber- 可表达处于某种状态、参与某种活动或具有某物；此处随语境表示成行、列队或带有线条。

senses.zh_definition: 排列成行、成排或呈连续的行列，尤指物体的排列状态。
senses.en_definition: To stand or be arranged in rows or a line.
senses.ms_definition: Tersusun dalam baris-baris tertentu; berderet, berbanjar atau berjajar.
senses.nuances: 不必有人主动排队；树木、房屋或其他物体也可 berbaris。用于景物描写时常带有整齐延伸的视觉感。

senses.zh_definition: 多人按一定队形站立或行进；排队、列队或操练队列。
senses.en_definition: To form a line or stand or march together in an ordered formation.
senses.ms_definition: Berdiri, berjalan dan sebagainya beramai-ramai dalam baris tertentu.
senses.nuances: 既可指日常排队，也可指学校、制服团体或军队的列队活动。berbaris 本身不保证正在行进；kawad kaki 更明确指步操训练。该词通常不带直接宾语，使别人列队则用 membariskan。

senses.zh_definition: 带有线条或被加上线条，如纸上有横线、文字下方有划线。
senses.en_definition: To have or be marked with lines, as on ruled paper or beneath underlined text.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai atau dibubuhi baris atau garis; bergaris.
senses.nuances: 这是“具有线条”的状态义，不是排队义。现代教学指令中，bergaris 或 bergaris bawah 往往更明确；berbaris 也不必然表示文字下划线，须结合修饰语判断。

dual_scenarios.context: 学校通知：集合安排
dual_scenarios.ms: Semua murid dikehendaki berbaris di tapak perhimpunan sebelum pukul tujuh setengah pagi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 所有学生须在早上七点半之前到集合场地列队。

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp：朋友在售票柜台外碰面

aku、kau 适用于关系熟悉的平辈。
nak 对应 hendak；强调性的 lah 在此表达轻微提醒。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah berbaris kat luar kaunter. Kau kat mana?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah berbaris di luar kaunter. Kamu berada di mana?

messages.ms_standard: Saya baru sampai. Saya hendak berbaris di hujung belakang barisan.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 要求公众排队时，Sila berbaris… 比单独命令 Berbaris! 更客气。学校或步操场景中的简短口令语气较直接，应按角色和场合使用。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 日常候车、购票或办事时，排在队尾并遵守先后次序。需要确认队尾可问 Ini hujung barisan, ya?；插队通常称为 memotong barisan。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 要求公众排队时，Sila berbaris… 比单独命令 Berbaris! 更客气。学校或步操场景中的简短口令语气较直接，应按角色和场合使用。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 日常候车、购票或办事时，排在队尾并遵守先后次序。需要确认队尾可问 Ini hujung barisan, ya?；插队通常称为 memotong barisan。

etymology.historical_story: A line provides the shared image behind this word's meanings. With ber-, baris can describe objects standing in rows, people forming a queue, or a surface carrying lines. The supplied Kamus Dewan entry places rubber trees beside collective standing and walking, connecting a familiar plantation landscape with the everyday organisation of people in space.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: baris＝“一排”；加 ber-，就进入“成排”的状态：树成排、人排队、纸有横线。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 表示从事某项活动；接 judi 时保留前缀和词根原形，不发生辅音替换。

senses.zh_definition: 以金钱或其他财物作赌注，参与输赢决定财物得失的游戏；赌博。
senses.en_definition: To gamble by playing a game with money or other valuables at stake.
senses.ms_definition: Bermain dengan memakai wang dan sebagainya sebagai taruhan.
senses.nuances: 通常是不及物动词：berjudi 描述参与赌博，下注的财物可用 dengan 引出。单纯打牌或玩游戏而没有赌注，不一定属于 berjudi。比喻性地拿前途或性命冒险时，常用 memperjudikan。释义依据：[DBP：judi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=judi)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Program kesedaran itu menerangkan kesan ketagihan berjudi terhadap kewangan dan hubungan keluarga.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该宣传教育项目说明赌博成瘾对财务状况和家庭关系的影响。
dual_scenarios.en: The awareness programme explains how gambling addiction affects finances and family relationships.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku tak nak berjudi lah, kita main tanpa taruhan je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya tidak mahu berjudi. Kita bermain tanpa taruhan sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我不想赌啦，我们玩玩就好，别下注。
dual_scenarios.en: I don't want to gamble. Let's just play without betting.
spoken_features: tak 是 tidak 的口语形式。
nak 对应 mahu；je 对应 sahaja。
lah 在此加强个人立场；aku、kau 用于熟人之间。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nak main kad tak? Kita main tanpa taruhan je.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu mahu bermain kad? Kita bermain tanpa taruhan sahaja.
messages.zh: 要不要打牌？我们就玩玩，不下注。
messages.en: Want to play cards? We won't bet anything.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Boleh, aku memang tak nak berjudi lah.
messages.ms_standard: Boleh. Saya memang tidak mahu berjudi.
messages.zh: 可以，我本来就不想赌啦。
messages.en: Sure. I don't want to gamble anyway.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是中性描述词，但直接说某人 berjudi 可能带有指责意味；谈论具体个人时，应区分已知行为与猜测。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 赌博在马来西亚具有宗教和家庭层面的敏感性，尤其在穆斯林社交环境中。适合用于讨论行为、成瘾和家庭影响；不要默认普通牌局一定涉及赌博。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是中性描述词，但直接说某人 berjudi 可能带有指责意味；谈论具体个人时，应区分已知行为与猜测。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 赌博在马来西亚具有宗教和家庭层面的敏感性，尤其在穆斯林社交环境中。适合用于讨论行为、成瘾和家庭影响；不要默认普通牌局一定涉及赌博。

etymology.historical_story: Berjudi combines the Malay activity prefix ber- with judi, gambling. Early lexicographers proposed a connection between judi and Sanskrit dyūta, dice play, although the precise transmission route should not be treated as settled. Dice provide a memorable cultural bridge: an ordinary game becomes gambling when players stake something valuable on its outcome. [Historical discussion](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/6c/A_manual_of_the_Malay_language._With_an_introductory_sketch_of_the_Sanskrit_element_in_Malay_%28IA_manualofmalaylan00maxwrich%29.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 ju 与“赌局”的“局”作近音联想：judi 是赌局活动，加 ber- 就是参与进去——赌博。近音仅用于记忆。

morphology.formula: ber- + terus → berterus；规范常用表达：ber- + terus terang → berterus terang
morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接 terus 时不改变词根。词包提供的 تروس 是词根 terus 的爪夷文，此处按输入保留；berterus 对应的构词拼写为 برتروس。实际教学和造句应使用完整表达 berterus terang。

senses.zh_definition: 用于完整表达 berterus terang：坦率地说出实情，不隐瞒自己的想法或真实情况。
senses.en_definition: In berterus terang: to speak frankly or truthfully, without concealment.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan berterus terang: bercakap atau berkata yang sebenarnya, tanpa berselindung.
senses.nuances: 本义属于完整表达 berterus terang，不能据此将单独的 berterus 当作常用的“坦白”动词。该表达分写且不加连字符。词包所附 terus 的“直接、不断”等释义不能直接移植为 berterus 的独立义项；表示“持续”通常用 berterusan。依据：[DBP：berterus terang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=berterus+terang)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Saya ingin berterus terang bahawa pasukan kami memerlukan masa tambahan untuk menyiapkan laporan ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我想坦率说明，我们的团队需要更多时间完成这份报告。
dual_scenarios.en: I would like to be frank: our team needs more time to complete this report.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak berterus terang dengan kau, aku belum siap lagi.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya mahu berterus terang dengan kamu bahawa saya masih belum siap.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我跟你说实话吧，我还没弄好。
dual_scenarios.en: I'll be honest with you: I'm still not done.
spoken_features: nak 对应 mahu。
aku、kau 表示熟人之间的交流关系。
口语用停顿连接说明内容；标准句可用 bahawa 引出内容。
完整保留 berterus terang，不省略 terang。

messages.speaker: Farah (熟悉的同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak berterus terang dengan kau, laporan tu belum siap lagi.
messages.ms_standard: Saya mahu berterus terang dengan kamu bahawa laporan itu masih belum siap.
messages.zh: 我跟你说实话，那份报告还没弄好。
messages.en: I'll be honest with you: the report still isn't ready.

messages.speaker: Amir (熟悉的同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Tak apa, cakap je bahagian mana yang kau perlukan bantuan.
messages.ms_standard: Tidak mengapa. Beritahu saya bahagian yang memerlukan bantuan saya.
messages.zh: 没事，你直接说哪一部分需要我帮忙。
messages.en: That's okay. Just tell me which part you need help with.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 坦诚涉及批评或拒绝时，可先说 Izinkan saya berterus terang 或 Saya ingin berterus terang，再具体说明事实，避免让对方难堪。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合澄清误会、说明困难和表达真实立场。与上级、长辈或不熟悉的人交谈时，宜私下、温和地说明；坦诚不意味着可以用羞辱性的措辞。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 坦诚涉及批评或拒绝时，可先说 Izinkan saya berterus terang 或 Saya ingin berterus terang，再具体说明事实，避免让对方难堪。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合澄清误会、说明困难和表达真实立场。与上级、长辈或不熟悉的人交谈时，宜私下、温和地说明；坦诚不意味着可以用羞辱性的措辞。

etymology.historical_story: The established expression berterus terang brings together terus, associated with directness, and terang, associated with clarity or light. Its meaning is frank speech without concealment. As a semantic interpretation, it pictures truth as something made clear rather than hidden. Learning the whole expression preserves that image and avoids confusing it with berterusan, which describes continuity. [DBP expression and definitions](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=terus+terang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: terus 联想“直接”，terang 联想“明亮、清楚”：直接把话说清楚，就是 berterus terang。必须把 terang 一起记住。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 直接接在 susah 前，词根首音 s 保留，不发生鼻音同化；前缀 e 读 /ə/。

senses.zh_definition: 为完成某事而辛苦操劳、费力奔忙。
senses.en_definition: To take trouble or exert considerable effort to do something.
senses.ms_definition: Melakukan sesuatu dengan susah payah; berpenat lelah mengerjakan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常与 payah 连用，也可用重叠形式 bersusah-susah。重点是行动所付出的辛劳，不单指生活贫困。tak perlu bersusah 常用于体贴地表示不必特地费心。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=bersusah)

senses.zh_definition: 感到忧愁、难过或心中不安。
senses.en_definition: To feel troubled, sorrowful, or distressed.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa susah hati; berdukacita.
senses.nuances: 这一义项通常以 bersusah hati 出现，语气偏书面或温和劝慰。日常口语中，risau 更常表示担心，sedih 更常表示难过。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=bersusah)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场 / 致谢发言
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak penganjur merakamkan penghargaan kepada semua sukarelawan yang bersusah payah menyediakan tempat perlindungan untuk mangsa banjir.
dual_scenarios.zh: 主办方向所有辛苦为水灾灾民准备避难场所的志愿者致以谢意。

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tak payah bersusah masak banyak-banyak lah, kita makan yang ada je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Tidak perlu bersusah menyediakan makanan yang banyak; kita makan sahaja makanan yang ada.

lah 缓和劝说语气；je 对应 sahaja。
masak banyak-banyak 是自然口语，表示煮很多食物。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Korang nak datang pukul berapa? Aku nak masak nasi dengan lauk sikit.
messages.ms_standard: Kamu semua hendak datang pada pukul berapa? Saya hendak memasak nasi dan menyediakan sedikit lauk.

messages.zh: 大概七点吧。不用那么费心啦，我们买点吃的就好。
messages.en: Probably seven. Don't go to any trouble—we can just buy some food.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 对主人说 tak perlu bersusah 是体贴的客套话，承认对方招待所付出的心力。面对长辈可说 Mak cik tidak perlu bersusah，并补上感谢。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 称赞他人辛劳时可说 Terima kasih kerana bersusah payah。安慰处于真实困境的人时，单说 jangan bersusah hati 可能显得轻描淡写，宜同时表达理解或提供具体帮助。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 对主人说 tak perlu bersusah 是体贴的客套话，承认对方招待所付出的心力。面对长辈可说 Mak cik tidak perlu bersusah，并补上感谢。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 称赞他人辛劳时可说 Terima kasih kerana bersusah payah。安慰处于真实困境的人时，单说 jangan bersusah hati 可能显得轻描淡写，宜同时表达理解或提供具体帮助。

etymology.historical_story: Bersusah is transparently formed from ber- and susah, turning difficulty into an activity or experienced condition. Its cultural resonance appears in the familiar proverb bersusah-susah dahulu, bersenang-senang kemudian: accept hardship first and enjoy ease later. The same word also softens hospitality exchanges, allowing guests to acknowledge a host's effort while asking them not to overexert themselves. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=bersusah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: susah＝困难；加 ber-，人就进入辛苦操劳的状态。记住 bersusah payah＝费尽力气，bersusah hati＝心里忧愁。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留整词分析；此处音标为英语读音。没有证据支持将其拆成马来语词缀与词根。

word_family.gloss: 看跌的；不是马来语派生词
可忍受的；源自动词 bear，与动物名词分属不同词源

senses.zh_definition: 英语动物名词：熊，指熊科哺乳动物；标准马来语通常用 beruang。
senses.en_definition: An English noun denoting a mammal of the family Ursidae; Malay: beruang.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, mamalia daripada famili Ursidae; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah beruang.
senses.nuances: 英语候选义项，不能据此认定 bear 是表示动物的正式马来语词。英语 teddy bear 指玩具熊，不是另一个动物类别。[DBP 英马词典对应](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=beruang)

senses.zh_definition: 英语动词：承载、承担或忍受；具体马来语译法须依宾语选择，如 memikul、menanggung 或 menahan。
senses.en_definition: To carry or support a burden, accept a responsibility, or endure something difficult.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, membawa atau memikul beban, menanggung tanggungjawab, atau menahan sesuatu yang sukar.
senses.nuances: 这些是英语动词的相关用法，不是已核实的马来语义项。承担费用通常译为 menanggung kos；忍受疼痛可译为 menahan kesakitan。所列马来语定义为编写释义。[DBP：menanggung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=menanggung)

senses.zh_definition: 金融英语：预期证券等资产价格下跌的交易者或投资者，即空头。
senses.en_definition: A market participant who expects prices to fall.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam istilah kewangan bahasa Inggeris, pelaku pasaran yang menjangkakan harga akan menurun.
senses.nuances: DBP 英马词典在证券交易语境保留 bear，并列出 pasaran bear；这支持其金融术语用途，但不能证明整条输入的所有义项均属正式马来语。[DBP：bear 的金融对应](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=beruang)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报 / 英语合同术语说明

etymology.historical_story: English bear hides two histories behind one spelling. The animal noun continues Old English bera, traditionally associated with a Germanic expression meaning the brown one. The verb continues Old English beran, meaning to carry. Their modern spelling therefore conceals a historical distinction rather than a Malay derivational relationship. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/bear)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bear 分成两幅画：熊是一幅，肩上承担重物是另一幅；同音同形不代表同一词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，无马来语词缀；按马来语读出两个音节，不沿用英语的双元音和弱读元音。词族所列为复合表达。

senses.zh_definition: 在工资或其他原有报酬之外，作为奖励或酬谢而额外支付的奖金。

senses.ms_definition: Bayaran tambahan pada gaji dan sebagainya sebagai pemberian atau ganjaran.

senses.ms_definition: Manfaat tambahan yang diperoleh di luar jangkaan atau tujuan asal.
senses.nuances: 由额外奖励义引申而来，常见于日常交流和宣传文案，不一定涉及金钱；这是常用引申义的编辑性概括。

etymology.historical_story: Malay borrowed bonus from English, whose word ultimately comes from Latin bonus, meaning good. Its journey connects an ancient adjective with modern rewards: something good becomes something extra. In Malaysian usage, the word covers both workplace rewards and benefits distributed to policyholders or shareholders, bringing employment and financial vocabulary together. See [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/bonus) and [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=bonus).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bo.nus 就是熟悉的英语 bonus；记住“工资之外，多出来的一笔”。马来语读 bo-nus，两个音节清楚读出。

senses.zh_definition: 英语名词：活动或工作中的短暂停顿、休息时间；马来语可用 rehat 或 waktu rehat。
senses.en_definition: A short interruption of an activity, especially a period of rest.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, tempoh berhenti sebentar daripada sesuatu kegiatan, khususnya untuk berehat.
senses.nuances: 在马来语与英语混用的交谈中可作为英语插入词使用。正式马来语宜按语境写作 waktu rehat、waktu minum 或 waktu makan tengah hari。[DBP 英马词典：break](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=break)

senses.zh_definition: 英语动词：使物体破裂、折断或断开，或物体自行发生这些变化。
senses.en_definition: To fracture, snap, or separate into pieces, or cause something to do so.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, menjadi pecah, patah atau putus, atau menyebabkan sesuatu mengalami keadaan tersebut.
senses.nuances: 马来语译法依物体而变：玻璃常用 pecah，树枝常用 patah，绳索常用 putus；不能统一译作一个动词。不要与英语 brake 或马来语 brek 混淆。[DBP 英马词典：break](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=break)

senses.zh_definition: 英语动词的引申用法：违反规则或承诺；也可指打破纪录。
senses.en_definition: To violate a rule or promise, or surpass an existing record.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, melanggar peraturan atau janji, atau mengatasi rekod yang sedia ada.
senses.nuances: 不同搭配需要不同马来语译法：违反法律用 melanggar undang-undang，打破纪录用 memecahkan rekod。这些是英语搭配义。[DBP 英马词典：break](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=break)

etymology.historical_story: English break continues Old English brecan, a Germanic verb associated with breaking and shattering. Its modern uses connect physical separation with interruptions in activities and departures from rules. A work break can therefore be remembered as a gap in continuous activity, although that image is a learning aid rather than a Malay word origin. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/break)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把连续工作想成一根线：break 让线暂时断开，就是休息；发音与 brake 相同，但含义不同。

senses.nuances: 属于地理专名，正式写作 Brazil；葡萄牙语本国拼写为 Brasil。体育报道中，Brazil 也可依语境代指巴西国家队。此处马来文释义为编写释义；马来西亚官方文本使用 Brazil。[马来西亚首相署：马来西亚与巴西](https://www.pmo.gov.my/en/news-en/malaysia-berbesar-hati-dan-berbangga-tatkala-menerima-kunjungan-rasmi-presiden-lula-dan-isteri-dari-brazil/)

etymology.historical_story: Brazil's name is conventionally linked to pau-brasil, the valuable tree whose wood yielded red dye. Trade in that material helped the name become attached to the territory. The deeper history of brasil has competing explanations, so the tree connection is more secure than a simple claim that the country was directly named after glowing embers. [Fundação Joaquim Nabuco](https://pesquisaescolar.fundaj.gov.br/pt-br/artigo/pau-brasil/), [Brazilian Academy of Letters](https://www.academia.org.br/noticias/abl-na-midia-g1-vai-brasa-afinal-alguem-fala-assim-novo-uniforme-da-selecao-tem-ver-com)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Brazil 的 bra- 联想“巴”，整词连到“巴西”；再记一幅红色染木的画面，连接国名背后的巴西木贸易史。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接在 goyang 前保持原形，词根首音 /ɡ/ 不变；表示处于摇摆状态或进行摇摆动作。

senses.zh_definition: 摇摆；晃动；物体或身体来回摆动，也可指随音乐摆动身体。
senses.en_definition: To sway, rock, or move repeatedly from side to side, including moving the body to music.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak berulang-ulang ke kiri dan ke kanan atau ke hadapan dan ke belakang; berayun, termasuk mengikut irama muzik.
senses.nuances: 通常描述主体本身在动；若明确表示使另一物体摇动，现代常用 menggoyangkan 或 mengayunkan。DBP 也收录进行摇动、摇荡动作的用法。摇摆不一定剧烈，也不必伴随位移。参见：[DBP：bergoyang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bergoyang)。

senses.zh_definition: 动摇；原有的立场、信心或地位变得不稳固。
senses.en_definition: To waver or become unstable, especially in one's resolve, confidence, or position.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi kurang teguh atau tidak tetap, khususnya tentang pendirian, keyakinan atau kedudukan.
senses.nuances: 这是由身体或物体晃动引申出的比喻用法，常与 mula、tidak 或 sedikit pun 连用。若强调外力使某人的信心动摇，使用 menggoyangkan keyakinan。

senses.zh_definition: 在固定说法 bergoyang kaki 中，指悠闲度日、无须工作而享清福，有时暗含游手好闲之意。
senses.en_definition: In bergoyang kaki, to live at ease without working, sometimes with an implication of idleness.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan bergoyang kaki, hidup senang tanpa perlu bekerja atau melakukan sesuatu tugas.
senses.nuances: 此义依赖完整短语 bergoyang kaki；bergoyang 单独使用不表示懒惰。该短语也可按字面理解为坐着晃脚，具体取决于语境。[DBP：bergoyang kaki](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bergoyang)。

etymology.historical_story: Bergoyang is transparently formed within Malay from goyang and the prefix ber-. Its imagery links ordinary movement with familiar cultural expressions: leaves sway, heads move in astonishment, and feet swing while someone sits. In bergoyang kaki, that relaxed posture becomes an image of living without work. This is a semantic connection, rather than a claim about when the expression originated. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bergoyang)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 go.yang 两个音节想成左右两拍，身体跟着来回晃；加上 ber-，就是正在摇摆的 bergoyang。

etymology.historical_story: The name baht comes from Thai บาท. Before serving as the familiar currency name, it referred to a traditional unit of weight used for precious materials. That history connects money with the practice of weighing valuable metal. Modern currency uses the same name, but a monetary amount must be distinguished from a weight measurement. [Thai government reference](https://www.thailand.go.th/page/thai-currency)

morphology.formula: be → been（英语不规则过去分词；无马来语词缀）
morphology.pattern_note: 实际词元为英语 be，故修正资料包将 been 标为词根的分析。affix_type 为 none 表示没有马来语词缀，不表示没有英语屈折变化；不可套用马来语 meN- 规则。

word_family.gloss: 英语现在分词；可用于进行体或被动结构

senses.zh_definition: 英语 be 的过去分词；与 have、has 或 had 等构成完成结构，表示曾经或持续处于某种身份、状态或位置。
senses.en_definition: The past participle of be, used in perfect constructions to express identity, condition, existence, or location.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk participle lampau bagi kata kerja bahasa Inggeris be, digunakan dalam binaan perfekt untuk menyatakan identiti, keadaan, kewujudan atau kedudukan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词形，不可一律译为 sudah 或 pernah。资料包不能证明其为正式马来语词条；全部马来语释义均为编辑释义。搭配字段采用马来语引述框架展示英语结构，不冒充马来语固有搭配。词形及功能见 [Merriam-Webster: be](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/be)。

senses.ms_definition: Digunakan dalam binaan seperti have been to untuk menyatakan pengalaman mengunjungi sesuatu tempat, lazimnya selepas kunjungan itu selesai.
senses.nuances: have been to 强调去过的经历；have gone to 通常表示已经前往、尚未回来。此处可对应马来语 pernah ke 或 pernah mengunjungi。参见 [Cambridge: been](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/been)。

senses.zh_definition: 作英语助动词 be 的过去分词，用于完成进行结构或完成被动结构。
senses.en_definition: The past participle of auxiliary be in perfect progressive and perfect passive constructions.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk participle lampau bagi kata kerja bantu be dalam binaan perfekt progresif dan perfekt pasif bahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: have been working 表示活动此前持续进行；has been approved 为完成被动结构。been 本身不直接表示“工作”或“批准”。参见 [Merriam-Webster: be](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/be)。

etymology.historical_story: Been belongs to the inherited English verb be, whose history reaches back through Middle English to Old English bēon. Modern English keeps been as its past participle, alongside forms such as am, is, was, and were. Its appearance in Malay material can reflect quotation or English use; the packet alone does not establish a Malay borrowing. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/be).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 have + been 这对搭档：先认出英语完成结构，再按语境理解为“曾经”“一直”或被动；不要把 been 当成 bin。

morphology.formula: bertanya + -kan → bertanyakan；进一步分析：ber- + tanya + -kan → bertanyakan
morphology.pattern_note: 依输入包保留直接基底 bertanya；最小词根是 tanya。加 -kan 时没有词首鼻音替换；ny 表示单一辅音 /ɲ/。这里的 -kan 引出询问的事项，并非使动义。

senses.zh_definition: 询问某事，要求获得有关某人、某事或某种情况的说明或消息。
senses.en_definition: To ask about someone or something; to seek information concerning a matter.
senses.ms_definition: Bertanya berkenaan sesuatu; meminta keterangan mengenai sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 后面直接接所询问的事项，如 bertanyakan khabar。若说明向谁询问，可用 kepada：bertanyakan hal itu kepada pegawai。-kan 已承担“关于”的作用，宜避免冗余的 bertanyakan tentang。可比较 bertanya tentang hal itu 与 bertanyakan hal itu。参见 [DBP 的 tanya 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=tanya)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: bertanyakan khabar 是常见的关心表达。涉及薪资、婚姻或健康细节时，宜先判断关系与场合，并给对方不回答的空间；询问办理进度时可保持语气中性。

etymology.historical_story: Bertanyakan illustrates Malay's own productive word formation: tanya develops into bertanya, followed here by -kan. Kamus Dewan includes an example in classical narrative style about asking after the affairs of a country. The same construction remains useful today when asking about someone's wellbeing, a price, or the progress of an application.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tanya＝问；bertanya＝进行询问；bertanyakan＋事项＝询问那件事。记住 bertanyakan khabar，就能抓住“问有关……的情况”。

etymology.historical_story: Biro belongs to the international vocabulary associated with bureau. In French, bureau developed from a word for coarse cloth into the cloth covering an accounting table, then the desk itself, and eventually an office or administrative body. This semantic journey offers a useful historical parallel for the institutional meaning recorded in Malay. [CNRTL：bureau](https://www.cnrtl.fr/etymologie/bureau)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bi-ro 和英语 bureau 的读音联系起来：想到处理事务的柜台，再想到柜台背后的部门。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根不发生音变，派生词分节为 ba.ca.kan。-kan 在此突出为他人读出内容。所给爪夷文 باچ 是词根 baca 的写法；完整派生形式为 باچاکن。

etymology.historical_story: Bacakan is transparently formed within Malay from baca and the suffix kan. The dictionary records membacakan as reading for someone, illustrated by storytelling to a child. That familiar scene captures the distinction: baca names reading, while bacakan directs the reading toward a listener. Its formation is explainable without proposing an uncertain remote origin. [DBP：baca／membacakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=baca)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: baca 是“读”，加 -kan 时想象声音传给旁边的人：bacakan＝读给别人听。

etymology.historical_story: Baja has several dictionary histories hidden behind one spelling. Its agricultural entry names substances that nourish crops, while separate entries concern steel and a traditional preparation for blackening teeth. These meanings should not be woven into an invented common origin. Their coexistence illustrates how a Malay dictionary distinguishes homonyms even when everyday readers encounter identical letters.

etymology.historical_story: Barnes enters this Malay context as a retained English surname, rather than a Malay lexical root with a descriptive meaning. A university catalogue records the 1951 Report of the Committee on Malay Education under L. J. Barnes. The familiar expression Laporan Barnes names the document through a person's surname. [Catalogue record](https://melayu.library.uitm.edu.my/115/).

etymology.historical_story: Brendan belongs to the Irish naming tradition. Medieval evidence connects it with Irish Brénainn and Latinized forms such as Brendanus. The underlying Irish name borrowed a Welsh word meaning “prince.” Two sixth-century Irish saints bore the name, helping explain its historical religious associations. Those associations do not establish a modern bearer’s nationality or beliefs. Source: [Dictionary of Medieval Names from European Sources](https://dmnes.org/name/Brendan).

etymology.historical_story: Bertopeng is transparently formed from ber- and topeng, meaning a mask. The root belongs to the vocabulary of both performance and concealment: a mask can create a stage character or hide a face. Malay extends that visible covering into a figurative one, allowing bertopeng to describe someone whose outward appearance conceals their real intentions.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ber- 表示“戴着”，topeng 是“面具”：ber- + topeng，一张脸戴上面具；引申为真心藏在假面后。

etymology.historical_story: Bomnya illustrates how Malay builds meaning through a short attached form rather than a separate possessive word. The root bom names the explosive weapon, while -nya connects it to a person or an established topic. The combination is grammatically transparent; it has no separate origin story requiring a new root or an invented historical decomposition.

etymology.historical_story: Bendanya joins benda to the attached element -nya. DBP identifies benda among Malay words borrowed from Sanskrit, illustrating how an old borrowing can become thoroughly ordinary vocabulary. Modern speakers use it for objects, possessions and loosely identified things. Adding -nya links that everyday noun to an owner or an understood referent, so the full interpretation depends on the surrounding conversation. [DBP language history](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/majalah/2019/dbahasa10/files/basic-html/page38.html)

etymology.historical_story: English bishop developed through Old English bisceop from Latin episcopus, ultimately from Greek episkopos, meaning overseer. The history connects the title with supervision before its specialized church meaning. Modern English also uses bishop for a diagonal-moving chess piece. In Malay discourse, the spelling can therefore signal an English religious title, a chess term, or a capitalized surname. [Merriam-Webster etymology](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/bishop)

etymology.historical_story: Bin belongs to the Arabic naming tradition associated with ibn, meaning son. In Malay names, it connects a man's personal name with his father's name, preserving a relationship rather than supplying a hereditary surname. Malay also developed a playful extension: between near synonyms, as in ganjil bin ajaib, the same connector strengthens an expression instead of identifying parentage.

messages.speaker: Mei (朋友)

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Itu panggilan lama untuk sesetengah lelaki India Utara. Kalau tak kenal, guna nama atau "encik" je.

messages.zh: 那是以前对一些北印度裔男性的称呼。不熟的话，叫名字或称 encik 就好。
messages.en: It's a traditional term for some men of North Indian descent. If you don't know someone, use their name or "encik".

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 是否显得亲切取决于熟悉程度、地方惯例和对方偏好。不要因为对方戴头巾或看似北印度裔就自动称 bai；不熟时使用姓名或 encik。

etymology.historical_story: Bai is linked to bhai, meaning brother in Hindi and related North Indian languages. James T. Collins cites Wilkinson's 1932 dictionary, which describes its use as a familiar address for North Indian men. Its Malaysian history shows how a kinship expression can become a community label, while older dictionary wording may obscure distinctions between Bengali, Punjabi and Sikh identities. [Source](https://www.scribd.com/document/521422996/Kamus-dan-Etnisiti-Sains-dan-Masyarakat-James-T-Collins)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bai 连到 bhai 的“兄弟”义来记；记住它是有关系和语境限制的称呼，不是精确的族群名称。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根不带词缀；加 meN- 或 peN- 时分别形成 membungkus、pembungkus，词首 b 保留。所列 IPA 采用标准元音读法；马来西亚部分口音将末音节 u 实现为 [o]，如输入包的 [ˈbuŋ.kos]。

senses.zh_definition: 用来包裹物品的纸、布、叶片等材料；包皮或包装。
senses.en_definition: Material used to wrap something; a wrapper.
senses.ms_definition: Bahan seperti kertas, kain atau daun yang digunakan untuk membalut sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 此义指外层材料，较明确的现代说法是 pembungkus。与“包好的物品”须按上下文区分。释义为对 [DBP：bungkus](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=bungkus) 的规范化转述。

senses.zh_definition: 用纸、布、叶片等包好的物品；一包东西。
senses.en_definition: A wrapped object or bundle; a package.
senses.ms_definition: Benda atau barang yang telah dibalut dengan kertas, kain, daun atau bahan lain.
senses.nuances: 相当于 bungkusan；强调包起来的整体及其内容。现代正式文体常用 bungkusan 使意思更明确。

senses.zh_definition: 量词：包；用于以纸、叶片、塑料等包好的物品。
senses.en_definition: A classifier for wrapped or packaged items: a packet or pack.
senses.ms_definition: Penjodoh bilangan bagi benda yang dibalut atau dibungkus.
senses.nuances: 本义的实际语法功能是 penjodoh bilangan；因给定词性枚举没有量词，归入 noun。sebungkus 表示一包，dua bungkus 表示两包；每包的重量或份量并不固定。

senses.zh_definition: 包起来；在餐饮口语中指打包外带或把剩余食物包好带走。
senses.en_definition: To wrap or pack something, especially food for takeaway.
senses.ms_definition: Membalut atau memasukkan sesuatu ke dalam pembungkus; dalam percakapan tentang makanan, menyediakan makanan untuk dibawa pulang.
senses.nuances: 裸词根可用于祈使句；日常口语也常省略 membungkus 的 meN-。在餐馆只说 bungkus，通常表示外带；若是打包桌上的剩菜，应明确说 baki makanan ini，以免被理解为另点一份外带餐。

etymology.historical_story: DBP's entry places paper, cloth and leaves together as wrapping materials. This helps explain the word's connected meanings: the covering, the wrapped object, and the unit counted as one packet. Its examples include rice wrapped in banana leaves. Today's takeaway use keeps that practical association between food, its covering and a portable portion. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=bungkus).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 bungkus 就想象把饭“包成一包”：动词是打包，名词是包装或包裹，数东西时就是“包”。

etymology.historical_story: Beliung carries a woodworking history into Malay proverbial language. The expression bagai beliung dengan asahan describes an exceptionally close relationship by pairing the tool with its sharpening stone. This is cultural evidence rather than proof of the word's ultimate linguistic origin. The image offers a practical memory: a working edge and the stone that maintains it belong closely together.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一把横刃工具沿木面削出长木屑：beliung＝木工锛。puting beliung 则整块另记为“旋风、龙卷风”。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接元音开头的 atur，词根不变；连读时 /r/ 可进入后一音节，因此可见 be.ra.tur 与 ber.a.tur 两种分节。

senses.zh_definition: 排队；站成或保持队列。
senses.en_definition: To stand in line or form a queue.
senses.ms_definition: Berada atau berdiri dalam barisan.

senses.zh_definition: 指物品排列整齐；处于有序排列的状态。
senses.en_definition: To be arranged neatly or in an orderly line.
senses.ms_definition: Berada dalam susunan yang baik, berkenaan dengan barang atau benda.
senses.nuances: 主语是已经排列好的物品，强调其状态。表达某人主动整理物品时用 mengatur；日常描写物品整齐也常用 tersusun 或 teratur。

etymology.historical_story: Beratur belongs to the Malay word family built on atur, which concerns arrangement and order. Its transparent formation connects people standing in a line with objects arranged neatly. In Malaysian public life, the word appears in school instructions, service counters and transport queues, making the abstract idea of order visible in everyday behaviour.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 atur 记成“安排有序”：ber- + atur，就是人或物进入有序排列；人在其中，就是“排队”。

morphology.pattern_note: bulat 是独立词根，无须拆分。派生时 meN- 在 b 前取 mem-，保留 b，如 membulatkan。

word_family.gloss: 使成圆形；使坚定；将数值取整

senses.zh_definition: 呈球状的；浑圆的。
senses.en_definition: Round like a ball; spherical or rounded.
senses.ms_definition: Seperti bola bentuknya.
senses.nuances: 强调立体外形；在日常描述中不要求物体在几何上是完美球体。修饰 mata 时常指眼睛圆大，具体神态由上下文表达。[DBP：bulat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=bulat)

senses.zh_definition: 呈圆形的；具有圆形轮廓的。
senses.en_definition: Circular; having a round outline.
senses.ms_definition: Bundar seperti talam atau duit syiling.
senses.nuances: 可描述平面轮廓，也可描述桌面等物体的形状。bulat 本身不能区分圆盘与球体，须由被修饰的名词和语境判断。

senses.zh_definition: 完整而不分裂的；全心全意的；团结一致的。
senses.en_definition: Whole and undivided; wholehearted, united, or unanimous.
senses.ms_definition: Lengkap seluruhnya (tidak pecah dan lain-lain), dengan keseluruhannya (tidak berpecah-pecah, tidak berbelah bagi), bersatu, berpadu.
senses.nuances: 由形状义延伸到整体性与一致性。bulat suara 表示意见一致；更常见的完整表达是 sebulat suara。bulat-bulat 是重叠形式，可表示全盘、整个地，不能在所有位置直接用 bulat 替换。

senses.zh_definition: 意志或决心坚定、不再犹豫的。
senses.en_definition: Firm or settled in intention or resolve.
senses.ms_definition: Tetap hati.
senses.nuances: 主要见于 bulat tekad、bulat hati、bulat fikiran 等固定组合。释义对应 DBP 的 bulat tekad；不能把这个意义任意用于所有抽象名词。

collocations.en: have firmly made up one's mind

senses.zh_definition: 数值没有分数部分的；整的。
senses.en_definition: Whole or integral, with no fractional part.
senses.ms_definition: Bukan nombor pecahan.
senses.nuances: 用于 nombor bulat、angka bulat 等数值表达。nombor bulat 在马来西亚学校数学中通常指 0、1、2、3 等非负整数；涵盖负整数时通常使用 integer。这里不表示数字的字形呈圆形。

collocations.en: a figure with no fractional part

etymology.historical_story: Bulat links physical roundness with social unity in Malay proverbial language. The saying bulat air oleh pembuluh, bulat kata oleh muafakat connects water taking the shape of its channel with agreement taking shape through consultation. This provides a cultural bridge between a round object and an undivided decision, making expressions about collective agreement easier to remember. [DBP: bulat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=bulat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个没有缺口的圆：外形是 bulat，意见没有分裂是 bulat，决心不再摇摆也可用 bulat。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 加在 duka 前，表示处于悲伤状态；词根不变，前缀中的 e 读央元音 /ə/。

senses.zh_definition: 感到忧伤或悲痛，尤指因死亡、离别或重大损失而哀伤。
senses.en_definition: To feel sorrow or grief, especially following a death or serious loss.
senses.ms_definition: Bersusah atau bersedih hati; berdukacita.
senses.nuances: 是不及物动词，可单独使用，也见于 berduka hati。语气通常比日常的 sedih 庄重或带文学色彩，但不限定用于丧事。若说明原因，可用 berduka atas pemergian seseorang 或 berduka kerana kehilangan seseorang。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合吊唁、重大损失及庄重表达同情的场合。对宗教背景不明的人，采用中性的慰问语较妥；宗教专用祈祷语应符合对方信仰。避免以 Jangan berduka 简单否定对方的哀伤。

etymology.historical_story: Berduka combines the productive Malay prefix ber- with duka, historically connected with Sanskrit duḥkha, meaning pain or sorrow. The inherited emotional vocabulary remains visible in Malay expressions concerning grief. The prefix turns the base into a verb describing someone's sorrowful state; it does not itself add a specifically religious meaning. See [Maxwell's comparative account](https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/25604/pg25604-images.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: duka 是“悲伤”，ber- 表示“处于这种状态”：ber- + duka → 正在悲伤、心中哀痛。

morphology.pattern_note: 依数据包将直接基词记录为 balasan，其内部还可分析为 balas + -an。-nya 是后附成分，可表示第三人称领属或语境中已知的对象，并非单一固定的“他的”。词干末尾 n 保留，ny 表示 /ɲ/。音节据完整词形补全；数据包 Jawi بالسن 为 balasan，完整词形为 بالسنڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 他／她／其作出的回复；或上下文所指的那一回复、答复。
senses.en_definition: His, her, or its reply; the response referred to in context.
senses.ms_definition: Jawapan daripadanya atau jawapan kepada perkara yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 常见于短信、电邮和书信。-nya 的具体所指须由上下文确定，不能只译为“他的”。所给 balsam 是 balasan 的另一古语同形词释义，不是这里常用的“回复”义。现代义项依据：[DBP：balasan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=balasan)。

collocations.en: to wait for his or her reply
to receive his or her reply

senses.zh_definition: 对先前的帮助、赠与或行为所作的回报、答谢或相应回馈。
senses.en_definition: The return, repayment, or reciprocal act for a kindness, gift, or action.
senses.ms_definition: Pemberian atau perbuatan sebagai membalas kebaikan, pemberian atau perbuatan yang telah diterima.
senses.nuances: 强调有来有往的关系，不必是金钱，也不等于工资。sebagai balasannya 中，-nya 常回指前文所述的帮助或行为，整体可译为“作为回报”。

senses.zh_definition: 因某种行为而得到的奖赏、惩罚或报应；具体是善报还是恶果，由上下文决定。
senses.en_definition: The reward, punishment, or retribution resulting from an action.
senses.ms_definition: Ganjaran atau hukuman yang diterima kerana sesuatu perbuatan.
senses.nuances: 并非天然带贬义；善行可以获得 balasan，恶行也可以遭到 balasan。报复意图通常用 balas dendam 表达；不能把所有 balasannya 都理解成“复仇”。

collocations.zh: 得到相应的奖惩或报应
collocations.en: to receive the corresponding reward or punishment
to receive one's punishment or comeuppance

etymology.historical_story: Balasannya illustrates how Malay builds a network of meanings around responding. Balas supplies the idea of answering or returning an action; -an forms balasan, a reply or return; -nya links it to someone or something already understood. The same pattern connects correspondence, reciprocal kindness, and the moral consequences of conduct.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: balas 是“还回去”，-an 把它变成“回来的东西”，-nya 指向前文：消息回来是回复，善意回来是回报，恶行回来是报应。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根末尾的 /ŋ/ 保留，后接 /kan/，不发生鼻音替换。输入的 Jawi بيمبڠ 仅对应词根 bimbang；完整派生形式按构词写作 بيمبڠکن。无 meN- 的形式可用于祈使句、第一或第二人称被动结构，也见于口语。

senses.zh_definition: 担心某人或某事；对其可能出现的不良情况感到忧虑。
senses.en_definition: To worry about someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa bimbang tentang seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常见于 perkara yang saya bimbangkan（我所担心的事）等结构。与使动义须依句法和语境区分。本义马来文释义为编写性概括，并非输入资料中独立词条的官方原文；官方词根资料见 [DBP：bimbang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=bimbang)。

senses.zh_definition: 使某人产生担忧或不安。
senses.en_definition: To cause someone to feel worried or anxious.
senses.ms_definition: Menimbulkan rasa bimbang; merisaukan.
senses.nuances: 对应 membimbangkan 的使动义；bimbangkan 可出现于省略主动前缀的祈使结构。宾语若是人，可能与“担心某人”产生歧义，应补足语境。正式主动陈述通常使用 membimbangkan。释义依据 [DBP：bimbang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=bimbang)。

etymology.historical_story: Bimbangkan illustrates how Malay builds verbs from an emotional base. Bimbang names an anxious state, while related forms express causing anxiety or the anxiety itself. The suffix belongs to productive Malay grammar, so understanding this family is more useful than inventing a picturesque foreign origin. Its deeper historical ancestry is not established by the supplied evidence. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=bimbang).

word_family.gloss: 多具动物尸体；多处残骸

senses.zh_definition: 动物死后的躯体；动物尸体。
senses.en_definition: The dead body of an animal; a carcass.
senses.ms_definition: Tubuh haiwan yang telah mati.
senses.nuances: 普通动物尸体用语，不必已经腐烂；涉及肉类加工时，不宜将所有合规屠宰后的胴体都笼统称为 bangkai。义项依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》及《Kamus Pelajar》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=bangkai)。

senses.zh_definition: 人的尸体；带粗鄙、蔑视或贬损意味的称呼。
senses.en_definition: A human corpse, referred to crudely or contemptuously.
senses.ms_definition: Mayat manusia yang disebut dengan bahasa kasar atau menghina.
senses.nuances: DBP 标为 bk，即 bahasa kasar。可见于旧文学、敌对叙述或辱骂；现代中性报道宜用 mayat，表达敬意时依语境使用 jenazah 或 jasad。

senses.zh_definition: 破旧、毁坏或失去使用功能的物件，尤指车辆、船只等的残骸。
senses.en_definition: The wreck or unusable remains of a vehicle, vessel, or other object.
senses.ms_definition: Benda yang telah rosak teruk atau tinggal rangkanya sehingga tidak dapat digunakan lagi.
senses.nuances: 比喻物件如同失去生命的躯体。bangkai kapal 可指沉船残骸，不表示仍可正常航行的旧船。

senses.zh_definition: 用于 bangkai bernyawa：形容极度衰弱、消瘦无力，或遭人鄙弃、活得如同行尸走肉的人。
senses.en_definition: In bangkai bernyawa, a living person portrayed as severely wasted, powerless, or socially rejected.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan bangkai bernyawa, orang yang sangat kurus dan tidak bermaya atau dipandang hina serta tidak dipedulikan.
senses.nuances: 固定比喻，不是医学诊断。旧辞书也将其用于严重药物成瘾者；直接这样称呼病人或受困者会造成羞辱。

etymology.historical_story: Bangkai belongs to an inherited Austronesian vocabulary of death; Tagalog bangkay is a cognate meaning 'corpse'. Malay extends the image from dead animals to wrecked ships and ruined vehicles. Traditional proverbs also use a conspicuous carcass to represent wrongdoing that cannot be concealed. These are historical relationships and metaphors, not a modern affix analysis. [Etymological reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/bangkai).

etymology.historical_story: Bertunang is formed from tunang, a prospective spouse, with the Malay prefix ber-. Its cultural setting is the promise of marriage: an engagement may bring two families together before the wedding itself. The word therefore describes both making that promise and living within it. Ceremony size and particular customs vary between families and communities.

etymology.historical_story: Butch developed in English before appearing in multilingual conversations elsewhere. Oxford dates the modern adjective to the 1940s and suggests, cautiously, a shortening of butcher. Its associations with masculinity also became important in lesbian identities. These developments explain its social meanings, but do not establish when it entered Malaysian usage. [Source: Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/butch).

etymology.historical_story: Buktinya combines the established Malay noun bukti, meaning evidence, with the attached form -nya. DBP illustrates bukti through courtroom evidence and a letter documenting a loan. These settings connect the word with substantiation. In discourse, buktinya can introduce a supporting fact without naming a separate owner of that evidence. [DBP: bukti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=bukti)

etymology.historical_story: Bagasi belongs to the European baggage vocabulary that entered the region through contact and transport. An Indonesian government loanword inventory records the pairing bagage–bagasi. Its dictionary meanings preserve several transport settings: the goods carried, the railway wagon carrying them, and the vehicle space holding them. These meanings provide a useful cultural picture without establishing a precise borrowing route into Malaysian Malay. [Loanword inventory](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/4383/1/Senarai%20Kata%20Serapan%20Dalam%20Bahasa%20Indonesia%201995.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Buih connects an everyday sight, clusters of bubbles, with Malay proverbial imagination. The proverb supplied in the packet pictures someone crossing water by stepping on foam, an apparently impossible task used to evoke determined effort. This is evidence of cultural imagery, not proof of the word's ultimate origin, which the supplied materials do not establish.

etymology.historical_story: Berdamai is transparently formed from ber- and damai. Its dictionary meanings connect repairing relationships with reaching agreement through discussion. The same verb can therefore describe reconciliation after conflict or negotiation over practical matters such as rent. This account explains its Malay word formation and cultural range; it does not claim an unverified ultimate origin for damai.

etymology.historical_story: Berjuta combines the Malay prefix ber- with juta, meaning one million. Historical linguistic research traces juta to Sanskrit ayuta, whose numerical value was ten thousand. The changed value shows why a borrowed number word cannot always be interpreted through its source language. Modern Malay uses berjuta and berjuta-juta for quantities in the millions. Sources: [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/formsets/30703), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=berjuta).

etymology.historical_story: Biola is generally traced to Portuguese viola, reflecting musical contact between European and Malay-speaking communities. The instrument acquired local lives rather than remaining exclusively orchestral: research in Sabah describes both three-stringed and four-stringed traditions. This history helps explain why one familiar name can cover instruments with different shapes, playing positions and musical roles. [Research on Sabah biola traditions](https://sare.um.edu.my/index.php/MJPVA/article/view/47225) [Historical discussion of the name](https://www.icm.gov.mo/rc/viewer/30026/1846)

etymology.historical_story: Berganda is transparently formed within Malay from ber- and ganda. Its word family connects everyday descriptions of increasing harvests or workloads with the mathematical language of multiples. The contrast is useful: berganda describes an increase occurring, while menggandakan describes causing it. No specific ancient source language is asserted here for the root ganda.

etymology.historical_story: An isolated spelling can hide several unrelated histories. Bellas appears in proper names, including a footwear brand whose own account describes a business founded in 2018. That particular history cannot identify this corpus token. Without its original sentence, assigning a foreign-language derivation, a personal-name origin or a Malay spelling correction would create a story unsupported by the packet. [Brand account](https://bellas-vienna.at/en/pages/uber-uns)

senses.zh_definition: 串联的；按先后次序逐项连接、传输或处理的。

senses.ms_definition: Disambungkan secara sederet atau dihantar dan diproses satu demi satu.

etymology.historical_story: Bersiri combines siri with the productive Malay prefix ber-. Its cultural setting extends beyond television: DBP records the Malay novel Iakah Salmah? as appearing in seven volumes between December 1928 and September 1929. Reading a story in successive installments thus belongs to an established publishing tradition, giving the modern phrase drama bersiri a recognizable cultural predecessor. [DBP encyclopedia](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=bersiri)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: siri 想成 series，ber- 表示具有这种形式：bersiri 就是一集接一集、一项接一项。

morphology.pattern_note: 开头 ber- 是词根的一部分，不是前缀。meN- 在 b 前变为 mem-，保留 b，形成 memberkas。

senses.zh_definition: 捆；束；叠；捆扎或归拢在一起的一组物品，如柴火、细棍或信件。

senses.ms_definition: Ikatan atau susunan benda seperti kayu api, lidi dan surat.
senses.nuances: 可作计量单位，如 dua berkas kayu api。逮捕义通常由派生词 memberkas 表达，不应把它直接当作此名词义。马来西亚电脑文件通常称 fail。参见 [DBP：berkas](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=berkas)。

senses.zh_definition: 【植物学】束；由多条输导组织组成的集合，尤指植物的维管束。
senses.en_definition: A bundle of conducting tissues in a plant, especially a vascular bundle.
senses.ms_definition: Gabungan tisu pengangkut dalam tumbuhan, khususnya xilem dan floem dalam berkas vaskular.
senses.nuances: 这是“聚合成束”的专业应用。berkas pembuluh 与 berkas vaskular 均用于相关植物学概念。参见 [DBP 植物学术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=berkas)。

senses.zh_definition: 【同形异义词，鱼名】鲹类海鱼的地方名称，亦称 cupak；词典列举六带鲹和浪人鲹。
senses.en_definition: A vernacular name for certain marine trevallies, also called cupak.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis ikan laut yang juga disebut cupak; kamus menyenaraikan Caranx sexfasciatus dan Caranx ignobilis.
senses.nuances: 属于独立的 berkas II，不应从“捆束”义推导，也不适用上述派生词族。该义较专门；以下为自然组合示例，未核实为高频固定搭配。参见 [Kamus Dewan 的 berkas II 条目](https://iqwiens.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/01/kamus-dewan.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: For the bundle sense, a useful cultural image is firewood or palm ribs tied together for carrying. The related verb memberkas covers both binding objects and apprehending people, connecting restraint with capture. This explains the word family's meaning, rather than proving a historical origin. The separate fish name is a homonym and needs its own memory.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berkas 想成“把几根柴捆成一束”；memberkas 再联想到把人控制住、拘捕。开头 ber 不能拆掉。

morphology.pattern_note: 上述词根标签和零词缀公式仅沿用词包的整词索引记录；实际语言构成为 baru + -nya → barunya，并非不可再分的词根。-nya 是后附成分，常作第三人称领属标记；拼接时不发生音变，ny 读作 [ɲ]。其功能参见：[DBP：-nya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tatabahasa+nya)。

senses.zh_definition: 新的；尚未使用或使用不久的。在名词短语中，后附的 -nya 通常表示该事物属于他、她或前文所指的人。
senses.en_definition: New or recently acquired or used, with attached -nya commonly marking a third-person possessor of the noun phrase.
senses.ms_definition: Belum digunakan atau belum lama digunakan; dalam frasa nama, bentuk baru yang diikuti -nya lazimnya menerangkan sesuatu yang dimiliki oleh orang ketiga.
senses.nuances: 如 kereta barunya 是“他／她的新车”，-nya 的领属范围是整个名词短语，不能把 barunya 固定译成独立的“他的新东西”。此处马来语释义根据 baru 和 -nya 的功能整合，并非词包提供的独立词条原文。DBP 的用例确有 kereta barunya：[DBP：baru 与 baharu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=beg+tangan)。

etymology.historical_story: Barunya illustrates how Malay packages reference into a written word. Baru supplies the meaning new, while attached -nya can identify a previously mentioned possessor. In kereta barunya, the result means his or her new car. Baru also has the variant baharu. This account explains the present construction without assigning an unsupported date or separate historical origin to barunya.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看 baru“新”，再找 -nya“谁的”：kereta barunya 就是“他／她的新车”。

morphology.pattern_note: 加 -an 时保留词根全部字母，末尾 h 成为下一音节的声母：ban.tah → ban.ta.han。主要形成表示异议或反对表达的名词，另保留词典所录的性情形容词义。

senses.nuances: 强度可从会议中的程序性异议到公开抗议，须依语境判断；不必然指上街示威。通常说 bantahan terhadap sesuatu。词典同时收录较少见的形容词义，参见 [DBP PRPM：bantahan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=bantahan)。

etymology.historical_story: Bantahan illustrates Malay’s productive use of -an to turn a root into a noun naming an expression or result. From bantah, the word gives disagreement a form that can be stated, written and submitted. Its dictionary also preserves an adjectival use describing someone prone to arguing, a reminder that identical forms can perform different grammatical jobs.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bantah＝反对，接上 -an 想成一份可以递交的异议书：bantahan 就是说出来或写下来的反对意见。
