etymology.historical_story: One well-attested place-name explanation connects Brandon with a hill where broom grows. Suffolk’s heritage record gives this meaning for its Brandon. English surnames and personal names also bear the spelling, but a particular person’s name does not establish their ancestry. In Malay writing, the useful distinction is grammatical: Brandon identifies someone or somewhere rather than describing an everyday object. [Place-name evidence](https://heritage.suffolk.gov.uk/media/pdfs/brandon.pdf), [surname history](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/brandon).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Brandon 当作通讯录里的一整个名字记；首字母大写，先认人或地点，不拆成马来语词根。

etymology.historical_story: Bayinya illustrates how Malay builds a personal reference without creating a new dictionary root. Bayi names the infant, while attached -nya identifies whose baby is meant. The same grammatical device works with many everyday nouns. This entry explains that transparent formation; the packet does not establish the deeper historical origin of bayi. [DBP: -nya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kamu+nya)

etymology.historical_story: Begitukah combines an established Malay expression for that manner or degree with the question particle -kah. The contrast is easy to hear: begitu presents something as so, while begitukah asks whether it is so. This small addition lets a speaker turn an observation into a request for confirmation without changing the base word.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: begitu＝那样，-kah＝疑问开关：begitukah? 就是把那样变成是那样吗？

etymology.historical_story: Berkuda is transparently formed from ber- and kuda, the Malay word for horse. Its dictionary meanings connect having a horse with riding one. The same formation remains useful across settings: a pasukan berkuda is a mounted unit, while sukan berkuda refers to equestrian sport. The horse supplies the shared image. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=kuda+I)

etymology.historical_story: The image behind bersemuka is the ordinary human face, muka. Malay builds an expression for direct encounter around that concrete image. In contemporary Malaysian education and administration, the word also distinguishes physical attendance from online participation. A meeting described this way therefore promises personal presence, while its purpose may be cooperation, explanation, or confrontation.

etymology.historical_story: Berpengaruh combines pengaruh, meaning influence, with ber-, expressing possession of that quality. The dictionary illustrates its reach through both personal power and the continuing influence of traditional literature and visual art. This makes the word useful beyond politics: authority may come from wealth or position, while cultural influence can endure through ideas and artistic forms. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=pengaruh)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ber- 表示“有”，pengaruh 是“影响力”：berpengaruh＝有影响力；terpengaruh＝被影响。把主动拥有与被动受到分开记。

etymology.historical_story: Bersifat combines the productive Malay prefix ber- with sifat, an Arabic-derived noun referring to a quality or attribute. The resulting verb expresses possession of a characteristic. This makes it useful across descriptions of personality, materials, policies, and ideas. Its structure shows how a borrowed noun can become fully integrated into ordinary Malay word formation without retaining foreign grammatical patterns.

etymology.historical_story: The root sekolah comes from Portuguese escola, reflecting a history of contact between Malay and Portuguese speakers. Malay then combines this borrowed noun with its own productive prefix ber-. The result illustrates how an imported word becomes part of local grammar: a word naming an institution also supplies a verb for attending it. Source: [UNESCO-hosted linguistic paper](https://en.unesco.org/silkroad/sites/default/files/knowledge-bank-article/portuguese_words_in_the_malay_language.pdf).

headword.editorial_note: 输入的 برت 是词根 berat 的 Jawi；完整词形须加 ڽ，写作 برتڽ。音节切分可分析为 be.rat.nya，但输入未提供，故 syllables 保留 null。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根不发生音变；ny 表示单一腭鼻音 /ɲ/。按本模式将 -nya 归入 suffix，但它可承担代词附着、名词化或强调功能，并非所有用法都是普通派生后缀。[DBP：-nya 的功能](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pascakata)；[DBP：-nya 的 Jawi 写法](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=bagi+nya)。

etymology.historical_story: Beratnya is transparently formed from berat and -nya, rather than being a separate historical root. Its meaning changes with the sentence: a measured weight, the burden of responsibility, or an exclamation of heaviness. Malay also connects physical and shared social burdens in the proverb berat sama dipikul, ringan sama dijinjing, encouraging people to carry difficulties together.

etymology.historical_story: Bayang connects visible shadows with reflected and imagined images. Malay figurative usage builds on that connection: takutkan bayang sendiri turns one's own shadow into an image of fear. Related membayangkan describes forming a mental picture or suggesting something indirectly. These links offer a cultural memory path without requiring a speculative ancient derivation. [Kamus Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=bayang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 bayang，想一束光照出影子；影子映到水里成为倒影，留在脑海里成为印象。

etymology.historical_story: Broker illustrates how Malay accommodates vocabulary associated with international commerce. DBP lists it among loanword examples that retain the initial consonant cluster br-. The word also participates in Malay word formation: pembrokeran names brokerage activity. Its stock, insurance, and land combinations show how one occupational label serves several distinct trading settings. [DBP terminology guidelines](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/umum_istilah.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Baldi is generally traced to Portuguese balde, meaning bucket. It belongs to a wider history of vocabulary exchanged around maritime Asia, where related bucket words occur in several languages. A dictionary of Kristang, the Portuguese creole associated with Malacca, also records baldi. That parallel illustrates the contact setting, although it does not establish the exact route into Malay. [Loanword study](https://irgu.unigoa.ac.in/drs/bitstream/handle/unigoa/3681/sardesai_m_2006.pdf?sequence=1); [Kristang dictionary](https://openresearch-repository.anu.edu.au/server/api/core/bitstreams/b9f4de02-19d2-4b1d-b643-5db3308f9ef9/content).

etymology.historical_story: Bajirao enters Malay discourse as an Indian personal name, not as a Malay derivation. Historical writing connects Bajirao I with Maratha leadership and the rise of Pune. The name also appears in descriptions of Shaniwar Wada and its equestrian statue. These associations explain its cultural visibility, but they do not establish an etymological meaning for the personal name itself. [Pune government heritage account](https://pune.gov.in/en/tourist-place/shaniwarwada/)

etymology.historical_story: English borrowed belle from French, where it is the feminine form of beau, meaning beautiful. Merriam-Webster records English use from 1622. In English, the word became a noun for an admired woman, familiar in belle of the ball. This history explains the English sense, but does not establish a Malay borrowing. [Merriam-Webster: belle](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/belle)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: belle 读 /bɛl/，可借英语 bell 的同音联想：舞会钟声响起，佳人成为焦点；这只是记忆联想，不是词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代构词中按完整词基处理，不把 bia- 当作词缀；加 ber- 构成 berbiasiswa，表示拥有奖学金。

senses.zh_definition: 奖学金；发给学生、用于支付或补助其学习费用的资助款项。
senses.en_definition: A scholarship: money awarded to a student to cover or help cover educational expenses.
senses.ms_definition: Wang yang diberikan kepada pelajar untuk membiayai atau membantu membiayai pelajarannya, biasanya di maktab atau di universiti.
senses.nuances: 既可译为奖学金，也可按具体项目译为助学性质的奖学金；不能仅凭词本身断定只奖励成绩优秀者，或必定涵盖全部费用。与须偿还的 pinjaman pelajaran 应按项目性质区分。马来语释义依据输入包及 [DBP 词条 biasiswa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=234664&keyword=biasiswa)。

etymology.historical_story: In Malaysian educational life, biasiswa names financial support that can open a route to further study. DBP's encyclopedic account describes awards connected with achievement, ability, or financial need, so the word carries both recognition and opportunity. This cultural history helps explain its importance to students and families; the consulted entry does not establish the word's exact formation or first use. [DBP encyclopedia](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=biasiswa).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用语义联想记：想到学生 siswa 的学习费用 mendapat bantuan，便想到 biasiswa；这是记忆提示，不是已核实的词源拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接词首 s 时保留原形，不发生鼻音同化；ber- 中的 e 读 /ə/，词尾 ai 为双元音 /ai̯/。此处词根是表示散开的 surai II。

senses.zh_definition: 聚集的人群散开，分别离去或各自返回原处；解散。
senses.en_definition: To disperse or separate and go one's own way, especially after a gathering.
senses.ms_definition: Berpisah-pisah, bercerai-cerai.
senses.nuances: 不及物动词，主语通常是参与者、人群或队伍；强调聚集状态结束后各自离去。使别人散开用 menyuraikan。活动流程末尾的 Bersurai 表示散会离场，不表示永久解散组织。DBP 将此义列在 surai II 下，应与“鬃毛”的 surai I 区分：[DBP：surai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=surai)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公共活动 / 主持人结束通知
dual_scenarios.ms: Para peserta diminta bersurai secara teratur setelah majlis tamat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 活动结束后，请各位参与者有序离场。
dual_scenarios.en: Participants are requested to disperse in an orderly manner after the event.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dah habis dah. Jom bersurai, esok jumpa lagi!

dual_scenarios.zh: 结束啦。散了吧，明天再见！
dual_scenarios.en: It's over. Let's head off. See you tomorrow!

jom 对应 mari 或 marilah，邀请大家一起行动。
bersurai 用在朋友之间可带有主持活动般的轻松语气；日常也常说 balik。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 主持人可说 Terima kasih atas kehadiran anda. Para hadirin dipersilakan bersurai.，先致谢再请大家离场。直接喊 Bersurai! 带有命令语气，适合明确的指挥场景。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 常用于集会、典礼、会议结束后的人员离散。描述一般会议结束也可用 mesyuarat tamat；描述组织被正式撤销通常用 dibubarkan。朋友间使用 bersurai 可能显得略正式或带有玩笑意味。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 主持人可说 Terima kasih atas kehadiran anda. Para hadirin dipersilakan bersurai.，先致谢再请大家离场。直接喊 Bersurai! 带有命令语气，适合明确的指挥场景。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 常用于集会、典礼、会议结束后的人员离散。描述一般会议结束也可用 mesyuarat tamat；描述组织被正式撤销通常用 dibubarkan。朋友间使用 bersurai 可能显得略正式或带有玩笑意味。

etymology.historical_story: Bersurai combines ber- with the dispersal root listed by DBP as surai II. The dictionary illustrates people leaving a gathering and returning to their respective places. Its separate entry for surai meaning a mane matters: identical spelling does not establish a shared origin, so the dispersal meaning should be learned independently. [DBP reference](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=surai).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 ber-su-rai，就想象礼堂里的人从一群变成各走各的：bersurai＝大家散开；menyuraikan＝使大家散开。

metadata.notes: 未取得 DBP 或权威词典公开释义

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着于前词的强调语气小品词，不是派生词缀；本格式以 suffix 表示其后附位置。词根不发生音变。输入 jawi 仅记录 bantu 的 بنتو，未包含 -lah。

senses.zh_definition: 帮一帮；请帮助。动词 bantu 加上 -lah，构成劝请、请求或强调性的祈使表达。
senses.en_definition: Do help; please help, with an urging or emphatic particle.
senses.ms_definition: Berilah pertolongan atau sokongan; bentuk suruhan atau permintaan daripada bantu yang disertai partikel penegas -lah.
senses.nuances: 帮助的核心意义来自 bantu；-lah 调节话语力度，不表示已经完成。语调温和时可显得恳切，语调急促时也可能带催促或不耐烦，不能机械等同于英语 please。

dual_scenarios.en: Help flood victims by donating through trusted organizations.

-lah 连写于 bantu 后，语气取决于上下文和语调。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 向长辈、上司或陌生人求助时，单说 bantulah 可能显得催促；可用 Bolehkah tuan/puan membantu saya?，并说明所需帮助。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合公益呼吁、熟人求助和鼓励他人施援。不要认为加了 -lah 就必然礼貌；语调、称呼及请求的负担同样重要。

etymology.historical_story: Bantulah combines bantu, 'help', with the Malay particle -lah. Its cultural interest lies in how a short attachment shapes an appeal: a request can sound encouraging, earnest, or insistent depending on delivery. Malay spelling joins this particle to its host. DBP distinguishes such particles from affixes that create derived words. No earlier origin for bantu is established here. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=partikel).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bantu＝帮助；尾巴加 lah，像把手伸出来说：“帮一帮吧！”记住它增加语气，不增加新的动作意义。

morphology.pattern_note: 前缀 ber- 与 tiup 直接结合，词根起首的 t 保留，不发生鼻音同化；此处构成不及物动词。前缀中的 e 读 /ə/。

word_family.gloss: 吹拂；吹出的气流或声音

senses.zh_definition: （风、空气）吹动，流动，吹拂。
senses.en_definition: Of wind or air, to blow or flow.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak (angin), berhembus, mengalir.
senses.nuances: 最常见义，通常以 angin 为主语，是不及物用法。表示人吹蜡烛、吹气球或吹奏乐器时，通常使用 meniup，并接宾语。bertiup 本身不限定风力，可搭配 sepoi-sepoi、kencang 等成分。

senses.zh_definition: （传闻、消息等）传播，流传，传开。
senses.en_definition: Of rumours or news, to circulate or spread.
senses.ms_definition: Merebak (khabar angin), tersebar (berita).
senses.nuances: 比喻义，将消息的传播描绘成风的流动，常见于新闻、评论和叙述。与 khabar angin 连用时表示传闻流传，并不确认内容属实；与 berita 连用时，也不能仅凭 bertiup 判断消息真伪。

senses.zh_definition: （米南加保方言）聚拢，围聚。
senses.en_definition: In Minangkabau usage, to gather in a crowd or cluster together.
senses.ms_definition: Berkerumun.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》标注 Mn，表示米南加保用法，并非当代马来西亚通用口语中的常用义。普通交流宜用 berkerumun。以下为方言义的词组示例，不应视为通用高频搭配。义项及标签见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=bertiup)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Angin kencang dijangka bertiup di kawasan pantai petang ini, dan orang ramai dinasihatkan supaya menangguhkan aktiviti di laut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 预计今天下午沿海地区将刮起强风，公众受劝推迟海上活动。
dual_scenarios.en: Strong winds are expected along the coast this afternoon, and the public is advised to postpone activities at sea.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Angin dah bertiup kuat kat pantai ni, jom balik je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Angin sudah bertiup kuat di pantai ini. Marilah kita pulang sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这海边风已经很大了，咱们还是回去吧。
dual_scenarios.en: The wind's picked up here at the beach. Let's just head home.
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式，表示已经。
kat 在这里相当于标准语的 di，表示地点。
ni 是 ini 的口语缩略形式。
jom 用于亲近关系中的共同提议。
je 相当于 sahaja，在这里表达干脆如此的语气。

messages.ms_spoken: Angin dah bertiup kuat kat pantai ni. Nak balik sekarang?
messages.ms_standard: Angin sudah bertiup kuat di pantai ini. Adakah kamu mahu pulang sekarang?

messages.en: The wind's getting strong here at the beach. Want to head home now?

messages.zh: 走吧，回去算了。我都觉得冷了。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: bertiup 本身语体中性，可用于天气报道、工作交流和日常聊天。与长辈、客户或上级交流时，可使用完整形式 sudah、di、ini；例句中的 aku 更适合熟悉的同辈。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈天气时可自然使用。谈及他人私事或职场传闻时，khabar angin bertiup 表示消息正在流传，不代表得到证实；正式汇报宜交代消息来源和核实情况。米南加保的“围聚”义适合方言或文学语境，通用交流使用 berkerumun 更清楚。

etymology.historical_story: Bertiup combines the Malay prefix ber- with tiup, the root associated with blowing. Its imagery reaches beyond moving air: news and rumours can also travel like wind. Malay pantun likewise use blowing wind as a scene-setting image, linking the natural world with human feelings. These documented uses offer a cultural memory bridge without requiring a speculative story about the word’s earliest origin. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=bertiup)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 tiup，就想象嘴唇轻轻吹出一股气；加上 ber-，把画面换成风自己吹起来：angin bertiup。消息像风一样传开，也可以 bertiup。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语来源的整词口语借用，无马来语词缀。按要求保留输入音节字段 sst，但该值有误；best 通常为一个音节。词尾 /t/ 在部分口语发音中弱化。

senses.zh_definition: 很棒的；令人愉快、觉得好玩或满意的。
senses.en_definition: Very good, enjoyable, or pleasing.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa percakapan, sangat bagus, menyeronokkan atau menyenangkan.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚口语中的英语借用，常表达主观赞赏，不一定具有英语最高级“最好的”之义；paling best 才明确表达比较中的最高程度。输入未提供 DBP 释义，本条马来语释义为编辑概括；status 按指定格式保留，不表示已核实为规范马来语词目。马来西亚网络语言研究将 best 列为情感评价词。[马来西亚国民大学研究](https://www.ftsm.ukm.my/ethesis/file/article/NORLELA%20SAMSUDIN.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: English supplies the form best, but Malaysian conversational usage gives it a broader everyday role. A film, meal, outing or experience can simply be best: enjoyable or excellent, without a comparison being intended. Malaysian research on online mixed-language messages records best among words used to express opinions and sentiment. [UKM research](https://www.ftsm.ukm.my/ethesis/file/article/NORLELA%20SAMSUDIN.pdf)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 best，先记朋友竖起拇指说“真棒！”；只有出现比较语境时，才往“最好”理解。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留数据包的直接词基 biarkan；更底层词根是 biar。-kan 构成及物动词，-lah 是后附强调或缓和祈使语气的助词，并非派生后缀；这里按字段位置归入 suffix。拼接时没有音位替换。

senses.zh_definition: 让……吧；准许某人做某事，不加阻止。
senses.en_definition: Let or allow someone to do something.
senses.ms_definition: Izinkan seseorang melakukan sesuatu tanpa menghalangnya.
senses.nuances: 常用于祈使句，后接人及其动作。-lah 可以缓和请求，也可以加强坚持，实际语气取决于语调。词义依据 membiarkan，释义按本词的祈使用法改写。[DBP：biar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=biar)

senses.zh_definition: 任其保持原状吧；别去干预、理会或打扰。
senses.en_definition: Leave someone or something alone or unchanged.
senses.ms_definition: Jangan ganggu atau ubah; tinggalkan dalam keadaan sedia ada.
senses.nuances: 既可表示有意保留原状，也可表示不再理会。独立说 Biarkanlah 可以相当于“算了，随它去吧”；用于他人的困难时可能显得冷淡。[DBP：biar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=biar)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -lah 不自动保证礼貌。对上司或长辈提出建议时，可说 Pada pandangan saya, elok kita biarkan beliau berehat dahulu，以建议句式表达尊重。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合劝人给予空间、等待或停止干预。面对求助、欺凌或安全问题时，单说 Biarkanlah 容易被理解为漠不关心。

etymology.historical_story: Biarkanlah illustrates how Malay builds an instruction in layers: biar supplies the idea of allowing, -kan forms the verb, and -lah shapes its force in conversation. DBP describes -lah as an attached particle that can soften an imperative. Its familiar conversational sound therefore also belongs to standard Malay grammar. [DBP：-lah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: biar＝让，-kan＝把动作指向对象，-lah＝加上语气：biarkanlah dia → 让他吧。

morphology.pattern_note: 首音节 e 为 e taling /e/，不是 /ə/；所列读音的末尾 a 实现为 /ə/。加 ber- 成 berbeza；加 meN-…-kan 成 membezakan，b 保留。

senses.zh_definition: 差别；差异；两个或多个事物在性质、特征或状态上的不同。
senses.en_definition: A difference or dissimilarity between things.
senses.ms_definition: Kelainan atau ketidaksamaan sifat, keadaan atau ciri antara sesuatu dengan yang lain.
senses.nuances: beza 表示“差别”，perbezaan 是常见的相关名词形式。表示“不同于……”时，正式表达通常用 berbeza daripada…。Apa beza…? 是自然口语。见 [DBP 马来语词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=beza)。

senses.zh_definition: 差额；差值；年龄、价格、尺寸或数量等可比较数值之间的差距。
senses.en_definition: The numerical difference between comparable amounts or measurements.
senses.ms_definition: Selisih antara dua nilai, ukuran, jumlah atau kuantiti yang dibandingkan.
senses.nuances: 本义项强调可量化的差距。beza harga 指价格差额，beza umur 指年龄差距；数学中具体采用有符号差还是差的绝对值，须看题目规定。见 [DBP 马来语词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=beza)。

etymology.historical_story: Beza belongs to Malay's Sanskrit-derived vocabulary and is associated with Sanskrit bheda, meaning distinction or difference. Its everyday use shows how an older borrowing can become an ordinary Malay root, taking familiar forms such as berbeza and perbezaan. Malaysian standard spelling uses beza, while Indonesian commonly uses beda. See [UiTM's discussion of Sanskrit loans](https://ir.uitm.edu.my/id/eprint/101300/1/101300.pdf) and [DBP spelling guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=beda).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 beza 的 /be/ 联想成“别”：有分别，就有 beza。只是记忆联想，并非词源。

senses.en_definition: Provisionally, to have or carry a gene, inferred from ber- + gen; not verified as an independently recorded dictionary sense.
senses.ms_definition: Secara tafsiran pembentukan kata, mempunyai atau membawa gen; takrif khusus bagi bentuk bergen belum dapat disahkan dalam sumber DBP yang dirujuk.

etymology.historical_story: The historical anchor is gen, rather than a separately established history for bergen. Danish botanist Wilhelm Johannsen coined the international scientific term gene in 1909 to name units of heredity. Malay uses gen for that concept. Adding ber- would express possession through Malay morphology, but that analysis alone does not establish bergen as an attested dictionary headword. [NHGRI history of gene](https://www.genome.gov/25520244/online-education-kit-1909-the-word-gene-coined)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 gen＝基因，再用 ber- 的“具有”义理解候选形式 bergen＝具有基因；实际表达优先记清楚的 mempunyai gen。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合描述实际争吵或打斗；不要把正常意见交流轻率称为 berkelahi。正式记录应进一步说明是言语争执还是肢体冲突。

etymology.historical_story: Berkelahi belongs to the family of kelahi, the base recorded by DBP for quarrelling and fighting. Malay proverbial tradition preserves a telling observation: people may remember their silat skills only after a quarrel has ended. The saying turns conflict into a lesson about belated wisdom, showing how this everyday word also carries practical cultural reflection. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=kelahi)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ber- + kelahi 连成“发生争斗”：嘴上争是 berkelahi，动手打也可能是 berkelahi；是否动手看上下文。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着代词，此处按后缀位置归类；词根不变，ny 表示 /ɲ/。数据包中的 Jawi 为词根 bawah 的拼写，未包含 -nya；完整词形为 باوهڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 在等级、职权或数值上低于所指对象的位置；常见于 di bawahnya。

etymology.historical_story: Malay uses bawah to organize physical space, from the underside of a table to the area beneath a raised house. The same spatial image extends to rank and supervision. Adding the attached pronoun -nya makes the reference contextual: the lower part of something already mentioned, or the people under someone's authority. This explains the form without requiring a separate borrowed origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bawah 想成“下方”，把 -nya 想成回指箭头：bawah + nya，就是“它的下部／它下面”。

morphology.pattern_note: 直接加 -kan，词根末尾的 ng /ŋ/ 保留。常用于请求、命令及第一、第二人称被动结构；对应主动形式为 membuangkan，-kan 可表示替别人做。资料包的 Jawi 为词根拼写；完整形式为 بواڠکن。

etymology.historical_story: Buangkan illustrates a familiar Malay way of turning an action into a favour. The base buang names removal or disposal, while -kan can direct that action towards another person's benefit. In household requests, the resulting form naturally accompanies tolong. Its story lies in productive Malay grammar rather than a separate borrowed origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 buang＝丢掉，再把 -kan 想成把这件事交给对方做：Tolong buangkan＝请帮忙丢掉。

etymology.historical_story: Bunuhnya combines a verb with an attached pronoun, a compact pattern familiar in Malay writing. Its literary use is visible in Norry Ahmy's Malaysian short-story collection Jangan bunuhnya, mak, published in 1985. The title shows how a prohibition can carry its object inside the verb form while leaving the person's identity to context. [Bibliographic record](https://ci.nii.ac.jp/ncid/BB0476364X)

etymology.historical_story: The root gambar belonged to Malay visual culture before photography: early dictionaries recorded its use for pictures and crafted representations. Bergambar combines this root with ber-. Its modern meanings bring illustrated objects and photographic activities together, so the same word can describe a picture book or friends posing together for a camera. [Historical study](https://penerbit.aswara.edu.my/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2289-5051_iJACH_Vol-11_Jun-2024.pdf); [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=378040&keyword=bergambar).

etymology.historical_story: Berkurang illustrates a useful Malay contrast between a change happening and somebody causing that change. Kurang supplies the idea of less; ber- forms a verb describing becoming less. Its dictionary meanings include both diminishing quantities and improving illness. The related mengurangkan supplies the causative counterpart, allowing speakers to distinguish falling costs from deliberately cutting costs.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kurang 是“少”，berkurang 是“变少”；东西自己变少用 berkurang，使它变少用 mengurangkan。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合个人写作、专业分享和机构资讯发布。分享他人的博客内容时注明作者与出处；官方博客与个人博客应明确区分。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: blog 本身语体中性，可用于正式机构沟通；与长辈或客户交流时，使用 saya、tuan 或 puan 等适当称呼。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合个人写作、专业分享和机构资讯发布。分享他人的博客内容时注明作者与出处；官方博客与个人博客应明确区分。

etymology.historical_story: Blog entered Malay as an English technology term. English blog is a shortening of weblog, combining web with log, a record of events. The name preserves the idea of keeping a journal online, although blogs also carry professional commentary and institutional information. Malaysian public-sector guidance describes their characteristic newest-first arrangement. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/blog); [Malaysian government guidance](https://www.planmalaysia.gov.my/uploads/content-downloads/file_20251114230316.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 blog 联想成一本不断更新的网络记录本：打开页面，最新一篇就在最上面。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆；ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/，不读成 /nɡ/。本词没有需要拆分的现代马来语词缀。

word_family.gloss: 他／她的棚屋；所指的棚屋

senses.zh_definition: 用于储物、作业等的长形简易棚屋或棚舍，通常结构简单，可无围墙。
senses.en_definition: A long, simply constructed shed used for storage, work, or shelter.
senses.ms_definition: Rumah panjang untuk gudang dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 现代常见义。重点是简易棚舍及其用途，并非所有仓库都叫 bangsal，也不专指婆罗洲的传统长屋。参见 [DBP：bangsal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=bangsal)。

senses.zh_definition: 市场等处供人交易或活动的长形有顶棚场所。
senses.en_definition: A long roofed shelter, especially one used in a market.
senses.ms_definition: Tempat panjang yang beratap, seperti di pasar.
senses.nuances: 强调覆盖较长空间的屋顶，可容纳多个摊位；不等同于单个摊位 gerai。

senses.zh_definition: 供军人、工人等集体住宿的营房或长形宿舍。
senses.en_definition: A barracks building or communal accommodation block.
senses.ms_definition: Berek.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录义；理解须依赖军营、劳工住宿等上下文。现代需要明确表达营房时，berek 通常更直接。以下搭配用于说明此义，不表示该义在当代高频。

senses.zh_definition: 爪哇语背景中，宫廷内的厅堂或殿阁。
senses.en_definition: A hall or pavilion in a palace, in Javanese usage.
senses.ms_definition: Balai di istana.
senses.nuances: DBP 标注 Jw，即爪哇语用法；属于地域、历史文化语境。不能据此把普通马来西亚宫殿厅堂一律称为 bangsal。以下为语境搭配。

collocations.en: a pavilion in a Javanese royal palace

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合农业、仓储、乡村建筑和市场语境。谈论爪哇宫廷建筑时，应依当地名称和历史语境理解其厅堂义。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 本词本身中性。描述别人的住宅时，应确认确实是棚舍；随意把正式住宅称为 bangsal，可能显得贬低居住条件。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合农业、仓储、乡村建筑和市场语境。谈论爪哇宫廷建筑时，应依当地名称和历史语境理解其厅堂义。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary preserves several architectural worlds inside bangsal: a storage building, a covered market space, barracks, and a palace hall marked as Javanese usage. These meanings offer a cultural picture of long, sheltered spaces serving different communities. The Javanese label identifies a particular usage; by itself, it does not establish the word's ultimate origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=bangsal)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bang.sal 的两拍连成画面：长长一排屋顶，下面放工具、避雨——bangsal，棚舍。ng 要连读成 /ŋ/。

morphology.pattern_note: 包内 root_word 保留整词 berjangkit；真正词根为 jangkit（جاڠکيت），因此 is_root 为 false。ber- 接在 j 前保持原形，词根不发生辅音脱落；所得动词通常不直接带宾语。

senses.zh_definition: 疾病传播、传染；从一个人或宿主扩散至另一个。
senses.en_definition: Of a disease or infection, to spread or be transmitted.
senses.ms_definition: Menular antara individu atau merebak ke tempat lain, berkenaan penyakit.
senses.nuances: 主语通常是疾病或感染。penyakit berjangkit 可译为“传染病”；说某人受到感染通常用 dijangkiti 或 terjangkit。义项参照 [DBP：berjangkit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=berjangkit)。

senses.zh_definition: 习惯、行为或情绪在人与人之间相互影响并传播。
senses.en_definition: Of a habit, behaviour or emotion, to spread from person to person.
senses.ms_definition: Ditiru atau turut dialami oleh orang lain, berkenaan tabiat, perangai atau perasaan.
senses.nuances: 比喻用法，可形容坏习惯，也可形容笑声、热情等；并不表示真正的病原感染。

senses.zh_definition: 火势蔓延；火从一处延烧至另一处。
senses.en_definition: Of fire, to spread to another object or place.
senses.ms_definition: Merebak daripada tempat yang terbakar kepada benda atau kawasan lain.
senses.nuances: 这是实体传播义，不是“火受到感染”。此义见 [DBP《Kamus Pelajar》：berjangkit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=berjangkit)；现代报道也常用 api merebak。

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 卫生宣传
dual_scenarios.ms: Kempen itu bertujuan meningkatkan kesedaran orang ramai tentang penyakit berjangkit.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这项宣传活动旨在提高公众对传染病的认识。
dual_scenarios.en: The campaign aims to raise public awareness of infectious diseases.

dual_scenarios.zh: 你的笑也太有感染力了，我都跟着笑起来了！
dual_scenarios.en: Your laugh is infectious—now you've got me laughing too!

dah 对应 sudah。
lah 在这里加强轻松、亲近的语气。

messages.ms_standard: Ketawa kamu ini berjangkit. Saya berasa hendak ketawa sebaik sahaja melihat kamu.
messages.zh: 你笑起来太有感染力了。我一看你就想笑。
messages.en: Your laugh is infectious. Just looking at you makes me want to laugh.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 描述疾病时宜说 penyakit itu berjangkit；避免把病人直接称作“传染源”来责备。比喻朋友的笑声 berjangkit 通常带亲切、正面的意味。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 卫生宣传中用词中性准确；不要仅凭族群、职业或外貌推断谁会传播疾病。谈坏习惯会 berjangkit 时，也应避免当众羞辱个人。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 描述疾病时宜说 penyakit itu berjangkit；避免把病人直接称作“传染源”来责备。比喻朋友的笑声 berjangkit 通常带亲切、正面的意味。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 卫生宣传中用词中性准确；不要仅凭族群、职业或外貌推断谁会传播疾病。谈坏习惯会 berjangkit 时，也应避免当众羞辱个人。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries place disease, fire and imitated habits within the semantic range of berjangkit. The shared picture is something passing beyond its first location or bearer. That picture also supports figurative expressions about laughter. Rather than requiring separate memorisation, these uses can be understood as different kinds of spreading, some physical and others social.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jangkit 想成“接着传”：疾病传给别人，火接着烧，笑声也接着传；berjangkit 的共同画面就是“蔓延”。

morphology.formula: Badminton Association of Malaysia → BAM；∅ + bam → bam（其他同形词）
morphology.pattern_note: 协会名称取英文名称各主要词的首字母，规范写作 BAM，可读作一个音节 /bam/；其余 bam 是独立同形词，不由协会缩写派生。

senses.zh_definition: 马来西亚羽毛球协会的英文名称缩写。
senses.en_definition: The abbreviation for the Badminton Association of Malaysia.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan nama Inggeris bagi Persatuan Badminton Malaysia, iaitu Badminton Association of Malaysia.
senses.nuances: 这是输入指定的主要义项；正式书写须用大写 BAM。它指协会，不自动等同于国家队或所有马来西亚羽毛球运动员。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=bam)。

collocations.zh: 马来西亚羽总旗下球员

senses.zh_definition: 航海用横木；用于加固船柱，或装在桨柄末端。
senses.en_definition: A crosspiece reinforcing a ship's post or fitted at the end of an oar.
senses.ms_definition: Palang kayu pengukuh tiang kapal atau palang pada bahagian hujung pengayuh.
senses.nuances: 属于航海器物词，与大写 BAM 无关。以下是说明器物所属的组合，不应视为现代日常高频搭配。[DBP 同形词释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=bam)。

senses.zh_definition: 鼓等发出的低沉声响。
senses.en_definition: A low, deep sound, such as that of a drum.
senses.ms_definition: Bunyi bernada rendah, misalnya bunyi yang dihasilkan oleh gendang.
senses.nuances: 用于声音描写，不能一概套用英语 bam 表示撞击的所有用法。以下为声音描写示例。[DBP 同形词释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=bam)。

collocations.en: the deep boom of a drum

senses.zh_definition: 躺下；儿童用语。
senses.en_definition: To lie down, in children's language.
senses.ms_definition: Berbaring, dalam bahasa kanak-kanak.
senses.nuances: 限于儿童语言或成人对幼儿的亲昵表达，不用于正式指示。这里表示躺卧，不必然表示睡着；以下为该语域中的组合示例。[DBP 语域标注](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=bam)。

collocations.en: lie down for a while first

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式首次提及时可写 Persatuan Badminton Malaysia (BAM)，后文使用 BAM。评论协会时应区分管理层、教练与球员。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 正式首次提及时可写 Persatuan Badminton Malaysia (BAM)，后文使用 BAM。评论协会时应区分管理层、教练与球员。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 体育聊天使用 BAM 很自然；儿童义 bam 只适合相应亲密语境。航海义与声音义须有明确上下文，以免误读为协会名称。

etymology.historical_story: BAM takes its letters from the association's English name. Its institutional history began in Kuala Lumpur on 11 November 1934 under the name Badminton Association of Malaya. The initials connect the earlier Malayan name with the Malaysian one. The lowercase nautical, sound and children's words are separate dictionary homographs. [Association history](https://bam.org.my/history).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: B＝Badminton，A＝Association，M＝Malaysia：看到大写 BAM，先想到马来西亚羽总；小写 bam 则要看上下文。

morphology.pattern_note: 上述词根分析及输入 Jawi 对应 DBP 标 Mn 的皮革名词。日常动词 bawak 则对应标准语 bawa，末尾常读作喉塞音 [ʔ]；这里的 k 不是后缀。两者须分开理解，不能据同形推断同源。

word_family.gloss: 口语动词 bawak 对应的标准词形：带、拿；不属于皮革名词的已证实派生词族
由 bawa 派生：携带、带领；不由皮革名词 bawak 派生

senses.zh_definition: 水牛皮；水牛的厚皮。
senses.en_definition: Buffalo hide.
senses.ms_definition: Belulang atau kulit kerbau.
senses.nuances: DBP 标注 Mn，指米南加保语来源或用法，并非日常最常见的“带、拿”。输入 Jawi 对应该词典名词。该义较少见，以下为释义性组合，不能认定为高频搭配。参见 [DBP：bawak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=bawak)。

senses.zh_definition: 带、拿、携带；也可指把某人带到某处。为 bawa 的口语写法。
senses.en_definition: Colloquial bawa: to bring, take, or carry something, or take someone somewhere.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk percakapan bagi bawa, iaitu membawa barang atau membawa seseorang ke sesuatu tempat.
senses.nuances: 在马来西亚口语和聊天文字中常见。正式书写按句法使用 bawa、membawa 或带适当词缀的形式。DBP 方言资料中有此类动词用例，但这不等于其作为正式动词词形获得规范地位。参见 [DBP：bawak 的方言用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=bawak)。

collocations.en: take a child to the clinic

senses.zh_definition: 驾驶车辆，为口语 bawa 的一种用法。
senses.en_definition: Colloquially, to drive a vehicle.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam percakapan, memandu sesuatu kenderaan.
senses.nuances: bawak kereta 可指“开车”，具体语境也可能表示“把车带来”。正式表达驾驶行为时用 memandu 更明确。此义属于口语动词，不属于米南加保皮革名词。参见 [DBP：bawak 的车辆驾驶用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=bawak)。

etymology.historical_story: Barangnya combines the ordinary noun barang with the attached element -nya. It is therefore understood through Malay grammar rather than as a separate historical borrowing. A useful cultural setting is collecting belongings or receiving goods: context tells listeners whether the speaker means someone's possessions or the particular delivery already discussed. The same spelling accommodates both interpretations without marking gender.

etymology.historical_story: Bunyi belongs to an old Austronesian sound vocabulary. The Austronesian Comparative Dictionary reconstructs Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *buñi, meaning noise or sound, and records related forms in several regional languages. Malay adds -kan to turn the idea of sound into an action causing sound: a bell rings, and someone makes it ring. This is productive Malay morphology rather than an English borrowing. [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/25834)

etymology.historical_story: Classical Malay preserves berbagai in descriptions of someone or something without an equal. The dictionary example concerns a princess whose beauty has no comparison. Modern learners can confuse this older comparative meaning with berbagai-bagai, meaning various kinds. DBP guidance explicitly distinguishes the two, making this word a useful reminder that reduplication can mark a significant difference in meaning. [DBP：用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=berbagai-bagai)

etymology.historical_story: The root cahaya belongs to the Sanskrit-derived vocabulary shared across Malay and Indonesian. Its source, chāyā, covered ideas including shade, reflection, lustre, and light. Malay gives the borrowed root a productive local structure: ber- creates bercahaya. The same image of visible brightness also supports descriptions of a radiant face. [World Loanword Database](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839473147977)

etymology.historical_story: Beca reflects the exchange of everyday vocabulary between Malay and Hokkien speakers. Singapore's National Library identifies it among Hokkien words absorbed into Malay, while its established Malay meaning names a pedal-powered passenger vehicle. The word offers a compact reminder that familiar transport vocabulary can preserve the history of multilingual contact. [National Library Singapore](https://biblioasia.nlb.gov.sg/files/pdf/vol-6/issue-4/v6-issue4_PluralitySolidarity.pdf)

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 与前词连写，但不是派生词缀；连接时词干没有音变。headword.jawi 严格保留数据包的 باݢي，该值仅拼出 bagi，未包含 -lah，不能视作 bagilah 的完整爪夷拼写。词族以下采用动词 bagi；不把介词义“为了”直接套入本词。

senses.zh_definition: 给吧；给一下；用来请求、劝说或催促对方交出或给予某物。
senses.en_definition: Give or hand something over, with a particle expressing encouragement, appeal, or insistence.
senses.ms_definition: Berilah atau serahkanlah sesuatu kepada seseorang; bentuk bagi yang disertai partikel penegas -lah.
senses.nuances: 常用于会话。-lah 可使请求显得亲近，也可能因语调而加强催促，并不自动等于“请”。bagi 的动词义及派生形式参见 [DBP：bagi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=bagi)；-lah 不构成派生词的说明参见 [DBP：partikel](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=partikel)。

senses.zh_definition: 让……吧；准许……吧；在口语中请求允许某人做某事。
senses.en_definition: Let or allow someone to do something, especially in a conversational request.
senses.ms_definition: Benarkanlah seseorang melakukan sesuatu, khususnya dalam bahasa percakapan.
senses.nuances: 常见结构为 bagilah + 人 + 动作，例如 bagilah saya cuba。正式文本通常改用 benarkanlah 或 berilah peluang，避免与交付物品的意思混淆。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 朋友间 Bagilah… 很自然；向长辈、客户或不熟悉的人提出请求时，Boleh berikan…? 通常更稳妥。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 不要把 -lah 当成万能礼貌标记。重复催促或加重语气，可能使原本简单的请求显得不耐烦。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 朋友间 Bagilah… 很自然；向长辈、客户或不熟悉的人提出请求时，Boleh berikan…? 通常更稳妥。

etymology.historical_story: Bagilah shows how Malay builds conversational meaning without creating a new dictionary root. The verb bagi carries the action of giving, while attached -lah adds emphasis or an interpersonal appeal. DBP distinguishes this particle from derivational affixes. Its effect depends on context and delivery: the same request can sound encouraging, pleading, or impatient. See [DBP's explanation of particles](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=partikel).

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为完整专名处理；不存在可据此确认的 ber- + nie 构词关系。音标为常见英式英语姓名读音。

senses.en_definition: A given name or familiar form of names such as Bernard, Bernadette, or Bernice.
senses.ms_definition: Nama orang atau nama panggilan yang boleh menjadi bentuk ringkas bagi Bernard, Bernadette, Bernice dan beberapa nama lain.
senses.nuances: 词性细类为专有名词，规范拼写首字母大写。不能仅凭该名字判断具体人物、性别或完整姓名。马来文解释为编者撰写。以下是姓名用法示例，并非固定高频搭配。参见 [Behind the Name：Bernie](https://www.behindthename.com/name/bernie)。

etymology.historical_story: Bernie belongs to the English tradition of familiar name forms. It can shorten Bernard, Bernadette, Bernice, and other names beginning with Bern, so its history depends on the individual’s full name. In Malay conversation it remains a personal name. Its initial letters merely resemble the Malay prefix ber-; that resemblance does not establish a morphological relationship. [Behind the Name: Bernie](https://www.behindthename.com/name/bernie).

senses.zh_definition: 握手；通常以 berjabat tangan 表示双方握手致意。
senses.en_definition: To shake hands, usually as a greeting or sign of goodwill.
senses.ms_definition: Saling memegang tangan sebagai tanda sapaan, penghormatan atau kemesraan; bersalaman.
senses.nuances: DBP 将 berjabat 释为 berjabat tangan；完整搭配最明确。表示与某人握手时用 berjabat tangan dengan seseorang。不可因 jabatan 有“部门”等义，就把 berjabat 解释为“任职”；马来西亚表达任职通常用 memegang jawatan 或 menjawat jawatan。参见 [DBP：jabat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=jabat)。

etymology.historical_story: Berjabat belongs to the jabat family, whose dictionary meanings connect holding a hand with holding responsibilities. In the greeting expression berjabat tangan, the physical act becomes a sign of recognition and goodwill. Related words such as jabatan illustrate how one lexical family can develop administrative meanings, although those meanings must not be transferred automatically to every derived form.

senses.en_definition: Having a history or historical importance; historic.

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合旅游介绍、文化报道和纪念活动。历史悠久不自动等于已获法定文物身份；涉及官方保护资格时应使用确切称号。

etymology.historical_story: Sejarah is commonly traced to Arabic shajarah, meaning a tree. The connection becomes memorable through genealogy: a family branches like a tree, and accounts of ancestry preserve the past. Malay sejarah encompasses history more broadly, while bersejarah describes places or events that carry historical significance. [Historical discussion](https://pearl.usm.my/pjj2324/pluginfile.php/70110/mod_resource/content/1/Pengertian%20sejarah%20%281%29.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听见 ber-sejarah，就把 ber- 想成“带有”：带着 sejarah（历史）的建筑或时刻，就是“有历史意义的”。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接 santai 时保留原形，不发生辅音脱落；把表示轻松状态的词变为表示休闲活动的动词。

senses.zh_definition: 在没有压力或催迫的情况下，轻松自在地休息、消遣或活动。
senses.en_definition: To relax or spend time at ease, free from pressure or tension.
senses.ms_definition: Berbuat apa sahaja dengan bebas tanpa ketegangan; bersenang-senang tanpa tekanan atau desakan.
senses.nuances: 强调活动时轻松自在，不必完全停止活动，也不等于睡觉或偷懒。可指聊天、散步、看书等休闲活动。释义参照 [DBP：santai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=santai)。

etymology.historical_story: Bersantai combines santai, a state of ease, with the productive Malay prefix ber-. Its cultural associations include conversation, family outings, and unhurried recreation. DBP's catalogue records the title Santai Jiwa from 1973, illustrating the word's established literary presence. The formation expresses taking one's ease without necessarily becoming inactive. [DBP：santai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=santai)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 santai＝轻松，ber-＝进行活动：bersantai 就是进入轻松模式，聊天、散步都算。

etymology.historical_story: The supplied Kamus Dewan entry records bangang as coarse language meaning stupid or dull-witted, but supplies no historical derivation. Its dependable cultural lesson is therefore about register: a dictionary can document an insult without endorsing it as polite speech. No specific donor language, ancient root, or origin story can be established from the evidence provided.

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary family around buruh shows how Malay describes both workers and the wider world of employment. Memburuh names working as a labourer, while perburuhan extends to labour and labour affairs. These established relationships explain the word's cultural reach without requiring an uncertain claim about its earliest borrowing source. [Source: Kamus Dewan via PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=buruh).

etymology.historical_story: Bawahan is formed from bawah, meaning below, and the suffix -an. Its meanings connect physical position with social organization: someone under another person’s authority becomes a subordinate. The same root also appears in terbawah, meaning lowest, and pembawah, the denominator beneath a fraction line. These connections provide a semantic map rather than a dated historical chronology. [DBP 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=di+bawah+1)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bawah 是“下面”，bawah + -an 就想到组织图上处于下一层的人：下属。记住是职位在下，不是人格低下。

etymology.historical_story: Berpegangan belongs to the pegang family, which connects physical holding with beliefs and commitments. A pantun recorded in DBP places holding hands beside an unchanging promise. That pairing provides a memorable cultural illustration: hands can hold another person, while a person can hold to a promise. It illustrates the meanings without establishing when either arose. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=berpegangan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 画面记忆：两只手相互 pegang，就是 berpegangan；心里紧握原则，则是抽象的“坚持”。

etymology.historical_story: The base bahaya belongs to Malay's Sanskrit-derived vocabulary; an early Malay dictionary already labels it Sanskrit and records its meaning as danger or peril. Malay morphology supplies -kan to form a verb expressing the causing of danger. Remember this as an established borrowed base used productively within Malay, rather than as several invented historical syllables. [Wilkinson](https://www.sabrizain.org/malaya/library/dictwilkinson.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bahaya＝危险；加 -kan，想成“把危险带给别人”：bahayakan＝使陷入危险。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 在此表示具有某种品格或属性；接 /m/ 开头的 maruah 时保留 ber-，词干不变。

senses.zh_definition: 具有尊严、自尊或良好操守的；能够维护自身名誉与人格的。
senses.en_definition: Having dignity, self-respect, or honour.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai maruah.
senses.nuances: 侧重人格尊严、操守和自尊，不等同于富有、职位显赫或态度傲慢。可形容个人，也可形容民族、国家或生活方式。词形含表示“具有”的 ber-，这里以形容词呈现其属性义。[DBP《Kamus Dewan》第四版](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=maruah)。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies maruah as an Arabic borrowing and records honour and self-respect among its meanings. Malay adds the productive prefix ber- to express possessing that quality. The resulting word can describe a person's character or the dignity of a community. Its core image is honour worth maintaining, rather than wealth, rank, or outward display. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=maruah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ber-＝具有，maruah＝尊严：bermaruah 就是“把尊严带在身上”。

etymology.historical_story: Beach belongs to English rather than the established Malay vocabulary represented by pantai. DBP's English–Malay dictionary records both the shoreline noun and the verb for bringing a boat ashore. Its appearance inside a Malay conversation can therefore be explained as language mixing. The packet provides no evidence identifying when this particular English item first entered Malaysian conversation. [DBP noun entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=tepi+laut%3B) [DBP verb entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=darat)

senses.zh_definition: 母狗；雌性犬。
senses.en_definition: A female dog.
senses.ms_definition: Anjing betina; makna literal perkataan bahasa Inggeris bitch.
senses.nuances: 这是英语本义，养犬或繁育语境可作中性术语；马来语通常说 anjing betina。以下搭配保留英语原文，ms 字段在本外语条目中承载原语搭配。马来语释义为编写释义，不冒称 DBP 原文。[Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/bitch_1)

collocations.en: a female dog used for breeding

senses.zh_definition: 针对女性的粗俗侮辱性称呼，表达说话者认为对方讨厌、刻薄或不友善。
senses.en_definition: An offensive term for a woman regarded as unpleasant or unkind.
senses.ms_definition: Kata makian bahasa Inggeris terhadap perempuan yang dianggap menjengkelkan, kejam atau tidak baik.
senses.nuances: 带有明显的性别贬损色彩；并不必然指性工作者，也不能一律译成“妓女”。部分群体会戏谑或自称使用，但不能据此推定任何人都接受。搭配为英语。[Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/bitch)

senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu perkara atau keadaan yang sangat sukar, menyusahkan atau tidak menyenangkan.

senses.zh_definition: 受他人完全控制、任其使唤的人，带有羞辱意味。

senses.ms_definition: Sebutan menghina bagi seseorang yang dikuasai sepenuhnya dan menurut segala kehendak orang lain.

senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan atau sesi merungut atau memperkatakan keburukan seseorang.
senses.nuances: 英语非正式用法，常见于 have a bitch 等结构；不是马来语名词构词。搭配为英语。[Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/bitch_1)

collocations.en: have a complaining conversation about work

senses.ms_definition: Merungut atau mengeluarkan kritikan yang pedas dan tidak menyenangkan tentang seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 英语动词，可见 bitch about 或 bitch and moan。马来语可按语境用 merungut、mengomel 或 mengumpat，三者并非在所有语境中完全等义。搭配为英语。[Collins English Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/bitch)

etymology.historical_story: English bitch continues Old English bicce, originally referring to a female dog. The animal meaning survives, while later uses include insults and expressions of complaint or difficulty. Its history belongs to English; its appearance inside a Malay sentence does not by itself establish an officially accepted Malay borrowing. [Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/bitch_1)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: /bɪtʃ/ 末尾是短促的 /tʃ/；本义“母犬”，指人常是辱骂。别与 beach /biːtʃ/“海滩”混淆。

senses.zh_definition: 更好的；质量、适用性或效果优于另一选择的。
senses.en_definition: Of higher quality or more suitable than another alternative.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan campur kod, lebih baik atau lebih sesuai berbanding sesuatu yang lain.
senses.nuances: 英语比较级；这里只说明马来语混用中的理解方式，并非 DBP 官方马来语释义。规范马来语用 lebih baik 或 lebih sesuai。输入缺乏其规范词条证据，因此不标为 official。英语读音及核心义参见 [Cambridge：better](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/better)。

senses.zh_definition: 身体或精神状态较之前好转的；舒服一些的。

senses.nuances: 修饰动作，区别于评价物品或状态的形容词义。规范表达用 dengan lebih baik 或 dengan lebih berkesan。

senses.zh_definition: 最好；还是……比较妥当，用来提出建议。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 熟人或惯常混用英语的同事之间可以自然出现；与不熟悉英语的人交流时，用 lebih baik 更清楚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式马来语公文、考试及规范写作应按语境改用 lebih baik、lebih sesuai 或 sebaik-baiknya。正式例句中的 better 是被讨论的英语词，而非作为规范马来语直接使用。

etymology.historical_story: Better is an inherited English comparative, recorded in Old English forms such as betera. It is not formed by adding -er to good. In Malay conversation, speakers may insert the English word into Malay sentences, while standard Malay expresses the comparison transparently with lebih baik. Its English history remains distinct from Malay morphology. [Word history](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/better).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: better 就是“更好”；切回规范马来语时，换成 lebih baik。不要误拆成 bet 加 -er。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 在 g 前保持原形，词根 getar 不变；ber- 和 getar 中的 e 均读 /ə/。构成表示主体自身振动的不及物动词。

word_family.gloss: 振动器；使物体振动的装置

senses.zh_definition: 物体快速、反复地往返运动；振动或震颤。
senses.en_definition: To vibrate or oscillate rapidly and repeatedly.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak dengan cepat dan berulang-alik secara berterusan; bergentar.
senses.nuances: 指主体自身振动，不直接支配受事宾语。要表达“使某物振动”，用 menggetarkan。可用于琴弦、手机、机器等，不限于大幅度摇晃。[DBP：bergetar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=bergetar)

senses.zh_definition: 声音或身体因紧张、恐惧、激动等而轻微颤抖；也可形容内心受到触动。
senses.en_definition: To tremble or quiver, especially through emotion; figuratively, to be emotionally stirred.
senses.ms_definition: Menggeletar atau terketar sedikit, misalnya pada suara atau tubuh akibat perasaan; secara kiasan, mengalami gerak perasaan yang kuat.
senses.nuances: 这是振动义在人和情感语境中的运用。suara bergetar 是声音发颤；jiwa bergetar 较具文学色彩，表示内心受到触动。不能机械地把所有“感动”都译为 bergetar。[DBP：bergetar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=bergetar)

etymology.historical_story: Bergetar combines the Malay prefix ber- with getar, presenting vibration as something the subject does or experiences. Its vocabulary bridges physical sound and inner feeling: a string vibrates, a voice quivers, and a soul may be stirred. DBP's literary index even records music described as continuing to bergetar in someone's soul, illustrating that expressive bridge. [DBP: bergetar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=bergetar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 getar 和吉他 gitar 联想在一起：拨动吉他弦，弦就在 bergetar；两词只是记忆联想，并非同源。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 在 c 前保留原形，c 表示 /tʃ/，词根首辅音不脱落。bercampur 通常是不及物动词；表示与某物或某人混合、交往时，常接 dengan。

senses.zh_definition: 不同物质、成分或感受混合、交织在一起。
senses.en_definition: Mix or mingle together, including substances, elements, or feelings.
senses.ms_definition: Berbaur atau bersatu dengan unsur lain dalam satu campuran atau keadaan.

collocations.en: happy and sad at the same time

senses.zh_definition: 与他人来往、交际或打成一片。

senses.en_definition: Have sexual relations as husband and wife.
senses.ms_definition: Melakukan hubungan kelamin sebagai suami isteri.

collocations.en: have sexual relations with one's wife
a husband and wife having sexual relations

senses.zh_definition: 在固定搭配中指介入、插手他人事务或参与议论。

senses.nuances: 限于 bercampur tangan、bercampur bicara 等搭配；bercampur 单独使用通常不表示“干涉”。

etymology.historical_story: Bercampur combines campur with the productive Malay prefix ber-. Its dictionary meanings bring together physical mixing, social association, and an intimate euphemism for marital relations. This range makes a useful cultural connection: the image of separate things coming together also describes people spending time together, while context determines how close that association is. [DBP source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=bercampur).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 cam-pur 的“混在一起”画面：物质混合用 bercampur，人群交往也用 bercampur；ber- 表示处于这种状态或进行这种活动。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接在 sekutu 前，词根拼写不变；表示结成伙伴关系或联合行动。

word_family.gloss: 使结为伙伴；使与某物并列

senses.zh_definition: 为共同目的结成伙伴或盟友，彼此合作。

senses.ms_definition: Berkawan untuk melakukan sesuatu; bersahabat.

collocations.en: join forces to achieve a common goal

senses.zh_definition: 多个团体或政治实体联合起来，形成更强大的联盟或联邦。

senses.nuances: 用于组织、政治联盟及联邦关系。negeri-negeri bersekutu 指组成联邦的州属；国家名称中的 Persekutuan 是相关名词，不能直接用 bersekutu 替换。

etymology.historical_story: Bersekutu combines ber- with sekutu, meaning an ally or associate. Its connection with political union is visible in the related noun Persekutuan. The Federation of Malaya, established in 1948, offers a historical example of that vocabulary of association. This illustrates the word family's cultural significance rather than dating the origin of the verb. [Malaysian Department of Information](https://dbook.penerangan.gov.my/dbook/dmdocuments/negaraku_60_tahun_merdeka/files/basic-html/page27.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 sekutu＝盟友；加 ber-，就进入“结成盟友、联合行动”的状态。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 保持原形，词根不发生删音；kh 是表示 /x/ 的双字母组合，y 表示 /j/。

senses.zh_definition: 沉入自己的想象、回忆或愿望中；做白日梦，遐想。
senses.en_definition: To daydream or become absorbed in imagined experiences, memories, or wishes.
senses.ms_definition: Berangan-angan; mengelamun.
senses.nuances: 可以只是中性的遐想，也可因脱离眼前任务而带有责备意味。不同于 tidur 时的做梦。四个基本义见 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=berkhayal)。

senses.zh_definition: 把想象中的事情当作正在发生来体验或表演；进行假想活动。
senses.en_definition: To imagine or act as though an unreal situation were actually happening.
senses.ms_definition: Berbuat seolah-olah sesuatu benar-benar berlaku.

senses.zh_definition: 仿佛看见实际并不存在的事物；产生虚幻的视觉印象。
senses.en_definition: To seem to see something that is not actually present.
senses.ms_definition: Melihat sesuatu yang sebenarnya tidak ada.
senses.nuances: 词典中的感知义；不能仅凭此词推断精神疾病、药物影响或其他医学原因。以下为说明该义的搭配，使用频率低于白日梦义。

collocations.zh: 仿佛看见不存在的影子

senses.zh_definition: 因某种活动或体验而入迷、忘我，以致忽略周围事物。
senses.en_definition: To become entranced or so absorbed in something that one's surroundings are neglected.
senses.ms_definition: Leka atau sangat asyik dengan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 侧重注意力被某事物吸引，不必涉及虚构情景。现代日常表达也常使用 leka、asyik 或 terbuai；berkhayal 在此较具文学色彩。

collocations.en: to become absorbed in a dance

etymology.historical_story: Khayal is an Arabic borrowing associated with imagination, visions, and absorption. An early Malay grammar already lists it among Arabic-derived vocabulary. Malay adds its own productive prefix ber- to form an activity verb. The result ranges from ordinary daydreaming to make-believe and entrancement, showing how a borrowed base becomes part of local word formation. [Winstedt's Malay grammar](https://www.sabrizain.org/malaya/library/grammarwinstedt.pdf), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=berkhayal)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kha-yal 连到“脑海里的画面”；ber- 表示进入活动：人在这里，心已跑进幻想里。

etymology.historical_story: Budiman is historically connected with Sanskrit buddhimān, meaning intelligent or wise, and belongs beside budi in the vocabulary of intellect and character. Malay dictionary meanings bring wisdom together with virtue. This pairing helps explain why calling someone budiman praises both judgment and conduct, rather than academic ability alone. [NUSA study of Sanskrit loans](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/paulipuye/Pdf-file-from-SEAlang/refs/heads/main/nusa-v41.pdf) [DBP: budiman](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=budiman)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用 budi（品德、理智）作记忆锚点：budiman 是“有智慧，也有好品德的人”。词尾 -man 不等于英语 man，也不表示只限男性。

senses.en_definition: The circulating bodily fluid that transports oxygen and nutrients and carries away waste products.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang berpadanan dengan darah, iaitu bendalir tubuh yang beredar untuk membawa oksigen dan nutrien serta mengangkut bahan buangan.
senses.nuances: 本记录用于识别混入词表的英语词，仅列其核心实体义，不宣称 blood 是正式马来语词，也不覆盖英语全部比喻义和动词义。标准马来语对应词为 darah。下列搭配使用马来语对应表达。参见 [Merriam-Webster：blood](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/blood)及 [马来西亚卫生部：献血与血型用语](https://data.moh.gov.my/ms-MY/data-catalogue/blood_donations)。

etymology.historical_story: English blood descends through Middle English from Old English blōd and is related to Old High German bluot. Its documented English history predates the twelfth century. English later uses blood for ancestry and kinship as well as bodily fluid, but these meanings require separate contextual translation into Malay. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/blood).

etymology.historical_story: Beg is an established Malay borrowing from English bag. Its everyday use illustrates how a borrowed noun can participate in Malay grammar: attaching -nya identifies a possessor or something already understood in context. The resulting begnya is therefore a regular grammatical combination, not a separate borrowing with its own independent historical origin.

etymology.historical_story: Khemah belongs to Malay's Arabic-derived vocabulary and is connected with Arabic khaymah, meaning a tent. An early English–Malay dictionary already records berkhemah for encamping. Malay adds its productive prefix ber- to turn the shelter into an activity: putting up a tent or staying in one. [Historical dictionary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/48/An_English-Malay_dictionary_%28IA_englishmalaydict00shelrich%29.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 khemah＝帐篷，再给它加上表示活动的 ber-：帐篷搭起来，人就开始 berkhemah（露营）。

etymology.historical_story: Britain belongs to an ancient family of geographical names. Roman writers used Britannia for the land associated with the Britons. The name later acquired political significance: the union of England and Scotland in 1707 established the Kingdom of Great Britain. This history helps explain its overlapping geographical and political uses today. [House of Commons Library](https://commonslibrary.parliament.uk/research-briefings/cbp-10649/)

etymology.historical_story: Bangkok preserves an older place name associated with the area around the Chao Phraya River. Its precise origin remains uncertain. Proposed explanations connect it with an island settlement or with Bang Makok, referring to makok trees. These are competing historical explanations, not components of a Malay compound. [Tourism Authority of Thailand](https://news.cision.com/se/tourism-authority-of-thailand/r/10-things-you-do-not-know-about-thailand%2Cc3233734).

etymology.historical_story: A bilingual dictionary can contain words from both languages without treating every headword as a borrowing. DBP records English beck in the expression at someone's beck and call, translated through the Malay image of another person's pointing finger. etymology.historical_story: Berkait combines the Malay prefix ber- with kait, a hook. Its dictionary senses connect a concrete hooked shape, the state of being caught, and an abstract relationship. These meanings offer a useful conceptual bridge: ideas can be linked just as objects can catch together. This explains the semantic connection without claiming a documented chronology.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kait 是钩子；berkait 就想成“钩在一起”：可以真的钩住，也可以是事情彼此有关。

etymology.historical_story: Malay bonet corresponds to English bonnet, preserving both the cloth head covering and the British automotive meaning. A memorable connection is that each covers something: one covers a head, while the other covers an engine. DBP records both senses, so the surrounding conversation determines whether the topic is clothing or a vehicle.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bonet 想成两顶“帽子”：宝宝头上的软帽，汽车发动机上的引擎盖。

etymology.historical_story: Bikin belongs to a wider regional colloquial vocabulary shared across Malay and Indonesian settings. One proposed history connects it with Betawi békin and an older formation involving baik. That proposal concerns historical development, not a productive rule for modern Malay. Learners should therefore store bikin as a whole root and learn its attested derivatives separately. See [the etymological discussion](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/bikin#Malay).

etymology.historical_story: Biaya belongs to the Indic layer of Malay vocabulary. Historical linguistic research connects it with Sanskrit vyaya, associated with expenditure, and records its place among Malay terms for money and legal affairs. Its modern family remains practical: biaya names the expense, membiayai describes providing the money, and pembiayaan names the funding process. [Historical linguistic study](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/files/1708896328/Legal_diglossia_lexical_borrowing_and_mixed_juridical_systems_in_early_Islamic_Java_and_Sumatra_24_11_19_14_19_08.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Bebola illustrates Malay partial reduplication: bola supplies the base, while a shortened copy appears before it with the vowel reduced to schwa. The resulting word names something shaped like a ball. Its usefulness extends from food counters, where bebola ikan means fish balls, to machinery, where alas bebola names a ball bearing. The shared image is roundness.

etymology.historical_story: The cultural life of benang reaches beyond sewing. Malay proverbs use thread to picture patient accumulation and impossible effort: small lengths eventually become cloth, while wet thread cannot stand upright. These expressions connect an everyday material with practical wisdom. This is cultural evidence, rather than a claim about the word's earliest origin. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132088&keyword=benang)

etymology.historical_story: Bermusuhan illustrates how Malay builds a relationship from a noun: musuh identifies an enemy, while bermusuhan describes being enemies. Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka also records opposition between desire and reason, showing that the expression can extend beyond human quarrels. Its transparent formation is established; a deeper origin for musuh is not asserted here. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=bermusuh)

morphology.formula: ke- + mungkin + -an → kemungkinan; ber- + kemungkinan → berkemungkinan
morphology.pattern_note: 分两层构词：先由 ke-…-an 构成名词 kemungkinan，再加前缀 ber-。affix_type 指最外层前缀；词干无辅音脱落，ng 表示 /ŋ/。所给音标中的 /e/ 反映部分马来西亚读音。

senses.zh_definition: 存在某种可能性；某事有可能发生或某种情况可能属实。
senses.en_definition: To have a possibility of occurring or being the case.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai peluang untuk berlaku atau menjadi kenyataan; tidak mustahil berlaku demikian.
senses.nuances: ber- 派生的不及物动词，常用作谓语，后接 akan、untuk 或其他谓语成分。单独使用不保证概率很高；besar berkemungkinan 才明确加强可能性。口语常简化为 mungkin。[释义依据：DBP mungkin](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=mungkin)。

dual_scenarios.zh: 我可能会晚到一会儿，这边堵车啊。

spoken_features: berkemungkinan 可出现在日常交流中，但比 mungkin 更郑重。
sikit 代替 sedikit；kat sini 代替 di sini。
lah 为解释情况增添口语语气。

messages.zh: 你是不是可能会晚到？我已经在咖啡馆了。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适合在职场汇报或正式说明中表达尚未确定的情况。谈到对方行程或决定时，这种保留语气可避免把猜测说成事实。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 涉及安排时，最好同时交代条件或确认时间。berkemungkinan 表达可能性，不等于承诺；与朋友聊天时，mungkin 通常更简洁自然。

etymology.historical_story: Mungkin comes from Arabic mumkin, meaning possible, illustrating how an Arabic loan became part of ordinary Malay thought and conversation. Malay morphology then builds kemungkinan, possibility, and berkemungkinan, having a possibility. The root's borrowing and its later Malay derivations show how inherited grammatical patterns can turn a borrowed word into a productive family. [Source: linguistic research archived by ANU](https://openresearch-repository.anu.edu.au/bitstreams/c4a77e46-47db-4b1f-9b8a-7eb7ee89efd8/download).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mungkin 是“可能”，kemungkinan 是“可能性”，ber-kemungkinan 就是“有这种可能性”。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 加在名词 karat“铁锈”前，表示带有锈或进入生锈状态；词干 k 保留，无鼻音同化。

senses.zh_definition: 铁或钢等表面生锈，或处于带锈的状态。
senses.en_definition: To rust or be covered with rust.
senses.ms_definition: Mengalami pembentukan karat atau mempunyai lapisan karat pada permukaannya.
senses.nuances: ber- 派生的不及物状态动词；可译为“生锈”或“锈了的”。通常用于铁、钢及相关器物，不能不加区别地代替所有金属的腐蚀。[释义依据：DBP karat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=karat)。

senses.zh_definition: 比喻事物年久陈旧，或因长期存在而显得老旧。
senses.en_definition: Figuratively, to be old, worn, or antiquated.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, sudah lama atau tua.
senses.nuances: 词典收录的比喻义。形容器物时可能同时带有实物生锈的意味；形容观念时有批评其陈旧的语气。下列为比喻组合，常见程度低于字面义。[释义依据：DBP karat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=karat)。

senses.zh_definition: 比喻内心怀有恶意，或心性受到邪恶侵蚀。
senses.en_definition: Figuratively, to be malicious or morally corrupted, especially of the heart.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, mempunyai perasaan jahat atau hati yang dipenuhi kejahatan.
senses.nuances: 主要见于 hati berkarat 等文学、劝诫或道德评价语境，评价较重，不宜随意用来形容具体人物。[释义依据：DBP karat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=karat)。

etymology.historical_story: Berkarat combines karat, rust, with the Malay prefix ber-, expressing possession or a resulting condition. Its cultural imagery reaches beyond metal: DBP also records figurative meanings involving age and a malicious heart. Rust therefore offers a concrete image for deterioration, allowing an observable surface condition to describe less visible human qualities. [Source: DBP karat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=karat).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: karat 是“锈”，ber- 表示“带有”：ber-karat＝带着锈，也就是生锈了。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，按独立词素记忆；开头的 ba- 不是马来语前缀。无须为此词生造派生词族。

etymology.historical_story: Batalion belongs to an international family of military terms. French bataillon was borrowed from Italian battaglione, a word for a body of soldiers. The precise route into Malay is not established by the supplied packet. Malay also uses the military image humorously: a visiting crowd can become a whole batalion of friends. [French Academy](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9B0584-A)

senses.zh_definition: 电子设备或喇叭发出的短促、通常较尖的“哔”声，常用于提示或警报。
senses.en_definition: A short, usually high-pitched sound made by an electronic device or horn as a signal.
senses.ms_definition: Bunyi pendek dan biasanya bernada tinggi yang dikeluarkan oleh peranti elektronik atau hon sebagai isyarat.
senses.nuances: 这里按英语原词在马来语中的夹用或拟声用法处理。输入没有 DBP 释义，本次亦未核实其马来语规范词条；马来文定义为编写释义。status 按指定格式保留，不代表已证实获 DBP 规范认可；Jawi 缺失保留 null。英语义与读音参见 [Oxford：beep](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/beep_1)。

senses.zh_definition: 发出短促的“哔”声，或使设备发出这种提示声。
senses.en_definition: To emit, or cause a device to emit, a short electronic signaling sound.
senses.ms_definition: Mengeluarkan atau menyebabkan peranti mengeluarkan bunyi isyarat pendek.
senses.nuances: 属于会话中的英语动词夹用，如 mesin tu beep；不是本次已核实的标准马来语动词。正式表达可用 mengeluarkan bunyi isyarat。此项马来文为编写释义。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 熟悉英语和设备操作的同事之间通常容易理解。面对不熟悉英语的使用者，bunyi isyarat 或 bunyi amaran 更清楚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合描述实际声响、技术聊天或引述设备提示。正式文件应说明该声响代表什么；不要把所有 beep 都称为警报，因为它也可能表示操作成功。

etymology.historical_story: English beep is an imitative word recorded from the 1920s, echoing a short, high sound. Its meaning covers both vehicle horns and electronic equipment. When inserted into Malay conversation, it conveniently names the sound itself. That conversational usefulness does not establish it as an officially standardized Malay headword. [Oxford: beep](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/beep_1)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 直接模仿设备“哔！”的一声：beep 的声音就是它的意思。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此为附着于名词后的第三人称代词，表示领属；并非创造新词义的派生后缀。ny 表示单一辅音 /ɲ/。数据包的 بوکو 只对应 buku，完整 bukunya 应加 ڽ。bu.ku.nya 为补充的音节划分。

senses.zh_definition: 他或她的书、本子；根据上下文，也可指他或她所写的书。
senses.en_definition: His or her book or notebook; also a book authored by that person, depending on context.

senses.nuances: 这是 buku 与领属代词 -nya 的组合释义，不是独立的 DBP 引文。-nya 不区分男女，也不单独标记书的数量；英语须依上下文选择 his 或 her。数据包引用的是 buku 表示节、关节或小块的另一组义项，不能直接充当本条常见书本义的定义。[DBP 拼写规范中的 bukunya 示例](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Malay attaches the possessive forms ku, mu, and nya directly to a preceding noun. DBP's spelling guide illustrates this with bukuku, bukumu, and bukunya together in one sentence. A single written word therefore carries both an object and its owner. This grammatical history is separate from the different dictionary meanings associated with buku.

etymology.historical_story: Berdirilah combines berdiri with the emphatic particle -lah. Its cultural interest lies in how one image, standing upright, also expresses independence, loyalty, and institutional existence. A person can stand on their own feet, supporters can stand behind a leader, and a kingdom can stand established. The particle frames these meanings as an appeal, assertion, or narrative development.

etymology.historical_story: Biasa traces to Sanskrit abhyāsa, meaning repetition or habit, illustrating the Sanskrit influence on Malay vocabulary. Its everyday meanings include ordinary and accustomed. Adding the Malay suffix -kan turns familiarity into something deliberately cultivated: a routine becomes customary, or a person learns to feel at home in unfamiliar circumstances. See [Traces of Contact in the Lexicon](https://brill.com/display/book/9789004529458/9789004529458_webready_content_text.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Bandara compresses the Indonesian expression bandar udara into a single pronounceable word. Indonesian language guidance lists it among acronyms that function as ordinary common nouns, so it is normally written in lowercase. For Malaysian learners, it provides a useful regional bridge: the same travel destination is normally called lapangan terbang in Malaysian Malay. [Indonesian Language Agency](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/32803/1/Buku_Seri_Penyuluhan_2019_Ejaan.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Malay connects physical crookedness with dishonesty through expressions such as akal bengkok. Its dictionary also records a separate Javanese homonym for land provided to village officials instead of wages. That administrative meaning preserves a different cultural setting; it should not be explained as a metaphor about bent land or treated as a derivative of the adjective. [Kamus Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=bengkok)

etymology.historical_story: The useful connection is with baik, meaning good. Adding -i produces a verb about making something right, while -nya points back to something already mentioned. Thus a familiar adjective becomes a compact instruction: make it good again. This explains the modern formation without inventing a separate historical origin for the whole expression.

etymology.historical_story: Bidadari ultimately comes from Sanskrit vidyādharī, a female supernatural being. Its history reflects South Asian influence on the vocabulary and storytelling traditions of the Malay world. In Malay, the word names a maiden of heaven or the celestial realm and also supplies a poetic comparison for an exceptionally beautiful woman. These uses preserve different cultural settings within one familiar word. [Linguistic source](https://brill.com/display/book/9789004529458/9789004529458_webready_content_text.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Berjauhan is a transparent Malay formation built from jauh, meaning far, with the circumfix ber-...-an. The resulting verb describes being far apart rather than actively pushing someone away. Its everyday uses connect physical distance with experiences such as living away from family, while the morphology itself does not imply a damaged relationship or permanent separation. [Malay morphology reference](https://ipkent.edu.my/document/pskent/pskent18/modul/bmm/BMM3093.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds expressive meanings with small attached elements as well as with full words. Here, buruk supplies the idea of something bad, ugly, or worn, while -nya can turn that judgment into an exclamation or a nominal expression. The familiar pairing baik buruknya presents good and bad together when people weigh a choice.

etymology.historical_story: Buah belongs to an old Austronesian word family, reconstructed as *buaq, whose meanings centre on fruit and extend across related languages. Malay preserves the concrete sense while also using fruit imagery for products and results. Buahnya adds the bound pronoun -nya, allowing speakers to connect a fruit or figurative outcome with something already mentioned. [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/25576)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: buah 是“果实”，-nya 像贴上的“它的”标签：buah + nya → 它的果实；语境换成努力，就能联想到“努力结出的成果”。

etymology.historical_story: The transparent formation joins ber-, expressing possession of a feature, to bentuk, meaning shape or form. A useful cultural bridge connects a heart-shaped cake with assistance delivered as cash: Malay uses the same verb for physical outlines and abstract formats. This illustrates its semantic range without requiring an unverified account of the root's distant origin.

etymology.historical_story: For many English families, Bradley began as a place name formed from Old English brād, meaning broad, and lēah, a woodland clearing. The place name became a surname and later a given name. Not every Bradley shares that origin: Scottish and Irish surname histories also exist, so the landscape explanation should not be applied to every individual. [Surname history](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=bradley).

etymology.historical_story: Banks is not a separate Malay root: it is an inflected English form of bank. Its final -s can mark several institutions or a single subject's action. Context also separates the financial institution from river edges, stored resources, and an aircraft's tilted turn. The spelling alone therefore cannot establish either the meaning or the part of speech. [Collins: bank](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/bank)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看主语再看场景：many banks 是“多家银行”，she banks 是“她办理银行业务”，river banks 是“河岸”；马来语复数不加英语 -s。

etymology.historical_story: Bertutur belongs to the Malay tutur family, which links speaking, speakers, and speech itself. The prefix ber- turns the base into an activity: speaking. Related forms include penutur, a speaker, and pertuturan, speech. This family offers a cultural connection to tutur kata, an expression concerned with the words people use when addressing one another. See [DBP: tutur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=tutur).

etymology.historical_story: English branch came through Anglo-French branche from Late Latin branca, meaning a paw. Its later meanings connect a projecting tree limb with divisions of larger systems, including organizations and routes. This history belongs to the English word. Its appearance inside Malay conversation is best understood as language mixing unless evidence establishes a particular borrowed use. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/branch).

etymology.historical_story: The word brings together tubuh, meaning body, se-, expressing one or unity, and the verbal prefix ber-. Its structure offers an image of bodily union, while its established dictionary meaning is specifically sexual intercourse. Related forms such as persetubuhan show how Malay uses different affixes to name an act or describe participation in it. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132444&keyword=bersetubuh)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tubuh 是“身体”，se- 联想到“合一”，ber- 表示进行活动：由“身体结合”的构词画面记住“性交”。

etymology.historical_story: Berganjak combines the Malay prefix ber- with ganjak, a base recorded in Kamus Dewan. A small bodily movement provides an accessible image for a change of position in argument. Thus someone can refuse to move from a chair or refuse to budge from a principle, using the same verb.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ganjak 想成“挪一格”：身体挪一格是移动，立场挪一格是改变；tidak berganjak 就是一格也不退。

etymology.historical_story: Bangku is a Portuguese loan associated with banco, meaning a bench or stool. A study hosted by UNESCO lists it among Portuguese contributions to Malay household vocabulary, alongside words for other familiar furnishings. Its modern Malay form functions as a complete lexical base; the ending ku is not a possessive suffix. etymology.historical_story: The bridge designation Bailey comes from its inventor, British engineer Donald Coleman Bailey. His surname became attached to the modular bridge system. In Malaysia, the expression jambatan Bailey appears in public works accounts of restoring disrupted road access. This engineering name must be distinguished from the English architectural noun bailey, which denotes an enclosed castle courtyard. Sources: [Science Museum Group](https://collection.sciencemuseumgroup.org.uk/people/cp89848/bailey-sir-donald-coleman), [JKR Pahang](https://jkr.pahang.gov.my/index.php/pembinaan-jambatan-panel-keluli-bermodular-jambatan-bailey-di-laluan-ft2490-seksyen-2-80-jalan-masuk-ke-perwira-jaya-dan-selancar-rompin-pahang/), [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/bailey).

etymology.historical_story: Benua belongs to an inherited Austronesian word family reconstructed as Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *banua, referring to inhabited land or territory sustaining a community. Related forms describe villages, homelands, and communal territory across widely separated languages. Malay preserves that older breadth in literary references to lands and countries, while modern geography gives benua its familiar continental scale. Source: [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/25129).

etymology.historical_story: Baker is an English occupational word built on bake. Malaysian vocational training materials pair it with pembuat roti, while DBP explains that this Malay expression can include cake makers in a general bakery context. The pairing helps explain its appearance in local job titles without establishing it as a standard Malay headword. [Malaysian vocational course](https://kemahiran.kbs.gov.my/kursus-ikbn-kemasik/kursus-sepenuh-masa-ikbnkemasik/details/4/32.html), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pastri)

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着于词尾的强调小品词，严格说并非派生后缀；此处 suffix 表示其附着位置。词根末尾的 /h/ 保留，不发生鼻音同化。输入 Jawi بونوه 仅对应 bunuh，此处按要求保留；完整 bunuhlah 应写作 بونوهله。

word_family.gloss: 杀人者；杀灭某物的制剂或工具

senses.zh_definition: 杀死吧；把某个有生命的对象杀死。通常为带有强调、催促或劝令语气的祈使形式。
senses.en_definition: Kill; an imperative form of bunuh carrying emphasis, urging, or exhortation.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk perintah bagi bunuh, yakni menyebabkan sesuatu yang bernyawa mati, dengan penegasan melalui partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: -lah 不改变“使死亡”的核心意义，其语气须结合语调与情境判断，不能一概译成礼貌的“请”。本词不是完成体，也不表示“已经杀死”。词根义参见 [DBP：bunuh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=Bunuh)。

senses.zh_definition: 消灭、扼杀或使某事物消失；用于抽象事物时，表示强烈地要求消除或毁掉它。
senses.en_definition: Eliminate, extinguish, or destroy something, including figuratively; used with emphatic or exhortative force.

etymology.historical_story: Bunuhlah illustrates how Malay builds an instruction without changing a verb's basic meaning. Bunuh supplies the action, while attached -lah highlights the speaker's intention. Depending on context and intonation, the result may urge, insist, or exhort. Its story is therefore one of productive grammar rather than a separate borrowed word or an independently established historical root. See [DBP on emphatic particles](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/03/16/2777/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bunuh＝杀死；末尾加 lah，像中文补上一声“吧／啦”。记住动作意义不变，变化的是说话语气。

senses.zh_definition: 进行身体锻炼；做操或进行有助于身体活动与健康的运动。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary places bersenam under senam, alongside senaman and menyenamkan. This family links an activity, its practice, and causing bodily movement. An older recorded sense means stretching after sleep, whereas the everyday modern sense is exercising. That contrast offers a useful cultural image: the same lexical family connects the body's first stretch with deliberate physical training. See [DBP: senam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=senam).
