etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve bini alongside older courtly expressions such as bini aji and bini gahara. These combinations show how vocabulary for wives and consorts reflected distinctions in royal households. In contemporary Malaysian usage, the main learning issue is register: bini is less polite than isteri. Its deeper origin remains unestablished here.

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接在 sandar 前，词根开头的 s 保留，不发生鼻音替换。原包将整个 bersandar 标为词根，现依 [DBP PRPM：sandar / bersandar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bersandar) 的词族分析纠正为 sandar。

word_family.gloss: 使靠着；把希望或论点寄托、建立于某事

senses.zh_definition: 倚靠；斜靠。身体或物体靠在某个支撑物上，以获得支撑或舒适。
senses.en_definition: To lean or rest against something for support or comfort.
senses.ms_definition: Berada dalam keadaan badan atau sesuatu benda bertumpu pada penyokong supaya stabil atau selesa.
senses.nuances: 通常为不及物用法；支撑物可用 pada 引出。若明确表示把某物放成倚靠状态，通常用 menyandarkan。词义依据 [DBP PRPM：bersandar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bersandar)，马来文释义为据此改写。

senses.zh_definition: 依靠；仰赖。把他人的帮助或某种支持作为生活、发展或行动的支撑。
senses.en_definition: To rely on someone or something for help or support.
senses.ms_definition: Mengharapkan bantuan atau sokongan daripada seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 由身体倚靠延伸为抽象依赖；bersandar pada bantuan 表示依赖援助。是否带有批评意味，由 terlalu 等修饰语和语境决定。词义依据 [DBP PRPM：bersandar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bersandar)。

senses.zh_definition: 以某事为依据或基础；指观点、判断或论证建立在某种根据之上。
senses.en_definition: To rest on something as a basis or justification.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai sesuatu sebagai asas atau alasan bagi pendapat, pertimbangan atau hujah.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 抽象义中“有根据”的分支，教学上与依赖援助分列。注意 bersandar pada bukti 与 bersandarkan bukti 的结构差别。词义依据 [DBP PRPM：bersandar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bersandar)。

etymology.historical_story: Bersandar combines the Malay prefix ber- with sandar. Its dictionary meanings connect bodily support with reliance and justification. A wall supports a tired person; assistance supports a project; evidence supports an argument. This progression provides a useful semantic learning account. The available sources do not establish a deeper historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sandar 想成“支撑点”：身体靠墙、生活靠援助、论点靠证据；ber- + sandar 就是处于有所依靠的状态。

etymology.historical_story: Malay labuh describes something hanging or extending downwards. Its family also includes lowering an anchor, a vessel stopping, and pelabuhan, a harbour. Curtains and ships therefore belong to the same recorded word family. The downward movement of cloth and an anchor offers a useful connection, although it does not establish which meaning developed first. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=labuh)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 la-buh 念成两拍：第一拍想象帘子垂下，第二拍想象船锚落下；帘子垂着，船就停着。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入指定的直接基础词 buktikan；更深层词根为 bukti。-kan 构成动词，-nya 在这里通常是指代前文内容的宾语后附代词，归入 suffix 仅为适配格式。ny 表示 /ɲ/；命令式可省去 meN-，常规主动陈述式则用 membuktikannya。

senses.zh_definition: 证明它；拿出证据证实前文所指的说法、事实或指控，常用于要求对方举证。
senses.en_definition: Prove it; establish the truth of a previously mentioned claim or fact with evidence.
senses.ms_definition: Nyatakan atau sahkan kebenaran perkara yang dirujuk dengan mengemukakan bukti.
senses.nuances: -nya 通常指前文的说法或事情，而非表示“他的”。独立的 Buktikannya! 是直接命令“证明给我看！”。释义据 membuktikan 的相关义项综合改写，见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=bukti)。

senses.zh_definition: 以行动或表现把它证实出来；展示前文提及的能力、诚意或决心。
senses.en_definition: Demonstrate it through actions or performance, especially a stated ability or commitment.
senses.ms_definition: Perlihatkan kebolehan, kesungguhan atau sifat yang dirujuk melalui tindakan atau pencapaian.
senses.nuances: 侧重实际表现，未必涉及文献或实验举证。被证明的内容须由上下文提供。此义依据 membuktikan 的“ memperlihatkan ”义综合改写，见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=bukti)。

etymology.historical_story: The history of buktikannya has two layers: the older evidence word bukti and productive Malay grammar. Scholarship on Sanskrit influence discusses bukti alongside forms associated with possession, manifestation, and proof; its semantic history is more complex than a simple modern translation. Malay adds kan to form the verb and nya to refer back to the claim. See [NUSA](https://sealang.net/archives/nusa/pdf/nusa-v19-p1-38.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Bahtera is traced to Sanskrit vahitra, meaning a boat or vessel. In Malay, the word belongs especially to classical and literary descriptions of large ships. Its nautical image also supports familiar metaphors: life becomes a voyage, while marriage becomes a vessel that partners must steer together. These figurative expressions preserve the word's literary character in contemporary usage.

etymology.historical_story: Berkunci belongs to a practical vocabulary of doors, boxes, and protected belongings. Malay builds it transparently from kunci and ber-, turning the lock into a property or state of its object. The dictionary preserves both possibilities: something may have a lock, or it may already be locked. Context tells the reader whether equipment or present access is being described.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kunci 是“锁、钥匙”；ber- 表示“具有或处于某状态”：berkunci＝带锁或锁着。看到 dah berkunci，就想到“已经锁了”。

etymology.historical_story: Malay borrowed bunker from English. Earlier Scots usage included a bench or chest that could serve as a seat. English subsequently used the word for coal storage, golf sand pits, and defensive shelters. The deeper origin remains uncertain; these changing uses explain why one Malay headword now belongs to three different specialist settings. [Etymological history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/bunker)

etymology.historical_story: The English name combines base and ball, highlighting the game's running stations and central equipment. Baseball developed within a wider tradition of bat-and-ball games rather than appearing fully formed through one inventor. Its organization became strongly associated with American culture. Malay uses the adapted spelling besbol, while English names often retain baseball. [Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/exhibitions/baseball-americana/about-this-exhibition/origins-and-early-days/)

etymology.historical_story: Bahu is a Sanskrit loan associated with bāhu, meaning arm or upper arm. Malay uses it for the shoulder, a body part that also supplies images of carrying burdens and sharing responsibility. Bahunya combines this established noun with the possessive clitic -nya, allowing one compact form to mean his shoulder, her shoulder, or its shoulder. [Historical dictionary evidence](https://wallace-online.org/converted/pdf/1852_Crawfurd_WS5.2.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Belakangku is a transparent Malay combination rather than a separate historical root. Belakang names the back or rear, while -ku is the attached form of aku, meaning I. The same attachment pattern produces rumahku and bukuku. In belakangku, the speaker becomes the reference point for either bodily possession or spatial position. See [DBP's explanation of ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kau+pasif).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: belakang＝后面，-ku＝我的：背部是“我的背”，位置是“我的后方”；看到di belakangku就想到“在我身后”。

etymology.historical_story: Berpeluk combines the Malay base peluk with the verbal prefix ber-. Its cultural imagery extends beyond affection: folded arms and arms wrapped around the knees also appear in established expressions. Dictionaries preserve both the bodily postures and their figurative association with inactivity, showing how an everyday gesture becomes a judgment about participation. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=berpeluk)

etymology.historical_story: Bius is generally traced to Persian bī-hosh, meaning unconscious or insensible. Malay treats the borrowed form as a complete root and builds familiar derivatives such as membius and pembiusan around it. Its dictionary senses preserve a useful distinction between the substance administered and the resulting state of unconsciousness. [Etymological reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/bius)

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary places berdebar under debar, the beat of the heart or pulse. With ber-, that beat becomes an ongoing bodily experience. Malay readily connects the sensation with emotion: jantung highlights the physical heart, while hati can frame the same pounding as fear, suspense, or eager anticipation. The repeated form berdebar-debar makes the sensation especially vivid.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 de-bar 想成心跳的两拍“怦—怦”；ber-debar 就是心正在怦怦跳。这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

etymology.historical_story: Berbaju illustrates a productive Malay way of turning a clothing noun into a description of its wearer. Baju names the garment; ber- presents someone as wearing it. Expressions such as berbaju kurung and berbaju Melayu connect this everyday grammatical pattern with traditional dress. This explains its formation without assuming an unverified ultimate origin for baju.

etymology.historical_story: Blh is a shortened written form of boleh, created by retaining its consonant letters and omitting the vowels. DBP's SMS guidance lists this correspondence, documenting its place in compressed electronic writing. The abbreviation carries the meanings of the expanded word rather than introducing a separate spoken word, so readers usually recover boleh from the surrounding sentence. [Source: DBP SMS guidance](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/khidmatsms.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: The standard word bekerjasama builds on kerjasama, a compound joining kerja, meaning work, and sama, meaning together or alike. Its meaning connects naturally with gotong-royong, collective work through mutual help. The spelling follows the exceptional be- form also seen in bekerja. Berkerjasama retains an extra r and should be treated as a spelling error rather than a separate historical word.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kerja＝工作，sama＝一起：一起工作就是合作。记住 bekerja，再接 sama → bekerjasama，前面不多加 r。

etymology.historical_story: Bridget is an English form of the Irish name Brighid, traced through Old Irish Brigit to a Celtic name associated with exalted status. etymology.historical_story: Business descends from Old English bisignes, associated with care, occupation, and being busy. Its history helps explain why modern English uses it for both commerce and matters requiring attention. Commercial activity became a central meaning, but expressions about personal business preserve the broader connection with someone's concerns. This is English word history, not evidence of official Malay lexical status. [English etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/business)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 business 和 busy 联系起来：忙着经营的是“生意”，忙着处理的也可能是“事务”。现代 business 通常只读两个音节。

etymology.historical_story: Before continues Old English beforan, which already connected position in front with earlier time. Modern English retains both ideas: someone can stand before a mirror or arrive before noon. Its additional use for priority reflects a similar ordering of things. These historical relationships belong to English; Malay normally expresses the relevant meanings with several different words. [American Heritage 词源与词义](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=before)

etymology.historical_story: Barfi belongs to a South Asian sweet-making tradition. Historical lexicography connects the name with Persian barfi, meaning snowy or icy, and with barf, snow. The pale appearance of milk barfi offers a memorable association with that meaning. In Malaysia, the sweet is also made by Punjabi families and enjoyed during celebrations, including Vaisakhi and Deepavali. [Lexical history](https://ruj.uj.edu.pl/server/api/core/bitstreams/77077db4-1b92-41e2-8e89-f1e43a6bfe10/content); [Malaysian context](https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/leisure/2025/04/08/finding-sweet-success-in-the-business-of-barfi)

etymology.historical_story: Biara derives from Sanskrit vihāra, a word associated with monastic residence. Its Malay history illustrates how a borrowed religious term can remain useful beyond its original setting. Malaysian dictionaries apply biara to communities of Christian or Buddhist ascetics, so the surrounding religious context determines the most suitable English or Chinese translation. [Linguistic study](https://roa.rutgers.edu/content/article/files/1262_sloos_1.pdf), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=biara)

etymology.historical_story: Belakangmu illustrates how Malay builds personal reference onto an ordinary spatial word. Belakang names both the back of the body and the space behind it; the attached pronoun -mu makes either meaning personal. The same construction suits intimate address, written instructions and literary dialogue, although everyday speakers also use separate pronouns.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 belakang＝后面，再把 -mu 看成‘你’的小尾巴：belakangmu＝你的背／你后面。

Its dictionary examples cover both matching objects and people moving together. This shared pattern explains why classroom partners, dance partners and matching items fit naturally under one word.

etymology.historical_story: English bean continues Old English bēan, a word for beans and related pulses. Its history belongs to the Germanic vocabulary, rather than Malay affixation. In Malaysian bilingual materials, the English spelling may appear beside Malay ingredient names. Translators therefore identify the actual plant or food before choosing kacang, biji or another suitable equivalent.

etymology.historical_story: Berkaki combines kaki, meaning foot or leg, with ber-, which here expresses possession. Its literal structure is straightforward, while familiar expressions add cultural imagery. Berkaki ayam means going barefoot, and berkaki seribu pictures a frightened escape through exaggerated speed. These expressions illustrate how an everyday body-part word can support both practical description and vivid figurative language.

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 加在名词 teknologi 前，表示“具有技术”。前缀保持 ber-，词根首辅音 t 保留，无鼻音同化。ber 中 e 读 /ə/，词根 ték 中 é 读 /e/；输入释义已给出音节提示 ber.ték.no.lo.gi。

word_family.gloss: 生物技术；同属 teknologi 词族，bio- 为科学构词成分

senses.zh_definition: 具有技术；具备或采用某种技术，常用于说明社会、产业、设备等所拥有的技术水平或类型。
senses.en_definition: To possess or be equipped with technology, especially of a specified level or kind.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai teknologi.
senses.nuances: 核心释义来自输入包所引《Kamus Dewan》第四版。属于 ber- 构成的状态性不及物动词，可在名词后作修饰语。单独使用并不自动表示“高科技”；tinggi、moden 或具体技术名称才进一步限定其水平或类型。与名词 teknologi“技术”和使用技术的动作表达 menggunakan teknologi 应作区分。

etymology.historical_story: Berteknologi shows how Malay can build a new predicate around an international scientific word. The inherited prefix ber- contributes possession, while teknologi supplies the technical concept. The international word family ultimately connects with Greek discussions of arts and skilled practice. This distant history should be distinguished from the immediate Malay formation: ber- plus teknologi. [Merriam-Webster: technology](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/technology)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ber- 想成“具有”，teknologi 想成“技术”：berteknologi 就是“具有技术”；再加 tinggi，才明确成为“具有高科技”。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接在 jarak 前，词根首音保持不变；马来西亚常见读音中，词尾 k 实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]。

etymology.historical_story: The word builds on jarak, meaning distance or an interval, with the Malay prefix ber-, expressing a state of having that distance. Its concrete spatial image also supports a figurative reading: people can be separated emotionally as well as physically. The two dictionary senses connect measurable space with human relationships.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jarak 记作“距离”，ber- 记作“有”：berjarak 就是“有距离”，既能隔着几米，也能心里疏远。

etymology.historical_story: Berbelanja combines ber- with belanja, linking the activity of shopping to the money it requires. Its dictionary examples range from preparations for Hari Raya to government spending on schools. That cultural span makes the word useful across household and public life: both festive purchases and institutional expenditure belong within its meaning.

etymology.historical_story: Barah carries several layers of Malay experience in one word. DBP preserves its meaning of a large suppurating boil alongside cancer and a destructive social condition. Traditional names and modern public discourse therefore meet in the same entry. These coexisting senses offer a cultural vocabulary story, but they do not establish the word's ultimate origin or a dated sequence of semantic change.

senses.ms_definition: Mendatangkan tuah atau mempunyai kesaktian menurut kepercayaan atau cerita, dengan -nya menegaskan sifat tersebut.

etymology.historical_story: Bertuahnya combines bertuah with the attached element -nya; bertuah itself is formed from ber- and tuah. Malay dictionaries give tuah a cultural range extending from ordinary good fortune to a reputed power that brings blessings or success. This helps explain why people can describe both a fortunate person and a supposedly powerful heirloom as bertuah. Everyday exclamations usually invoke good fortune. [DBP](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=tuah)

etymology.historical_story: Berborak combines the Malay prefix ber- with borak, which Kamus Dewan describes as friendly, informal conversation about matters of little seriousness. Its meaning readily evokes people sitting together and passing time through conversation. The consulted dictionary supports this formation and usage, but supplies no dated account of the root’s earlier origin. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=borak).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: borak 是“闲聊”，加上表示活动的 ber-：berborak，就是开聊。

etymology.historical_story: Beijing represents the Chinese name 北京, literally northern capital: běi means north and jīng means capital. The name contrasts naturally with Nanjing, southern capital. Older international writing also uses Peking. These forms belong to the history of representing Chinese place names in other languages, rather than to Malay affixation. [Beijing tourism authority](https://english.visitbeijing.com.cn/article/47OMhkXlgaL)

etymology.historical_story: Batal belongs to Malay's Arabic loan vocabulary. Winstedt's historical grammar already lists it among Arabic-derived words, glossing it as futile. Modern Malay connects the word with validity as well as cancellation: an agreement may be void, a ritual invalid, or a planned outing called off. These uses share the idea that something no longer holds or takes effect. [Historical source](https://www.sabrizain.org/malaya/library/grammarwinstedt.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Brooke entered Sarawak's historical vocabulary as an English family name. James Brooke acquired political authority there in 1841, and the dynasty's rule ended with cession to Britain in 1946. The name therefore appears in accounts of rulers, administration and heritage. It identifies a family rather than a Malay title or a word formed with Malay affixes. [Source: Brooke Heritage Trust](https://www.brooketrust.org/history-of-sarawak)

etymology.historical_story: Malay tinju denotes both a clenched fist and a blow delivered with it. Adding ber- turns that concrete image into an activity: exchanging punches. This connection explains why bertinju can describe either organised boxing or an ordinary fistfight. The related petinju names the boxer, while meninju directs attention to striking someone. See [DBP: tinju](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=tinju).

etymology.historical_story: The Malay stem siul names a whistle or an animal call, while ber- turns it into an activity. The dictionary connects human whistling with birdsong and also records a snake's hiss. These meanings show how a sound word can link people and their natural surroundings. They provide a cultural memory route without establishing an earlier foreign source. See [DBP: siul](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243492&keyword=siul).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 siul 的音想成一声“咻——”；前面加 ber-，就是正在做这个动作：bersiul＝吹口哨。

etymology.historical_story: Battousai belongs to the fictional world of Rurouni Kenshin. The story connects the feared epithet with Kenshin's violent past during Japan's Bakumatsu upheaval, then contrasts that reputation with his later vow never to kill again. Its cultural force comes from this tension between an old identity and a changed life. [Official story](https://rurounikenshin-anime.com/story/intro.html).

etymology.historical_story: Berita belongs to Malay’s Sanskrit-derived vocabulary of information and reporting. An etymological study connects it with Sanskrit vṛtta, associated with an occurrence or account. Beritanya adds the Malay clitic -nya to that established noun: the borrowed vocabulary item participates in ordinary Malay grammar, allowing speakers to refer back to someone’s news or an already mentioned report. [Etymological study](https://asianethnology.org/downloads/ae/pdf/a150.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 berita＝消息，再接 -nya＝他／她／它的或前面提到的：beritanya 就是“相关消息”；具体指谁，看上下文。

morphology.pattern_note: 此形式保留 ber-，词根 terbang 不变；ter- 是词根的一部分，不是额外前缀。词根末尾 /ŋ/ 与 -an 衔接，ng 始终表示一个辅音 /ŋ/。ber-...-an 在此表示多个主体四处飞动。

senses.zh_definition: 成群飞翔；多个飞行主体向各处飞动。
senses.en_definition: To fly about in numbers or in various directions.
senses.ms_definition: Terbang beramai-ramai atau bergerak dengan terbang ke pelbagai arah dan tempat.
senses.nuances: 不及物动词，突出多个主体或分散飞动，而非单纯表示某一只鸟正在飞。正式表达通常用 burung berterbangan，无须再将 burung 重叠以表示复数。[DBP：berterbangan 的语法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=berterbangan)

etymology.historical_story: Berterbangan illustrates Malay’s productive word formation rather than a separate borrowed origin. The root terbang supplies the idea of flight, while ber-...-an presents multiple participants or movement in different directions. The resulting verb covers both birds moving through the sky and dust scattered through the air, linking living flight with the visible motion of light material. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=berterbangan)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve two striking semantic worlds under bual: bubbling water and human chatter. Modern learners usually encounter the conversational family in berbual, perbualan, and temu bual. Imagining speech bubbling like spring water makes a useful learning image, but dictionary grouping alone does not establish that one meaning historically developed from the other.

etymology.historical_story: Baghdad’s name predates the Abbasid capital founded there in 762. Scholars connect it with Iranian elements meaning roughly ‘god’ and ‘given’, although historical explanations vary. The new capital also bore the official name Madinat al-Salam, ‘City of Peace’. Malay retains Baghdad as a whole place name, rather than translating or reanalysing its ancient components. [Historical reference](https://www.iranicaonline.org/articles/baghdad/baghdad-iranian-connection-i-pr-mongol/)

etymology.historical_story: The supplied Kamus Dewan entry records bok as a regional name for a mattress in Johor and Kedah. This documents geographical usage, but does not establish when the word arose or which earlier language supplied it. Its cultural interest lies in the coexistence of a local household term with the widely understood Malay word tilam.

morphology.pattern_note: 最外层为前缀 ber-，因此 affix_type 标为 prefix；内部 pendidikan 由 peN-…-an 构成，peN- 在 /d/ 前实现为 pen-，保留 d。所列读音把词干末 k 实现为 /ʔ/，也可听到 /k/。输入 Jawi 字段原样保留，但 ڤنديديقن 对应 pendidikan；完整词形为 برڤنديديقن。输入 root_jawi 含多余的 بر，didik 应写作 ديديق。

etymology.historical_story: This word tells its story through productive Malay morphology rather than an established foreign source. Didik names the act of educating or nurturing; pendidikan names education; berpendidikan describes someone who has received it. The supplied Kamus Dewan example connects the word with Western-educated Malay intellectuals and debates over Malay as an official language, illustrating its use for educational background.

etymology.historical_story: BMW takes its letters from Bayerische Motoren Werke, a German name referring to Bavaria and engine manufacturing. The initials preserve that industrial background even when speakers use them simply to identify a car. In Malay conversation, the brand can stand for the vehicle itself, while formal descriptions can specify kereta BMW or motosikal BMW. [BMW official history](https://www.bmw.ca/en/more-bmw/why-bmw.html).

etymology.historical_story: Rencana has a broad recorded range: a story, written account, draft, agenda, or plan. Berencana selects the planning sense and adds ber-, presenting an activity as having a plan behind it. The connection is memorable: arranging ideas on a page and arranging actions in advance both give otherwise scattered material an intelligible order. [DBP rencana](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=rencana)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rencana 想成桌上的计划表：加上 ber-，就是“带着计划做事”。

senses.en_definition: Swamp forest; woodland growing on waterlogged ground.
senses.ms_definition: Hutan yang berpaya-paya; hutan rawa.
senses.nuances: 对应 Kamus Dewan 的 baran I，属于较少见的环境或地貌用语；日常交流通常说 hutan paya。此义的固定组合有限，不宜把例示搭配当作高频日常表达。[DBP：baran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=baran)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve two separate entries under this spelling: a swamp forest and a person who readily becomes angry. The familiar expression panas baran connects the second meaning with the everyday image of heat. Their shared spelling does not establish a shared origin, and neither entry supports deriving baran from bar plus a suffix. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=baran).

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接数量词表示若干个该数量单位；bilion 的首辅音 b 保留，不发生鼻音替换。音标采用元音分读形式，连读可更紧凑。

word_family.gloss: 十亿；旧式长级差用法另有所指

senses.zh_definition: 数十亿的；以十亿计的，表示若干个十亿或非常庞大的数量，不指定确切数值。
senses.en_definition: Amounting to several billion; numbering in the billions.
senses.ms_definition: Beberapa bilion, beberapa banyak bilion.
senses.nuances: 实际语法类别是 kata bilangan tak tentu（不定数词）；受给定词性枚举限制，pos 暂映射为 adjective。现代数量表达通常以 satu bilion = 1,000,000,000 理解，中文为“十亿”，不可误译为“一亿”。DBP 较早释义还记录 10¹² 的旧英国用法，阅读历史文献应核对计数体系。berbilion-bilion 是常见重叠形式。[DBP：bilion 与 berbilion](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bilion)；[DBP：数学术语中的 bilion](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=bilion)

etymology.historical_story: Berbilion shows how Malay builds an indefinite quantity from a numerical base: ber- combines with bilion to express billions. DBP also records berbilion-bilion. Its dictionary material preserves the older contrast between billion as a million million and as a thousand million, explaining why historical figures sometimes require careful interpretation. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bilion)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bilion 是“十亿”；加 ber- 就想到“一批批十亿”，即数十亿。

senses.nuances: 通常写作 Blackbeard，首字母大写；此处按历史人物释义，具体作品中的同名角色须结合语境判断。它不是马来语中泛指黑胡须的普通名词；普通名词应说 janggut hitam。输入未提供 DBP 释义、音节或 Jawi，缺项保留 null；status 按指定格式填写，不表示该专名获得 DBP 词条认证。人物依据：[Smithsonian 人物介绍](https://americanhistory.si.edu/explore/exhibitions/on-the-water/online/living-atlantic-world/pirates/edward-teach-blackbeard)。

etymology.historical_story: Blackbeard is an English nickname built from black and beard. Edward Teach's conspicuous dark beard supplied the name, while accounts of smoking fuses before battle helped establish his intimidating image. His story belongs to Atlantic maritime history; the name should therefore be learned as a historical proper noun rather than a Malay descriptive word. [Smithsonian account](https://americanhistory.si.edu/explore/exhibitions/on-the-water/online/living-atlantic-world/pirates/edward-teach-blackbeard).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: black＝黑，beard＝胡须；把两个英语词拼成一张海盗的脸，就是 Blackbeard“黑胡子”。

etymology.historical_story: The currency name commemorates the Spanish explorer Vasco Núñez de Balboa. Panama established the balboa as its national monetary unit in 1904. Malay uses the currency name as a whole borrowing, so its apparent parts should not be interpreted as Malay roots or affixes. [Panamanian legal record](https://infojuridica.procuraduria-admon.gob.pa/norma_screen?numsec=26718), [dictionary etymology](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/balboa)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 balboa 和 Panama 放在同一张旅行钱币卡上：巴拿马的钱币单位叫巴波亚。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 表示具有某物或处于某种状态；词根 nyawa 保持不变，ny 表示一个鼻音 /ɲ/。此处构成不及物动词。

senses.zh_definition: 具有生命；活着。
senses.en_definition: To possess life; to be alive.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai nyawa; hidup.
senses.nuances: 常用于说明人或动物是否仍然活着，也用于 makhluk bernyawa 等名词修饰结构。tidak bernyawa 可表示已经死亡或本来没有生命，须依上下文判断。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=bernyawa)

senses.zh_definition: 比喻场所、商业或社会活动呈现活力，有各种活动进行。
senses.en_definition: To be alive with activity; to show vitality.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai kegiatan yang berlangsung dan memperlihatkan suasana yang hidup atau aktif.

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈及死亡时须顾及家属感受。确认有人去世后，直接交流通常可用 meninggal dunia 等较委婉表达；不要把仍在抢救的人随意描述为 tidak bernyawa。

etymology.historical_story: The Malay noun nyawa denotes life and the animating spirit. Adding ber- creates the transparent idea of possessing life. The dictionary also records a figurative use: a place can be bernyawa when activity fills it. This connects bodily life with the social energy of markets, streets and neighbourhoods, making an active town feel like a living body.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: nyawa＝生命；ber-＝具有：bernyawa 就是“具有生命”。再把热闹街区想成恢复心跳的身体，即可记住比喻义。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接在 ganti 前，词根首音 /ɡ/ 保留，不发生 meN- 类鼻音替换；前缀中的 e 读 /ə/。

senses.zh_definition: 更换；改变；由原来的名称、衣着、状态或所属关系转为另一种。
senses.en_definition: To change or switch from one name, set of clothes, state, or affiliation to another.
senses.ms_definition: Bertukar atau berubah daripada sesuatu kepada yang lain, termasuk nama, pakaian atau keadaan.
senses.nuances: 通常为不及物用法；berganti pakaian 表示换衣服，不能据此把所有“替换某物”的句子都改用 berganti。主动替换特定对象通常用 mengganti 或 menggantikan，依搭配选择。释义依据输入所引《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》。

senses.zh_definition: 交替；接续；一个人、事物或时段过去，由另一个接上。
senses.en_definition: To alternate or succeed one another, including successive periods of time.
senses.ms_definition: Bertukar secara berurutan atau bergiliran; sesuatu menyusul selepas yang sebelumnya.
senses.nuances: 常用于时间流转和轮替。silih berganti 强调接连交替；单独的 berganti 不一定表示多人按计划轮班。释义依据输入所引《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》。

etymology.historical_story: Berganti memperlihatkan pembentukan kata Melayu melalui awalan ber- dan dasar ganti. Idea pertukaran itu bergerak antara pengalaman harian, seperti menukar pakaian, dengan gambaran perjalanan masa. Ungkapan hari berganti hari menjadikan waktu seolah-olah datang mengambil tempat waktu sebelumnya. Cerita ini menerangkan hubungan makna yang masih hidup, tanpa menetapkan asal purba ganti yang belum disahkan.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ganti 记成“换”，ber- + ganti 就是“发生更换”：衣服换一套，日子换一天。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根 kekal 不发生辅音变化；加 -an 后，词根末尾的 l 与后续元音连读，形成 ber.ke.ka.lan。ber- 与 ke- 中的 e 均读 /ə/。

senses.zh_definition: 持续存在或延续很长时间，甚至永久，不消失或不发生根本变化。
senses.en_definition: To endure or remain in existence for a very long time or permanently.
senses.ms_definition: Sentiasa ada atau berterusan untuk sepanjang masa atau lama sekali; berlanjutan.
senses.nuances: 属于表达持续状态的不及物动词，也常译为“持久的”。可用于友谊、和平、影响或不利状况，并不自带褒义。语境中的长久延续不一定是字面上的永远。马来文释义据 [DBP：berkekalan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=berkekalan) 整理。

etymology.historical_story: Berkekalan belongs to the kekal family, whose related forms distinguish enduring from actively preserving something: berkekalan describes continuity, while mengekalkan means maintaining it. DBP illustrates the word through the survival of a written text and the continuation of a curfew. Those contrasting examples show that endurance can describe either something treasured or an unwelcome condition. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=berkekalan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听见 ke-kal，记住“持续留着”；ber-ke-ka-lan 把这个状态延展开：一直都在，长久不散。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接在 bogel 前表示处于该状态，词根不变。ber- 中的 e 读 /ə/，bogel 中的 e 为 e taling，读 /e/。

etymology.historical_story: The transparent formation is ber- plus bogel: an adjective describing nakedness becomes a verb describing being naked. DBP's dictionary examples place berbogel in ordinary childcare, including bathing a baby, rather than defining it as inherently sexual. The same lexical family includes membogelkan, making someone naked, and kebogelan, the condition of nakedness. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=bogel)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bogel 记作“光着”，ber- 表示处于这种状态：berbogel＝身上光着、没穿衣服。注意末尾 gel 读 /ɡel/。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根 belakang 整体保留，不能拆成 be- + lakang。加 -an 后，词尾 /ŋ/ 成为下一音节的声母；ng 表示一个鼻音 /ŋ/。

senses.zh_definition: 近来；最近一段时间，通常与 ini 连用。
senses.en_definition: Recently; lately, especially in the expression belakangan ini.
senses.ms_definition: Sejak masa-masa yang kemudian ini; akhir-akhir ini.
senses.nuances: belakangan ini 与 kebelakangan ini 均用于近期情况，不能机械理解为“在后面”。马来西亚正式写作中 kebelakangan ini 也很自然。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=belakangan)

senses.zh_definition: 后来；最终，表示事情在先前阶段之后出现的变化或结果。
senses.en_definition: Later; eventually, introducing a subsequent development or outcome.
senses.ms_definition: Kesudahannya, akhirnya, kemudian.
senses.nuances: 常与 mula-mula 等先行阶段形成对照；不一定表示漫长等待。马来西亚日常交流也常用 kemudian、akhirnya 或 lepas itu，按具体意思选择。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=belakangan)

senses.zh_definition: 较后；在别人之后，指到达或行动的先后次序，带雅加达地域色彩。
senses.en_definition: Later than others; after someone else, in Jakarta Malay usage.
senses.ms_definition: Lebih kemudian daripada orang lain dari segi waktu atau urutan.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》标为 Jk，即雅加达用法。马来西亚正式表达宜按语境使用 kemudian、selepas orang lain 或 lebih lewat；不要把这一地域义当作所有马来西亚口语的默认用法。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=belakangan)

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这个词本身中性，礼貌程度取决于句子内容和称呼。对上司或长辈询问近况时，用 Encik、Puan 等称呼，避免直接使用 kau。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: belakangan ini 可用于正式报告和日常交流。谈近期变化时应把 ini 一并记住；表达空间位置“在后面”通常用 di belakang。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这个词本身中性，礼貌程度取决于句子内容和称呼。对上司或长辈询问近况时，用 Encik、Puan 等称呼，避免直接使用 kau。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: belakangan ini 可用于正式报告和日常交流。谈近期变化时应把 ini 一并记住；表达空间位置“在后面”通常用 di belakang。

etymology.historical_story: Belakangan turns the spatial idea of belakang, the back or rear, into a way of locating events in time. Something behind an earlier event can be understood as coming later. The established phrase belakangan ini instead points to the recent period. This is a useful semantic connection for learners, rather than a dated account of the word's first appearance. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=belakangan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: belakang 是“后面”，加 -an 想到时间上的“后来”；一看到 belakangan ini，就整块记成“近来”。

morphology.pattern_note: 外语专名，整词记忆，无马来语词缀变化。所列音标采用德语读法；其他语言及本人读法可能不同。资料包未提供音节和爪夷文，保留 null；无可确认的马来语派生词族。

etymology.historical_story: Brandt has more than one surname origin. German and Swiss German families may derive it from a landscape designation for land cleared by burning, or from the older personal name Brand. Scandinavian examples may reflect German transmission or related naming traditions. These alternatives explain the surname generally; they do not establish any individual family's ancestry. [Source: Dictionary of American Family Names](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/brandt?geo-lang=en).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Brandt 与名牌上的“布兰特”绑定记忆；德语读音只有一个音节，末尾 dt 不另添元音。这是姓名记忆法，不是马来语词根分析。

morphology.formula: ber- + abad → berabad；常用重叠形式：ber- + abad-abad → berabad-abad
morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接元音起首的 abad 时保留 r，前缀 e 读 /ə/；音节据构词补全。数据包爪夷文 ابد 是词根 abad；完整 berabad 应写 برابد。DBP 明确收录的常用派生形式为 berabad-abad。

word_family.gloss: 历时数百年；好几个世纪

senses.zh_definition: 表示时间以世纪计、历经漫长年代；现代标准表达通常使用重叠形式 berabad-abad，意为数百年、好几个世纪。
senses.en_definition: For a span measured in centuries; normally used in the reduplicated form berabad-abad, meaning for centuries.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bentuk lazim berabad-abad: beratus-ratus tahun atau beberapa abad lamanya.
senses.nuances: 数据包释义来自词根 abad“一百年”，不能直接当成 berabad 的独立释义。单独 berabad 较少见，可见于诗性或压缩表达；一般写作和口语使用 berabad-abad，故以下搭配与例句采用该形式。它不表示严格的一百年；严格的一百年用 seabad。[DBP 派生词释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=berabad-abad)

etymology.historical_story: The base abad is an Arabic loanword that Malay uses for a century. Malay word formation supplies seabad for one century and berabad-abad for a duration of centuries. This distinction matters in historical writing: the base names a time unit, while the reduplicated expression presents a long span without specifying an exact number of years. [Arabic loanword research](https://oarep.usim.edu.my/server/api/core/bitstreams/b38963e9-99b5-417c-af79-7f0f570e28db/content), [DBP meanings](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=berabad-abad).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: abad 是一个“百年格”；seabad 填一格，berabad-abad 把格子连续铺开，表示好几个世纪。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留原包的直接基底 bincangkan；更底层的词根是 bincang。-kan 构成及物动词，-nya 是附着代词，此处通常作宾语，并非派生后缀。-kan + -nya 写作 -kannya，n 与 ny 分属前后两个部分。

senses.zh_definition: 讨论它；就前文已提到的事情进行商议或分析。用于指令时，可译为“讨论一下这件事”。
senses.en_definition: Discuss it or examine the previously mentioned matter through discussion.
senses.ms_definition: Membicarakan atau membahas perkara yang telah disebut atau diketahui dalam konteks.
senses.nuances: -nya 的指代对象须由上下文确定；此处一般指事情、建议或问题。该形式适用于祈使句，如 Sila bincangkannya，以及无 meN- 前缀的代词被动结构，如 Perkara itu akan saya bincangkan；带 -nya 时也可见 Akan saya bincangkannya。正式主动陈述一般用 membincangkannya，如 Kami akan membincangkannya。official 表示这是规范构词形式，不表示它是独立收录的 DBP 词头；本条释义为编辑概述。词义依据见 [DBP：bincang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bincang)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 使用 -nya 前应确保对方知道所指何事。讨论敏感问题时，明确议题并选择合适场合；若表达“我们将讨论它”的正式主动句，应使用 Kami akan membincangkannya。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates how Malay builds meaning through morphology and reference. The base bincang belongs to the vocabulary of discussion; -kan forms a transitive verb, while attached -nya points back to something already known. In a request, the result means discuss it. It is a grammatical combination rather than a separate historical borrowing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 三步记忆：bincang＝讨论；-kan＝讨论某个对象；-nya＝前面提过的它。合起来就是“讨论这件事”。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为借词整体记忆，分为 bal.ko.ni 三个音节；词尾 -i 不是本词中的马来语后缀。ber- + balkoni → berbalkoni，表示“有阳台”，词根拼写不变。

word_family.gloss: 多个阳台；由全词重叠构成

senses.zh_definition: 阳台；位于建筑物楼上、供人到室外休息或乘凉的小平台。

senses.nuances: 常用于住宅、酒店和公寓的阳台。与通常位于地面的庭院或露台不同，核心空间特征是位于楼上。具体建筑名称仍以实际设计为准。[DBP《Kamus Dewan》第四版](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=balkoni)

senses.zh_definition: 电影院的楼座；位于楼上观众席区域的座位。
senses.en_definition: The upper-level seating area in a cinema.
senses.ms_definition: Tempat duduk di tingkat atas pada panggung wayang.
senses.nuances: 此义指室内的楼层观众席，需结合电影院或票务语境理解；不表示室外阳台，也不自动表示贵宾席。[DBP《Kamus Dewan》第四版](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=balkoni)

etymology.historical_story: Balkoni belongs to the architectural vocabulary represented by English balcony and Italian balcone. The Accademia della Crusca documents the Italian origin of the English word. Malay dictionaries preserve two connected spatial meanings: an outdoor platform upstairs and upstairs cinema seating. The shared image is an elevated space; the precise route into Malay is not established by the supplied evidence. [Accademia della Crusca](https://www.italianismi.org/scheda-italianismo-scolastica/balcony/796)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bal-ko-ni，联想英语 balcony：先记“楼上伸出的小平台”，再联想电影院位于楼上的“楼座”。

morphology.pattern_note: 此处 buka 是表示幅面或宽度的名词，-nya 指回前述对象；严格说是附着代词，按本格式归入 suffix。ny 表示 /ɲ/，词根不变。音节由构词推定；输入的 بوک 是词根写法，完整形式补写为 بوکڽ。

word_family.gloss: 幅面；宽度；另有打开相关用法

senses.zh_definition: 其幅面、长宽尺度或横向宽度；由表示尺寸的 buka 加指回前述对象的 -nya 构成。
senses.en_definition: Its dimensions, extent, or breadth; buka in its dimensional sense followed by the referring enclitic -nya.
senses.ms_definition: Ukuran panjang dan lebar, keluasan atau jarak lintang sesuatu yang telah disebut, dengan -nya merujuk kepada benda tersebut.
senses.nuances: 本条按输入所指的尺寸义处理。现代日常表达通常使用 ukurannya、luasnya 或 lebarnya；bukanya 的这一用法较少见。它不同于否定词 bukannya，不能把两者混同。下列为词典所示的尺寸表达模式，不应理解为现代高频搭配。依据 [DBP：buka](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=buka+nya)。

etymology.historical_story: Bukanya combines buka with the referring enclitic -nya. The supplied dictionary passage preserves a less familiar dimensional use of buka, illustrated with measurements such as hasta and depa. These expressions evoke measurement through the human body. Modern readers usually encounter buka in connection with opening, so the older dimensional context is essential to understanding this particular form.

etymology.historical_story: The documented historical meaning of belati is foreign-made, especially European-made. Its established combinations preserve a small record of how goods were described by their provenance: pisau belati names a kind of knife, while tali belati names imported rope. etymology.historical_story: The story of bangganya lies in Malay word building. Bangga supplies the feeling of pride, while attached -nya helps shape its expression through emphasis, nominalisation or reference. A parent's exclamation, Bangganya saya!, makes the grammar memorable: the speaker is saya, so -nya cannot automatically mean his or her. Context supplies the interpretation. etymology.historical_story: Brooks illustrates how a name can travel into Malay writing without becoming a Malay common noun. Brooks England, for example, connects its business history to John Boultbee Brooks and an enterprise established in 1866. That documented example explains one use of the name, but cannot identify the referent of this isolated lowercase token. See [Brooks England](https://www.brooksengland.com/pages/about-us).

etymology.historical_story: Bentuknya combines bentuk, meaning shape or form, with attached -nya. The same root describes both visible outlines and abstract arrangements, making it useful in design, writing, and institutional discussion. The packet does not establish a deeper historical origin for bentuk; the secure analysis here is its productive formation within Malay.

etymology.historical_story: Berkasar shows a transparent Malay word-building pattern: ber- turns kasar into a verb describing conduct. The root covers physical roughness as well as a lack of gentleness or courtesy. In this derivative, the focus is on speaking or acting roughly. The movement from a rough surface to a rough manner offers a memorable semantic connection without requiring an unsupported story about the root's distant origin.

senses.zh_definition: 勃拉姆斯：德国姓氏，在古典音乐语境中通常指作曲家、钢琴家及指挥家约翰内斯·勃拉姆斯（1833—1897）。
senses.en_definition: Brahms: a German surname, usually referring in musical contexts to Johannes Brahms (1833–1897), the composer, pianist, and conductor.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Jerman yang dalam konteks muzik lazimnya merujuk kepada Johannes Brahms (1833–1897), seorang penggubah, pemain piano dan konduktor.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，须写作 Brahms。音乐交流中也可借指其作品，例如 mendengar Brahms 表示听勃拉姆斯的音乐。此处为专名释义，不冒充 DBP 普通词条；所要求的 official 标签不构成 DBP 收录证明。生平资料见 [Brahms-Institut](https://www.brahms-institut.de/application/files/6915/9282/6446/press_info_brahms_biography_engl.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Brahms enters Malay musical discourse as a retained German surname, rather than a Malay descriptive word. Johannes Brahms was born in Hamburg in 1833 and later settled in Vienna. His compositions made the surname internationally recognizable, allowing concertgoers to use it for both the composer and his music. [Brahms-Institut biography](https://www.brahms-institut.de/application/files/6915/9282/6446/press_info_brahms_biography_engl.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Brahms 的单音节读音与一记厚重的钢琴和弦相连：看到这个姓氏，就想到作曲家勃拉姆斯；这只是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

etymology.historical_story: Kata taraf dipinjam daripada bahasa Arab ṭaraf, yang antara maknanya ialah hujung atau sisi. Dalam bahasa Melayu, taraf digunakan bagi kedudukan, tingkatan dan mutu. Awalan ber- membentuk bertaraf, yakni mempunyai taraf tertentu. Perkataan ini memperlihatkan bagaimana kata pinjaman dapat menerima imbuhan Melayu dan digunakan untuk menerangkan institusi, kelayakan serta mutu perkhidmatan. [Kajian kata pinjaman Arab](https://ejal.info/menuscript/index.php/ejal/article/download/155/28/278).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ber- 想成“具有”，taraf 是“等级、水准”：bertaraf dunia 就是“具有世界级水准”。

etymology.historical_story: If this token is English, its history belongs to bone, which continues Old English bān and an older Germanic word. Bones adds the English plural ending. That history does not establish a Malay borrowing: without the original sentence, the supplied token could instead be a name or a data error. [Merriam-Webster: bone](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/bone)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语 bone 加复数 -s 成 bones；马来语用 tulang，数量可由上下文或数词表达。

senses.zh_definition: 山毛榉；山毛榉属（Fagus）的大乔木，叶片有光泽，树皮光滑、呈灰色；木材语境中也指其木料。
senses.en_definition: A beech tree of the genus Fagus, with glossy leaves and smooth grey bark; also its timber.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis pokok besar daripada genus Fagus yang mempunyai daun berkilat dan kulit kayu licin berwarna kelabu.
senses.nuances: 植物及木材名称；pokok bic 强调树木，kayu bic 强调木料。此处指 Fagus 属，并非泛指所有名称中带 beech 的树种。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=bic)；[英马对应词条](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/beech)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay bic closely resembles English beech in both sound and meaning, suggesting an English borrowing, although the cited dictionary does not establish its transmission history. Its practical setting is easy to picture: a furniture buyer encounters a timber name rather than a familiar garden tree. The expressions pokok bic and kayu bic distinguish the living tree from its wood.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bic 的读音接近英语 beech；把这个短音连到“灰色光滑树皮的山毛榉”，再用 kayu bic 记住它的木材。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此主要构成指称相遇或交汇事件的表达，读作 /ɲa/，前面的元音不脱落；更深层词根为 temu。资料包所给 برتمو 对应 bertemu，未包含 -nya；完整词形可写作 برتموڽ。headword.jawi 按要求保留资料包原值。

senses.zh_definition: 相遇、会面这一事件；常用于说明有关人物相见的时间、地点或结果。
senses.en_definition: The occurrence of people meeting or coming face to face.
senses.ms_definition: Hal atau peristiwa seseorang berjumpa atau bersemuka dengan orang lain.
senses.nuances: 这是 bertemu 加 -nya 后在名词性结构中的用法，例如 tempat bertemunya dua sahabat。不能机械译为“遇见他”，也不宜照搬英语说 saya bertemunya；表达“我见到他”通常用 saya bertemu dengannya 或 saya menemuinya。释义依 bertemu 综合编写。[DBP：bertemu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=bertemu)；[-nya 的名词化功能](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/03/16/2777/)。

collocations.en: the place where two friends meet

senses.nuances: 常见于地点说明和地理叙述，如 di sinilah bertemunya dua sungai；-nya 不表示某个人拥有河流。此义承接 bertemu 的“连接、合为一体”义。[DBP：bertemu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=bertemu)。

collocations.en: the point where two roads meet

senses.nuances: 属于“相遇、会合”的抽象延伸，适用于评论或较书面的叙述；具体是接触、融合还是一致，须由上下文判断。这类完整结构的词性按名词性用法标注，而其基础 bertemu 是动词。

etymology.historical_story: The base temu connects a family of Malay words about meeting and finding, including bertemu and pertemuan. Adding -nya can let a clause present a meeting as an event, as in bertemunya dua sungai. This is a grammatical explanation rather than a claim about a separately borrowed word or a documented date of origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认 bertemu＝相遇，再把 bertemunya 理解为“相遇这件事”：bertemunya dua sungai＝两条河的交汇。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根无词缀。派生时，meN- 在 b 前变为 mem-，保留 b：meN- + balut → membalut；peN- 同理形成 pembalut。

etymology.historical_story: The packet does not establish a dated origin for balut. Its cultural associations are nevertheless concrete: DBP records balut ketupat for the coconut-leaf casing used around ketupat. The same wrapping idea connects everyday packaging with bandaging. This provides a useful cultural illustration of the word, without treating the ketupat tradition as proof of its historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ba.lut 联想到“把物包住”：礼物包起来，伤口包扎好；这是记忆联想，不是词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 沿用输入包，将 bantuan 记为直接基词；更深层词根为 bantu。-nya 是附着于词尾的代词形式，此处按给定字段归入 suffix，不是构成新词的普通派生后缀。ny 表示单个辅音 /ɲ/，连接时不删字母、不加连字符。

senses.zh_definition: 他或她所提供的帮助、援助或支持；具体所指由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: His or her help, assistance, or support, with the referent supplied by context.
senses.ms_definition: Pertolongan atau sokongan yang diberikan oleh orang yang dirujuk melalui bentuk -nya.
senses.nuances: bantuan 是核心名词，-nya 在此通常回指已经提及的第三人称，不区分性别。例如 Farah memberi bantuan. Bantuannya amat berguna. 不能脱离上下文一律译为“你的帮助”。该释义由 bantuan 的词义与 -nya 的语法功能合成，并非独立词头的逐字官方释义。依据：[DBP PRPM：bantu／bantuan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=392888&keyword=bantu)及 [DBP：-nya 的语法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tatabahasa+nya)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 所指人物必须清楚；多人同时出现时，可重复姓名或使用 bantuan beliau 等表达以避免歧义。-nya 本身不标示尊称，也不区分男女。

etymology.historical_story: Bantuannya illustrates a productive grammatical sequence rather than a separate borrowing. The root bantu expresses helping; -an forms the noun bantuan; attached -nya connects that assistance to a third-person referent. This structure lets Malay identify the helper without marking gender. Its history should therefore be explained through its components, without inventing a separate origin for the complete written form.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 三步记：bantu“帮”＋-an“帮助这件事”＋-nya“他／她的”＝bantuannya“他／她的帮助”。

etymology.historical_story: Bola entered Malay from Portuguese bola, meaning “ball,” through the language contact associated with Portuguese activity in the Malay world. Bolanya illustrates how a borrowed noun becomes part of Malay grammar: the established word bola takes the native possessive clitic -nya, allowing speakers to identify whose ball they mean.

morphology.pattern_note: 依词包保留独立词形分析；实际为已有研究记录的登嘉楼方言形式，对应 belaka，涉及词内元音省略及地方发音。不是 bl- 或 -e 词缀派生；未核实精确音值，IPA 留空。

senses.zh_definition: 全都；一概；无一例外。登嘉楼方言中对应标准马来语 belaka 的形式。
senses.en_definition: A Terengganu dialect form of belaka: all; entirely; without exception.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk dialek Terengganu bagi belaka, yang bermaksud semuanya atau seluruhnya tanpa kecuali.
senses.nuances: 登嘉楼方言研究明确列有 belaka → blake：[UKM：Dialek Melayu Terengganu](https://ejournal.ukm.my/jmelayu/article/download/5060/2612)。标准词的释义见 [DBP：belaka](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=belaka)。通常置于所概括的成分之后。以下为说明用法的自然组合，未经语料频率排序；不能把所有小写 blake 都自动判为方言词，原文也可能涉及人名 Blake。

dual_scenarios.context: 语言研究 / 方言记录

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可用于地方对话、人物对白和方言研究。不要为了模仿或取笑当地口音而夸张使用；若是人名 Blake，应按专名处理。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 方言形式本身不失礼。与熟悉登嘉楼口音的人交流时很自然；面对跨地区听众或正式读者，使用 belaka 更容易理解。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 可用于地方对话、人物对白和方言研究。不要为了模仿或取笑当地口音而夸张使用；若是人名 Blake，应按专名处理。

etymology.historical_story: Terengganu dialect research records blake alongside standard belaka as an example of shortening within a word. This makes the spelling a useful trace of local speech rather than evidence of an English borrowing. In conversation, such regional forms can signal familiarity and belonging. The documented relationship explains the form, but does not establish a date for its origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 belaka 中间的弱元音压缩，联想到 blake；意思仍是“全都、无一例外”。

headword.jawi_note: 依要求保留数据包的爪夷文；بهاي 对应词根 bahaya，完整 bahayanya 为 بهايڽ。音节与音标按完整词形补充。

morphology.formula: bahaya + -nya → bahayanya（其危险；危险之处；口语感叹：好危险）
morphology.pattern_note: 词根不发生音变；y 表示 /j/，ny 表示 /ɲ/。-nya 的作用须结合句法判断，可回指前文，也可用于强调；不能一律译成“他的”。[DBP：-nya 的功能](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=teks+nya)

senses.zh_definition: 某事物所具有的危险、危害或危险之处；也可指某项行为的危险性。
senses.en_definition: The danger or harmful potential associated with something already mentioned or subsequently specified.
senses.ms_definition: Bahaya yang berkaitan dengan perkara yang dirujuk, iaitu kemungkinan perkara itu mendatangkan kecelakaan atau bencana.
senses.nuances: 例如 menyedari bahayanya 表示意识到其中的危险；bahayanya merokok 可指吸烟的危险性。完整词形释义依据 DBP 的 bahaya 词根义及 -nya 的语境功能编写，不是独立词条的逐字引文。[DBP：bahaya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1.aspx?d=73980&keyword=bahaya)

senses.zh_definition: 好危险；太危险了。用于口语感叹，对眼前情况或某种行为表示惊讶、担忧或警告。
senses.en_definition: How dangerous; used colloquially to express alarm at a situation or action.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan percakapan, menyatakan rasa terkejut atau bimbang kerana sesuatu sangat berbahaya.
senses.nuances: 这是感叹句中的口语述性用法，不能把 -nya 理解为领属。正式表达可用 Alangkah berbahayanya…! 或 …sangat berbahaya。DBP 对 -nya 的说明包括强调功能；此处给出其语境化解释。[DBP：-nya 的功能](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=teks+nya)

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 提醒他人危险时，可以直接说 Bahayanya!；对不熟悉的人，补上具体原因和行动提示更清楚，例如请慢行。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 提醒他人危险时，可以直接说 Bahayanya!；对不熟悉的人，补上具体原因和行动提示更清楚，例如请慢行。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 安全报告宜明确危险来源及可能后果，避免只写含糊的 bahayanya。日常感叹适合即时提醒；紧急情况下优先给出清楚的指令，如 Berhenti! 或 Jangan sentuh!。

etymology.historical_story: Bahaya belongs to the Sanskrit-derived vocabulary shared across parts of Southeast Asia, ultimately connected with bhaya, fear or danger. In Malay it functions as a complete root and combines productively with Malay grammatical elements. Bahayanya therefore joins a borrowed lexical base to -nya; its meaning depends on the surrounding sentence. [Sanskrit loanword overview](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_loanwords_in_Malay_language)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Bolivia 是中性国家名称。谈论当地居民时可用 rakyat Bolivia 或 warga Bolivia，不应以国籍概括个人性格。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式文本写 Bolivia；涉及外交全称时依有关机构的正式名称处理。不要把该国等同于单一族群、单一语言或单一文化。

etymology.historical_story: Bolivia’s name commemorates Simón Bolívar, a central figure in South American independence. The new state declared independence in 1825 and initially adopted a name honouring him. This is a historical naming relationship, not a productive Malay word-building pattern: learners should remember Bolivia as a complete proper name rather than invent a Malay root and suffix. [U.S. government historical publication](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-PR32_4600-a2ce7fd45863c13d4bb5a8a2d8405602/html/GOVPUB-PR32_4600-a2ce7fd45863c13d4bb5a8a2d8405602.htm).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Bolívar → Bolivia：用受纪念的人名连接国家名；读作 bo-li-vi-a，写国家名时首字母大写。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接名词 keluarga，表示具有家庭或处于家庭生活状态；词首 k 保留，不发生鼻音同化。输入 Jawi 末尾的 U+0081 控制字符已清除。

word_family.gloss: 家庭关系；亲情；与家庭有关的

senses.en_definition: To have family or relatives; to be related to someone.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai keluarga atau sanak saudara; bersaudara-mara atau berkerabat.
senses.nuances: 重点是亲属关系，并不必然表示已婚。berkeluarga dengan seseorang 可表示与某人有亲属关系，不宜脱离上下文直接译为与某人结婚。[DBP keluarga 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=Keluarga)

etymology.historical_story: Keluarga contains elements associated with Sanskrit kula, meaning family or lineage, and varga, meaning group. Research leaves open whether the compound was borrowed whole or assembled locally from borrowed elements. Malay adds the productive prefix ber- to express having family connections or living as a married household. [World Loanword Database](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839391642536)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: keluarga 是家庭，ber- 表示具有或处于某种状态：berkeluarga＝有家庭、已成家。

senses.zh_definition: 虽然；尽管；即使。引出一种情况，说明主句所述仍然成立。
senses.en_definition: Although; even though; even if, introducing a circumstance that does not prevent the main statement from holding.
senses.ms_definition: Meskipun; kata hubung yang memperkenalkan keadaan yang tidak menghalang berlakunya perkara dalam klausa utama.
senses.nuances: 与 walaupun、meskipun 意义接近。已知事实通常译为虽然或尽管，假设情形可译为即使；是否为事实取决于上下文。常与主句中的 tetap 呼应。biarpun 固定连写，不能按一般也字义的 pun 拆开。[DBP 马来语拼写规范](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Biarpun combines biar and the particle pun in a conventional conjunction. Malay spelling treats it as a single word, alongside forms such as walaupun and meskipun. Its meaning makes a useful conceptual turn: a circumstance is acknowledged or allowed, yet the main outcome still stands despite that circumstance.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 biar 联想到任它如此，再接 pun 的强调：任它如此，我仍然……＝即使、尽管。这是记忆提示，不是逐字翻译。

etymology.historical_story: The country name Bulgaria preserves the name of the Bulgars. Bulgarian statehood developed through their alliance with Slavic populations, and Byzantium recognised the state in 681. Later cultural and religious developments helped shape a shared Bulgarian identity. The national name therefore carries a historical connection to the Bulgars, rather than a meaning assembled from Malay syllables. [保加利亚外交部历史介绍](https://www.mfa.bg/en/about_bulgaria/history).

etymology.historical_story: Berpaut belongs to the Malay paut family, whose meanings connect gripping, attachment, and connection. Its physical image extends naturally to holding onto beliefs or hope. Traditional proverbial expressions also use attachment to describe restricted freedom or unresolved ties. These relationships explain its cultural imagery without requiring an unverified account of its earliest historical origin. See [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=berpaut).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 paut 联想到“攀住”：手攀住树枝，心攀住希望；berpaut 就是紧紧依附。此为记忆联想，并非词源。

etymology.historical_story: Malay barbeku adapts English barbecue to Malay spelling. The English word travelled through Spanish barbacoa from a Caribbean Indigenous term associated with a wooden structure used for cooking or smoking meat. Its history connects a cooking arrangement with the food and the gathering around it, a connection also reflected in the two Malay dictionary senses. Sources: [Atlanta History Center](https://www.atlantahistorycenter.com/blog/a-brief-history-of-barbecue/), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=barbeku).

etymology.historical_story: The word belongs to the Malay siar family, which connects spreading information with publishing and broadcasting. Adding -an produces siaran, a broadcast or something disseminated; ber- then presents broadcasting as an activity. Its dictionary definition centres on radio and television, while contemporary speakers also use it for online programmes. This is a transparent Malay formation, rather than an indivisible borrowed word.

etymology.historical_story: Malay bait brings together separate borrowing histories. The house and poetic senses belong to the Arabic bayt tradition, in which the same word can denote a dwelling or a verse unit. Malay preserves the dwelling sense as archaic and uses the poetic sense in literary discussion. The computing sense instead adapts English byte, so its eight-bit meaning should be remembered separately.

morphology.formula: ∅ + berdikari → berdikari；历史缩合：berdiri atas kaki sendiri → berdikari
morphology.pattern_note: 现代作为完整词根处理；不能误拆为 ber- + dikari。它由短语缩合形成，部分马来西亚口音中的 r 较弱或不发音。

etymology.historical_story: Berdikari compresses the expression berdiri atas kaki sendiri, literally standing on one's own feet, into a single word. DBP identifies it as an acronym formed from parts of words. The physical image makes an abstract ability easy to grasp: managing life through one's own effort. Its beginning is therefore not a detachable ber- prefix. [DBP explanation](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=berdikari)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: berdikari：想象靠自己的 kaki（双脚）站稳，便是“自立”。这是短语联想，不是现代词缀拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留资料包的直接基底 buangkan；进一步的词根是 buang。-kan 是派生后缀，-nya 是附着代词，二者性质不同。连接后保留 /ŋ/、/k/，ny 表示 /ɲ/。祈使句中的动词通常不带 meN-。

senses.zh_definition: 把它丢掉；将前文提到的东西弃置，语境中也可表示替别人丢掉它。

senses.ms_definition: Membuang benda yang telah disebut, termasuk melakukannya untuk orang lain; lazim digunakan sebagai bentuk perintah atau permintaan.
senses.nuances: -nya 的所指须由上下文确定；本义中通常指待丢弃的东西。该形式本身不表示过去时。DBP 将 membuangkan 解释为替别人丢弃，不能把所有 buang 的义项机械套入本形式。[DBP：buang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=buang)

senses.zh_definition: 把它去掉、删除或清除；对象可以是文字、污物等需要移除的内容。

senses.ms_definition: Menghilangkan atau menghapuskan sesuatu yang telah disebut, seperti perkataan atau unsur yang tidak diperlukan.
senses.nuances: 须有明确的前文对象。编辑文字时，padamkannya 或 gugurkannya 有时更精确；本形式不自动带有“浪费”或“流放”的意思。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates how Malay builds an instruction from smaller grammatical pieces. Buang supplies the action of discarding or removing, -kan forms buangkan, and -nya points back to an understood referent. The dictionary records a benefactive use of membuangkan: throwing something away for another person. The complete form is therefore a grammatical construction rather than a separate ancient root.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分三步记：buang＝丢，-kan＝构成动作形式，-nya＝它；合起来想到“把它丢掉”。

etymology.historical_story: Berlima illustrates how Malay builds a social grouping from a number. The prefix ber- turns lima into an expression meaning five together, making the group itself central rather than merely counting its members. Compare kelima, which places someone fifth in a sequence: the same number supports two different ways of organising experience. [DBP morphology reference](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2025/04/eDigital_Morfologi-qnsczr.pdf), [PRPM: kelima](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kelima).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ber-li-ma，抓住 lima＝五；想象五个人围成一圈：ber- 把“五”组成“五个一起”。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan labels berantakan as Javanese in origin. Its image is concrete: things scattered instead of arranged. That image helps learners understand its use for untidy spaces without inventing a Malay root beneath its opening letters. The borrowing also illustrates how regional vocabulary can enter a dictionary while retaining a distinctive geographical flavour. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=berantakan)

morphology.pattern_note: 按数据包保留直接基底 berpeluk；更深层词根是 peluk。完整 ber-…-an 结构在此表达相互动作；词根末尾 k 在接元音后缀时成为下一音节的起首辅音，不发生鼻音替换。

etymology.historical_story: Berpelukan illustrates Malay's productive way of building reciprocal actions from familiar roots. Peluk supplies the idea of an embrace, and the ber-…-an construction presents the participants as embracing one another. Its dictionary meaning is therefore mutual, while the emotional setting may be reunion, farewell, consolation or celebration. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=378040&keyword=pelukan)

etymology.historical_story: Banner is an English word used in Malaysian printing, advertising and event work. Its physical display sense also provides a useful bridge to digital design: a website banner presents a message in a conspicuous graphic panel. Malay equivalents depend on the object and setting, with kain rentang and sepanduk useful for physical displays.

etymology.historical_story: The letters bp come from bahasa percakapan, literally conversational language. Malay dictionaries use this compact label to signal register beside particular words or meanings. Its interest lies in dictionary practice rather than an ancient lexical origin: two letters help readers distinguish everyday expressions from choices suitable for formal writing.

etymology.historical_story: The international history of bandit leads to Italian bandito, originally someone outlawed or banished by public proclamation. The meaning developed into a robber living outside the law. Malay records bandit as a robber, especially an armed gang member; the supplied evidence does not establish its immediate borrowing language. [Merriam-Webster: bandit](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/bandit).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ban.dit 想成电影里结伙抢劫的匪徒；若熟悉英语 bandit，可直接建立同形同义联想。

senses.zh_definition: 箱子；盒子。这里作为马英夹杂中的英语词使用，规范马来语通常用 kotak，某些箱柜类容器可用 peti。
senses.en_definition: A container, typically with a flat base and sides; an English word that may occur in Malay–English code-switching.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang merujuk kepada bekas, lazimnya berbentuk segi empat; padanan bahasa Melayu ialah kotak atau, mengikut konteks, peti.
senses.nuances: 未核实 box 作为正式马来语词头的地位，因此不标记为 official。此处仅收录容器义，不把英语的拳击、剧院包厢等其他义项自动移植为马来语义项。搭配中的 box 属英语夹杂；规范写法分别为 kotak kosong 和 kotak kasut。马来语对应词依据：[DBP：kotak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=kotak)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam laporan inventori berbahasa Melayu, gunakan perkataan kotak sebagai padanan bagi perkataan Inggeris box.

kat、tu、nak 分别对应 di、itu、hendak。

etymology.historical_story: English box has a container history linked to Latin buxis and Greek pyxis, a receptacle associated with boxwood, according to [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/box). The word eventually came to describe containers made from many materials. In this entry it is treated as an English code-switching item; that history does not establish official Malay status or supply a verified Malay Jawi spelling.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 box 直接连到马来语 kotak：看到包裹盒，口语可能听到 box，正式马来语记住 kotak。

word_family.gloss: 一套换洗衣服；更换或蜕换

senses.zh_definition: 更换衣服；换上另一套衣物。
senses.en_definition: To change clothes.
senses.ms_definition: Bertukar pakaian atau menggantikan pakaian yang dipakai dengan pakaian lain.
senses.nuances: 常与 pakaian、baju 搭配。单独说 bersalin 时，现代日常语境往往首先让人想到分娩，因此表达换衣服时宜补出衣物名称。此义与下列义项依据 [DBP：bersalin](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=bersalin)。

senses.zh_definition: 皮肤、毛羽等发生更换，或颜色、外观发生变化。
senses.en_definition: To shed or change skin, fur, or feathers, or undergo a change in colour or appearance.
senses.ms_definition: Berubah warna atau rupa, atau berganti kulit, bulu dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: bersalin kulit 通常指蜕皮；bersalin bulu 指换毛或换羽。具体变化由后接名词和主语决定，不表示动物分娩。

senses.zh_definition: 分娩；生孩子。
senses.en_definition: To give birth to a child.
senses.ms_definition: Melahirkan anak; beranak.
senses.nuances: 常用于医疗、家庭和职场语境，表达较委婉得体。cuti bersalin 指产假，wad bersalin 指产科病房。此义不只是‘怀孕’，也不表示一般性的‘生产制造’。

dual_scenarios.ms: Sepanjang tempoh cuti bersalin Puan Aina, semua urusan pelanggan akan dikendalikan oleh Puan Farah.

messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia masih di hospital. Kita hantar pesanan dahulu sahaja supaya dia dapat berehat.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈论分娩时，bersalin 通常比直接说 beranak 更适合礼貌交流和职场表达。称呼产妇可用姓名、Puan 或关系合适时的 Kak。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 关心产妇时先询问是否方便交流或探访，尊重休息需要。避免追问生育计划、分娩细节或身体恢复情况；表达换衣服时补上 pakaian 或 baju，以免歧义。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈论分娩时，bersalin 通常比直接说 beranak 更适合礼貌交流和职场表达。称呼产妇可用姓名、Puan 或关系合适时的 Kak。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 关心产妇时先询问是否方便交流或探访，尊重休息需要。避免追问生育计划、分娩细节或身体恢复情况；表达换衣服时补上 pakaian 或 baju，以免歧义。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries place changing clothes, changing bodily coverings, and giving birth under bersalin. The shared form offers a memorable cultural contrast: a person may bersalin pakaian before a celebration, while a mother may bersalin in a maternity ward. These established meanings should be learned together; their coexistence does not establish which meaning historically developed first.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ber- + salin：记住两幅画面——换一身衣服，迎来一个孩子；说 pakaian 就是换衣，说产房就是分娩。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 表示发出或具有某种声音；词根 gema 保持不变，两个 e 均读央元音 [ə]。

senses.zh_definition: 回响；回荡；声音响彻某个空间。
senses.en_definition: To echo, reverberate, or resound.
senses.ms_definition: Bergaung, berkumandang, bertalun.
senses.nuances: 不及物动词，常以声音、音乐或呼喊为主语。既可描述可辨认的回声，也可泛指声音响彻某处，不要求一定听到重复的声响。释义依据 [PRPM：gema](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=gema)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds bergema transparently from gema, meaning an echo, with the prefix ber-. Its cultural associations include voices carrying through halls, calls sounding across neighbourhoods, and cheers filling stadiums. These familiar settings explain its expressive usefulness. The consulted dictionary establishes the modern word family, but does not establish a dated origin or a particular donor language.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 gema＝回声，再加 ber-：让脑中响起一声又一声的 gema，就是 bergema。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根末尾 k 与后缀开头 k 均保留，形成 kk；词根末尾 k 可实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]。常用于祈使句或省略 meN- 的结构。输入 Jawi بنتوق 是 bentuk 的拼写；此处 بنتوقکن 按词根加后缀构成，并非输入包提供的整词拼写。DBP 的构词说明列有 membentukkan：[PRPM 构词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pem)。

senses.zh_definition: 使物体具有某种形状；将材料塑成指定形态，常用于指令。
senses.en_definition: To shape or mould something into a particular form, especially in an instruction.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan sesuatu mempunyai bentuk atau rupa yang tertentu.
senses.nuances: 此为根据 bentuk 词族及 -kan 构词法编写的释义，并非 DBP 对 bentukkan 的独立原文释义。Bentukkan doh itu 表示“把那面团塑形”；陈述正在进行的动作时通常用 membentuk。不要与名词 bentukan“形成之物”混淆。参见 [PRPM：bentuk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bentuk)。

senses.zh_definition: 组织、组成或建立某个群体或组织，常用于指令。
senses.en_definition: To form or establish a group or organization, especially in an instruction.
senses.ms_definition: Menubuhkan atau menyusun sesuatu kumpulan atau organisasi.
senses.nuances: 这是由 bentuk 词族的“组成、建立”义推导的用法。日常指令也常直接用 bentuk，如 Bentuk satu kumpulan；并非所有使用 bentuk 的位置都必须加 -kan。参见 [PRPM：bentuk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bentuk)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于烹饪、手工、教学及分组活动。它是动词形式；“形状”用 bentuk，“形成之物”用 bentukan，不能因发音接近而混写。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接使用 Bentukkan… 带有指令语气。对客户、长辈或不熟悉的人，可加 sila 或 tolong，并说明具体要求。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于烹饪、手工、教学及分组活动。它是动词形式；“形状”用 bentuk，“形成之物”用 bentukan，不能因发音接近而混写。

etymology.historical_story: The modern family centres on bentuk, a word covering shape, appearance, arrangement, and style. Adding -kan produces an instruction-friendly verb that asks someone to give something a form. The same concrete image extends to organizing groups. This explains the contemporary relationship between shaping material and forming organizations without assuming an undocumented ancient origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bentuk＝形状；加 -kan＝使它成形。看到 bentukkan，就想象双手把面团塑成小球。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是连写的强调语气词，不是派生词缀；添加后不改变 belajar 的词干读音。belajar 本身由 ber- + ajar 形成特殊形式。输入包的 Jawi بلاجر 对应 belajar，未包含 -lah；完整词形分音节为 be.la.jar.lah。[DBP 构词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=bel)；[DBP 拼写规范](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

word_family.gloss: 学习、研习某项知识或技能

senses.zh_definition: 学习吧；劝勉、邀请或要求对方努力获取知识、掌握技能或接受训练。

senses.ms_definition: Berusaha memperoleh ilmu pengetahuan atau kepandaian, atau menjalani latihan; digunakan bersama partikel -lah untuk memberikan penegasan atau galakan.
senses.nuances: 核心意义来自 belajar，-lah 增加劝勉或强调意味，不表示学习已经完成。语调温和时可译为“学一学吧”，语调严厉时也可能成为催促或训诫。释义依据 [DBP：belajar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=belajar)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -lah 不会自动让命令变礼貌。老师鼓励学生时很自然；对长辈、上司或不熟悉的人直接说 belajarlah，可能显得居高临下。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合鼓励学习或总结经验。争论时说 belajarlah dahulu 容易被理解为“先去学懂再说”；正式建议可改用建议句式并说明学习目的。

etymology.historical_story: Belajarlah combines an established Malay learning verb with the attached particle -lah. Belajar belongs to the ajar family, which also supplies words for teaching, lessons, and learners. Its exceptional ber- formation produces belajar. Adding -lah brings the word into interpersonal speech, where intonation helps distinguish encouragement, invitation, insistence, and reprimand.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认出 belajar“学习”，再听句尾 lah 像中文“啦／吧”：belajarlah，就是“学习吧”。这是语气联想，不是词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 双音节词根，无词缀。派生 membara 时，meN- 在 /b/ 前实现为 mem-，词根首音 /b/ 保留。

senses.zh_definition: 木头、木炭等燃烧后仍灼热发红的残块；余烬，炭火。
senses.en_definition: An ember or live coal; a fragment of fuel that remains hot and glowing as a fire dies down.
senses.ms_definition: Sisa kayu, arang atau bahan seumpamanya yang masih berpijar ketika api hampir padam.
senses.nuances: 重点是燃料残块仍然灼热，区别于 abu（灰烬）和 nyalaan api（火焰）。没有明显火焰也可能仍有 bara。马来语释义依据词典内容释写。参见 [DBP：bara](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=bara)。

senses.zh_definition: 比喻内心持续燃烧的强烈情感，尤指怒意、仇恨或热忱。
senses.en_definition: A smouldering intensity of feeling, especially anger, resentment or passion.
senses.ms_definition: Kiasan bagi perasaan kuat yang terpendam atau terus bergelora, seperti kemarahan, dendam atau semangat.
senses.nuances: 这是余烬意象的比喻延伸，常见于文学和修辞；并不表示所有强烈情绪都可自然地与 bara 搭配。membara 的情绪义也体现同一意象。参见 [DBP：membara](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=membara)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 本义中性，适用于烹饪、露营和消防提醒。比喻义较有文学色彩，描述他人心怀 bara dendam 可能显得指责意味很强。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 谚语 genggam bara api biar jadi arang 强调做事坚持到底，不能按字面理解为徒手握住炭火。普通沟通中表达“很生气”通常直接用 sangat marah。

etymology.historical_story: Malay proverbs turn bara into an image of perseverance: genggam bara api biar jadi arang urges someone to persist through difficult work. The same ember image supports expressions of smouldering anger and enduring hope. These associations explain the word's cultural force; they do not establish a particular ancient source or borrowing route. See [DBP: bara](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=bara).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ba.ra 想成“扒啦”一下灰堆：灰下面露出红亮炭火，那就是 bara。此为联想，不是词源。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan labels banget as Javanese and connects it with bangat II. Its familiar conversational role is to intensify an adjective, as in bagus banget. For Malaysian learners, the useful cultural distinction is register: recognizing this regional expression broadens comprehension, while sangat remains the straightforward choice in formal Malay. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=banget).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 banget 想成形容词后的“程度放大键”：bagus 是好，bagus banget 就是好极了。

morphology.pattern_note: is_root、root_word、affix 和 root_jawi 按输入包的整词词基记录保留，不代表语言学上不可分析。实际构词为 ber- + rahsia；词根是 rahsia（رهسيا），遇词首 r 时前缀与词根不写成双 r，形成 berahsia。

senses.zh_definition: 怀有秘密；具有不为人知的隐情或隐藏之处。
senses.en_definition: To have or harbour a secret; to contain something hidden.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai rahsia; menaruh rahsia.
senses.nuances: 侧重“有秘密”的状态，未必表示有意欺骗。bilik berahsia 可指具有隐藏之处的房间，不一定等于“位置隐秘的房间”。三项释义均依据 [DBP：berahsia](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=berahsia)。

collocations.en: a room with a hidden secret

senses.zh_definition: 对某人隐瞒事情；不向某人透露内情。
senses.en_definition: To keep something secret from someone; to withhold information.
senses.ms_definition: Menyembunyikan sesuatu daripada seseorang.
senses.nuances: 这是日常交流中的常用义。berahsia dengan saya 通常表示“对我有所隐瞒”；若要直接带所隐瞒的事情作宾语，使用 merahsiakan perkara itu 更清楚。

senses.zh_definition: 向某人私下透露秘密；向某人吐露隐情。
senses.en_definition: To confide a secret to someone.
senses.ms_definition: Memberitahukan sesuatu rahsia kepada seseorang.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录的较少见用法，与常见的“隐瞒”义方向不同。通常依靠 kepada 及上下文辨认；现代交流可改说 menceritakan rahsia kepada seseorang，以免误解。

collocations.zh: 向可信任的人透露秘密
collocations.en: confide a secret to someone trustworthy

etymology.historical_story: Berahsia places the Malay prefix ber- before rahsia, the word for a secret. Its dictionary meanings reveal an intriguing conversational reversal: it can describe keeping something hidden, yet also confiding a secret to another person. The surrounding construction therefore matters as much as the word itself when interpreting who knows what. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=rahsia).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rahsia＝秘密；ber- 表示处于某种状态：berahsia 常指心里有秘密、对人不说。遇到 kepada，再留意是否是在“吐露秘密”。

headword.orthography_note: 保留词包的空音节值和 Jawi 字段。实际音节可分为 be.ra.pa.kah；词包 Jawi 仅对应 berapa，未包含疑问附着语 -kah。

morphology.pattern_note: -kah 是后附的疑问强调语素，并非改变词类的普通派生后缀；此处按字段归入 suffix。词根不发生音变，连写为一个词；不要把 berapa 再机械拆成 ber- + apa。

senses.zh_definition: 用于明确询问数量、金额、尺寸、年龄、时刻等可量化信息，相当于“多少”或“几”。
senses.en_definition: An interrogative expression asking how many, how much, or what numerical value.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk tanya berapa yang disertai partikel -kah untuk meminta maklumat tentang bilangan, jumlah, harga, ukuran atau nilai tertentu.
senses.nuances: 实际语法类别为 kata tanya；因指定词类列表不含疑问代词，此处暂归 particle。常见于完整问句、教学和正式询问。口语通常省略 -kah，说 Berapa harganya? 或 Harga berapa?；词根 berapa 的非疑问用法不能一概移植到 berapakah。[DBP 词义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=berapa)；[DBP 疑问句说明](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2025/08/22/19818/)。

etymology.historical_story: Berapakah combines the Malay question word berapa with the question particle -kah. Its structure illustrates a familiar contrast in Malaysian communication: a complete written question may retain the particle, while a quick conversation often uses berapa alone. The particle marks the question explicitly; it does not create a separate word for prices, ages, or quantities.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berapa 记作“多少”，再给它挂上疑问标记 -kah：berapa + kah，就是完整地问“究竟多少？”

morphology.pattern_note: 作为外来专名整体记忆，不作马来语词缀拆分；规范书写首字母大写。所列 IPA 为英语来源读音。

senses.zh_definition: 布伦特：石油报道中用于指布伦特原油及相关国际原油价格基准的专名。
senses.en_definition: Brent crude oil, or a related international crude-oil pricing benchmark.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang merujuk kepada minyak mentah Brent atau penanda aras harga minyak mentah yang berkaitan dengannya.
senses.nuances: 属于专名，不是表示一般事物的马来语普通词。此处按石油新闻中的常见用法解释；孤立词形也可能是人名或地名，原始语境不足以排除这些指称。不同 Brent 现货评估、指数与期货合约并非完全相同的价格。参见 [ICE：原油基准](https://www.ice.com/oil) 和 [ICE Brent Index](https://www.ice.com/futures-europe/brent)。马来语释义为说明性释义，并非 DBP 原文。

etymology.historical_story: The oil-market name Brent comes from the Brent field in the North Sea. Shell records its discovery in 1971. The field's name subsequently became associated with crude-oil pricing far beyond that location. In Malay reporting, Brent therefore travels as an international proper name rather than as a newly formed Malay word. See [Shell: The Brent Story](https://www.shell.co.uk/about-us/sustainability/decommissioning/brent-field-decommissioning/the-brent-story) and [EIA: the Brent benchmark](https://www.eia.gov/todayinenergy/detail.php?id=30292).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Brent 与一桶贴着“布伦特”标签的原油绑定记忆：minyak mentah Brent。不要把它拆成马来语词根和词缀。

etymology.historical_story: The evidence here concerns translation rather than an established Malay borrowing. DBP presents bull as an English source term with Malay veterinary equivalents. This distinction matters in bilingual agricultural writing: an English label may appear beside a Malay explanation without becoming a Malay headword. No date or route of borrowing is established by the supplied packet.

etymology.historical_story: Bahagikan shows how Malay connects an everyday action with an abstract operation. The base bahagi concerns a part or share; the related bahagian names a portion, while pembahagian names division or distribution. Sharing food, allocating duties, and dividing numbers therefore belong to one recognizable word family, although context determines whether physical portions, responsibilities, or quantities are involved. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=membahagikan).

etymology.historical_story: English boon comes through Middle English from Old Norse bón, meaning a petition or prayer. Its history connects asking for a favour with receiving something beneficial. Modern speakers usually use it for something especially helpful. DBP supplies Malay equivalents in its English–Malay dictionary; that bilingual listing does not establish a separate Malay borrowing history.

etymology.historical_story: Malay bajet adapts English budget. Behind the English word lies French bougette, a small bag. Financial papers carried in a bag helped connect the container with its contents, and eventually with a plan of revenue and expenditure. The Malay spelling makes this international financial word fit local spelling and pronunciation. [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/budget)
