etymology.historical_story: Banggakan is a Malay formation built from bangga and the suffix -kan. DBP records related forms expressing feeling proud, taking pride in something and causing pride. In everyday encouragement, the word readily links personal achievement with family or community recognition. Its useful learning story is this grammatical relationship; a particular ancient source is not established by the supplied evidence. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=membanggakan).

etymology.historical_story: Boot illustrates how English vocabulary circulates through Malaysian workplaces, shops and technology conversations. The same written form can evoke footwear, a car’s luggage compartment or computer startup. Malay standardization uses but for these meanings, while bilingual speakers may retain boot when discussing English interfaces, product descriptions or technical instructions.

etymology.historical_story: The useful cultural story here is a shift from source to explanation. Punca names a source or starting point, while ber- makes it possible to describe something as originating there. In Malaysian reporting and everyday explanations, berpunca carries that source image into discussions of breakdowns, disagreements, and social problems. This is a semantic account, not a claim about the root's ultimate origin.

etymology.historical_story: Belut is treated here as an established Malay animal name, without assigning an unverified borrowing history. Its cultural reach extends beyond naming a fish: Malay proverbs draw on the eel's slippery body and association with mud. Licin bagai belut describes someone difficult to deceive, showing how an observable animal trait becomes a memorable image of human cleverness. etymology.historical_story: The swimsuit name bikini comes from Bikini Atoll in the Pacific, associated with nuclear weapons testing in 1946. Louis Réard presented his design in Paris that July, while Jacques Heim also promoted a competing minimal swimsuit. The geographical name became an international clothing term. Its final i is therefore part of the borrowed word, not a Malay suffix. [Metropolitan Museum of Art](https://www.metmuseum.org/pt/essays/the-bikini)

etymology.historical_story: English borrowed butte from French, where the word denotes a knoll or mound; Merriam-Webster records English use from 1805. In English geographical usage, it became associated with isolated, steep-sided hills. Its French ancestry explains the spelling, while its English pronunciation is a single syllable, /bjuːt/, rather than a letter-by-letter Malay reading. [Merriam-Webster: butte](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/butte).

etymology.historical_story: The animal name appeared in English in the early sixteenth century, possibly referring to its badge-like head markings. That explanation remains uncertain. The later verb developed from badger-baiting, in which dogs repeatedly attacked the animal. The historical connection helps explain why the verb conveys persistent, unwelcome pressure. [Source: Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/badger_2).

etymology.historical_story: Bertinelli belongs to an Italian surname group associated with Bertin and related personal-name forms. A surname can travel internationally with its bearers and appear unchanged in Malay reporting. Its initial letters happen to resemble Malay ber-, but that resemblance does not establish Malay morphology or identify the ancestry of any particular bearer. [Geneanet](https://www.geneanet.org/nom-de-famille/BERTINELLI)

etymology.historical_story: The supplied spelling is English. In Malaysian automotive conversation, an English component name may appear inside an otherwise Malay sentence. The dictionary form bampar shows a spelling adapted to Malay, while penampan names its protective function. These alternatives offer a useful contrast between borrowing a technical label and describing what the component does.

etymology.historical_story: Bertaburan belongs to the tabur family, whose meanings include scattering and sowing. The same spatial image connects seeds spread over ground, papers scattered across a floor, and islands dotted across the sea. Malay morphology turns that shared image into a word describing dispersed abundance, with disorder present in some contexts but absent in others. [DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=bertaburan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tabur 是“撒”；想象撒出一把种子，满地都是——bertaburan 就是“散落各处”。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆，不能拆成 ber- 加词根；两个 e 均为 é /e/，词尾 /k/ 在马来西亚口语中常实现为 [ʔ]。下列词族项是复合短语。

etymology.historical_story: Berek belongs to the vocabulary of communal service housing. Its cultural footprint survives in Malaysian place names: the Perlis public library records that Jalan Berek in Kangar was named after police accommodation once located there. The buildings and street later disappeared through redevelopment, but the recorded name preserves the neighbourhood’s former function. [Perlis public library](https://www.perlislib.gov.my/web/ejurnal-perlis/207-jalan-jalan-lama-di-bandar-kangar)

etymology.historical_story: The spelling question becomes clearer through Malay word formation: DBP identifies berserta as ber- plus serta. Its guidance explicitly retains the r and corrects beserta to berserta. This gives learners a useful connection between vocabulary and administrative writing, where accompanying documents and payments are routinely expressed with the standard form. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=beserta).

word_family.gloss: 多个罐子；完整重叠形式

senses.zh_definition: 用于盛放饮料、食品等的罐子或较大的瓶状容器，常见为玻璃罐。
senses.en_definition: A jar or large bottle-like container used for storing liquids, food, or other items.
senses.ms_definition: Bekas seperti botol, besar dan agak luas mulutnya, tempat menyimpan air, barang-barang makanan dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 常指装饼干、糖果或饮料的罐子；不能仅凭材料判断其是否为 balang。《Kamus Dewan》强调容器较大、开口较宽，《Kamus Pelajar》另描述为大而小口的玻璃瓶，因此不宜把开口大小当作所有用法的绝对条件。常用量词为个体容器 sebuah balang；一罐内容物可说 sebalang。这里处理输入指定的容器义；同形的古代船名及 membalang 的投掷词根属于其他词条。依据：[DBP PRPM：balang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=balang)。

etymology.historical_story: A balang belongs to the everyday vocabulary of keeping food and drink. A useful cultural image is a household jar filled with festive biscuits, ready for visiting guests. This explains a familiar setting rather than a proven origin: the supplied evidence does not establish the word's earliest source or borrowing history.

morphology.formula: berusaha + -lah → berusahalah；更深一层：ber- + usaha → berusaha
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接基词 berusaha；其最终词根为 usaha。-lah 是附着语气词，并非派生词缀，此处因字段限制记在 suffix 下。ber- 的元音为 /ə/，后接元音起首的 usaha 时保留 /r/；加 -lah 不改变基词拼写。输入未给音节划分，故 syllables 保留 null。输入爪夷文 براوسها 对应 berusaha，未含 -lah；完整形式可写作 براوسهاله。

word_family.gloss: 努力；为达成目标而付出的行动

senses.zh_definition: 努力吧；尽力设法实现某个目标。由 berusaha 加语气词 -lah 构成，用于劝勉、请求或指示。
senses.en_definition: Make an effort; strive to achieve something, with -lah adding exhortation, emphasis, or softening.
senses.ms_definition: Bekerja dengan giat untuk mencapai, melaksanakan atau menyempurnakan sesuatu; berikhtiar dengan sedaya upaya.
senses.nuances: 马来语释义依据 DBP 的 berusaha 条目展开缩写；-lah 的语气作用另作说明。它不创造新的词汇义，也不保证语气必然温和，实际效果取决于语调与关系。常见于鼓励和致辞；日常聊天中也可使用，但容易带出劝导口吻。berusahalah 后接目标时可用 untuk；Yang Berusaha 是另一个固定敬称结构。依据：[DBP PRPM：berusaha](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=berusaha)。

etymology.historical_story: Berusahalah layers Malay grammar onto usaha, an older word for effort. Lexical references trace usaha through Classical Malay and Pali ussāha to Sanskrit utsāha, associated with energy and perseverance. Malay adds ber- to form the verb and -lah to address a listener directly. The historical borrowing is therefore distinct from the word's transparent modern construction. Reference: [usaha etymology](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/usaha).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分三步记：usaha＝努力，berusaha＝去努力，berusahalah＝努力吧！最后的 lah 给行动加上劝勉语气。

etymology.historical_story: Bricheno illustrates how personal names can enter a word list without becoming ordinary vocabulary. The surname is documented, and Tim Bricheno is identified in an authority record as a British musician. Those facts establish a name, not a Malay meaning. The supplied packet provides no evidence for the surname's ultimate origin or the intended referent.

etymology.historical_story: Berarak belongs to arak II, the procession family, which Malay dictionaries distinguish from arak I, the alcoholic drink. Its recorded meanings move from people proceeding together to clouds moving in succession and memories appearing one after another. These senses share an image of successive movement; that relationship explains the imagery without establishing a historical order of development. [DBP: arak II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kenangan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arak 想成一列队伍：人列队、云排队、回忆也排着队涌现；ber- 让队伍动起来。

morphology.pattern_note: 同步构词中作为完整词根记忆，不拆成 ba- 与 hagi。加 meN- 或 peN- 时，b 前取 mem- 或 pem-，词根 b 保留：membahagi、pembahagian。

senses.zh_definition: 整体分开后形成的一份、一部分；份额。
senses.en_definition: A part, portion, or share of a whole.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian atau belahan daripada sesuatu keseluruhan.
senses.nuances: 输入《Kamus Dewan》材料中的基本名词义。现代一般表达多用 bahagian；旧式 dua bahagi、tiga bahagi 可分别表示三分之二、四分之三，属于古典用法，不能套用于现代除法读法。

senses.zh_definition: 把整体分开、切开或划分成若干部分。
senses.en_definition: To divide or split a whole into parts.
senses.ms_definition: Memisahkan sesuatu keseluruhan menjadi beberapa bahagian.
senses.nuances: 裸词根常见于指令和口语；正式主动陈述通常用 membahagi，必要时用 membahagikan。单独的 bahagi 不保证等分，须由 sama rata 等表达补充。

senses.zh_definition: 把物品、款项或任务分配给若干人或群体。
senses.en_definition: To distribute or allocate goods, money, or tasks among recipients.
senses.ms_definition: Mengagihkan barang, wang atau tugas kepada beberapa orang atau kumpulan.
senses.nuances: 强调各有所得，而非仅将物体切开。口语可直接说 bahagi；正式表达常用 membahagikan 或 mengagihkan。不要把此处的 bahagi 与口语中表示“给”的 bagi 完全等同。

senses.zh_definition: 作除法；求一个数除以另一个数的结果。
senses.en_definition: To divide one number by another.
senses.ms_definition: Melakukan operasi pembahagian terhadap sesuatu nombor dengan nombor lain.
senses.nuances: 数学表达中 lapan bahagi empat 表示 8 ÷ 4，结果为 2。主动陈述可用 membahagi，完整被动式可用 lapan dibahagi dengan empat。此义须与“把东西分成几份”及古典分数表达区分。

etymology.historical_story: Bahagi belongs to a long-established vocabulary of parts and shares. Linguist Tom Hoogervorst lists Malay bahagi and bagi alongside Sanskrit bhāga, meaning a part, in his study of South Asian lexical influence. The comparison connects an everyday word for dividing things with a wider regional vocabulary of portions, while its modern Malay derivatives remain transparently productive. [Hoogervorst](https://brill.com/downloadpdf/book/9789004529458/BP000002.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bahagi 连到 bahagian“部分”：先 bahagi 分开，才有一份份 bahagian；看到 ÷ 也读 bahagi。

etymology.historical_story: A rantai consists of connected links, providing a concrete image for sequences of events. DBP records berantai both for having a chain and for successive connections, including a chain reaction. The prefix ber- gives the noun a state or possession reading. The connection between physical links and linked events offers a useful semantic explanation, rather than proof of a dated historical development. [DBP rantai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=rantai)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rantai 是链条，berantai 就是“带着链、连成链”：项链连环，事件也能环环相接。

morphology.pattern_note: -kan 构成使动及物形式，词根不发生音变。bocorkan 可用于祈使句、第二类被动结构及省略 meN- 的口语；一般正式主动陈述用 membocorkan，meN- 在 b 前变为 mem-，保留 b。输入 Jawi 仅为词根 bocor，原样保留；输入未提供音节划分。

senses.zh_definition: 泄露、透露原本保密或尚未公开的消息、资料或内容。

senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan diketahui orang sesuatu yang dirahsiakan; memberitahukan atau membuka sesuatu rahsia kepada orang lain.
senses.nuances: 通常带宾语，如 rahsia、maklumat sulit；娱乐语境也可指提前透露剧情。bocor 表示“已经泄露”的状态，bocorkan 表示“把它透露出去”的动作。此释义对应 DBP 的 membocorkan，目标词为其无 meN- 形式。[DBP 词义与派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pembocoran)。

senses.zh_definition: 使物体出现漏孔或失去密封性，导致液体或气体能够进出；弄漏、弄破。
senses.en_definition: To make something leak by puncturing it or damaging its seal.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan bocor, tiris atau berlubang sehingga air atau angin dapat keluar atau masuk.

etymology.historical_story: Bocorkan makes an abstract action visible through the everyday image of a leak. The root bocor describes something that lets water or air escape; with -kan, someone causes that escape. Malay extends the same image to secrets: information slips beyond its intended boundary. Both the physical and informational meanings appear under membocorkan in DBP dictionaries. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pembocoran).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bocor 是“漏了”，加 -kan 变成“把它弄漏”；秘密也像水一样漏出去，就是“泄密”。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着于词后的强调语气粒子，不是派生后缀；此处按字段归为 suffix。词干不发生音变。输入的 Jawi بياسا 对应词根 biasa，未包含 -lah。

etymology.historical_story: Biasa comes from Sanskrit abhyāsa, meaning repetition or habit. Its history connects repeated practice with what eventually feels ordinary. Adding the Malay particle -lah produces biasalah, a familiar expression for treating something as expected. The reassuring or resigned interpretation comes from context and intonation, rather than from a separate historical root. [Historical linguistic account](https://brill.com/display/book/9789004529458/9789004529458_webready_content_text.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Baharu belongs to an inherited Austronesian word family for newness, rather than being a recent invention of language planners. Comparative research connects it with reconstructed ancestral forms. Modern Malay also has baru, and both can describe something new. Their overlap does not extend to every use: the temporal meaning just normally takes baru.

etymology.historical_story: Beyond comes from Old English begeondan, associated with being on the farther side. That spatial idea provides a useful bridge to its abstract meanings: a deadline, budget, or person's understanding can also be imagined as a boundary. This is English word history; it does not establish beyond as an officially adopted Malay word. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=beyond)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 beyond 想成“越过一条界线”：河的另一边、期限之后、能力之外。马来语对应词随界线类型变化。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records bual both in descriptions of bubbling water and in the vocabulary of conversation. Those meanings should not be treated as proof that one historically produced the other. Bualkan belongs to the conversational family: adding -kan makes the subject matter something to talk about, while sentence structure determines whether the active prefix meN- appears. [DBP: bual](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=berbual%2C+berbual-bual+1)

etymology.historical_story: Bahas comes from Arabic baḥth, associated with inquiry and discussion. Its Jawi spelling preserves the Arabic letters بحث, while ordinary Malay pronunciation adapts the word to /bahas/. Malay also attaches its own affixes, producing forms such as membahaskan. The word thus shows how a loan can retain its written ancestry while participating fully in Malay grammar. [UNIMAS study](https://www.ils.unimas.my/images/pdf/v6n2/v6n2_idris.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bahas 想成“把话说清、把理由摆出来”：核心是讨论与论证。bahasa 多一个 a，意思是“语言”，不要混记。

etymology.historical_story: Broadway began as a route used by Indigenous people long before Manhattan's modern street grid. Dutch colonial street names preceded the English name Broad Way, recorded around 1668. The transparent English elements mean a broad road. Later, theatrical activity made the street's name a cultural shorthand for New York's commercial stage. [Street history](https://s-media.nyc.gov/agencies/lpc/lp/1235.pdf), [theatre context](https://www.broadway.org/?l=1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语 broad 是“宽阔的”，way 是“道路”：想象一条通向耀眼剧院的宽阔大道，就能连起“百老汇大街”和“百老汇剧场”两义。

headword.editorial_note: 未能确认 berpura 是独立的标准词条；表达“假装”时，已核实的标准形式是 berpura-pura。此处音节、读音及爪夷文仅按输入形式规则推读、转写。输入的 ڤورا 是词根写法，其钱包义也不能直接作为本词释义。[DBP：berpura-pura](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=berpura-pura)

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 加在 p 前通常保留词根首辅音；但形式上可拆分，并不证明 berpura 已成为标准词。假装义的标准表达还包含重叠。

senses.zh_definition: 若原文意在使用 berpura-pura，则表示假装、装作，表现出与实际情况不同的状态。

senses.nuances: 本义项是对可能意图的条件性说明，不确认 berpura 为标准同义形式。以下搭配采用标准词 berpura-pura。输入中 pura 的钱包、旧时交易场所或资金义属于其他词义，不能据此解释“假装”。[DBP：pura](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132444&keyword=pura)

etymology.historical_story: The useful historical distinction here is between lookalike dictionary forms. Malay pura has entries associated with a purse and with a city, while pretending is expressed through pura-pura and berpura-pura. Shared spelling does not establish a shared origin. The supplied purse definition therefore cannot explain pretending, and no secure independent history for shortened berpura has been established. [DBP: pura](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132444&keyword=pura)

senses.zh_definition: 把事务处理完毕；解决争端或清偿债务。
senses.en_definition: To complete a task, resolve a matter, or settle a debt.
senses.ms_definition: Mengurus sesuatu hingga selesai, termasuk menyelesaikan perselisihan atau hutang.
senses.nuances: 强调达成完成或解决的结果。正式陈述可用 membereskan；mengurus、menyelesaikan 或 melangsaikan 可按宾语提供更明确的表达。

dual_scenarios.zh: 请在本月底前办妥所有付款事宜。
dual_scenarios.en: Please complete all payment arrangements before the end of this month.

口语主动陈述中可省略 meN-，正式书面语恢复 membereskan

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 单独命令 Bereskan! 语气较硬。对同事或不熟悉的人，可加 sila 或 tolong，并说明具体任务。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于整理和办事。bereskan dia 等以人为宾语的表达可能被理解为威胁，应明确说出要解决的问题。

etymology.historical_story: Beres expresses orderliness or completion in Malay. Adding -kan turns that resulting state into something a person brings about: putting things in order or getting a matter settled. Bereskan is especially useful in instructions, while membereskan supplies the ordinary active form. The available dictionary evidence does not establish the root's ultimate historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: beres 是妥当、办完；beres + -kan 就是把它办妥。记整词 beres，不要拆成 ber- + es。

morphology.formula: berjumpa + -nya → berjumpanya；进一步分析：ber- + jumpa → berjumpa
morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在这里按名词化成分分析，表示相见这件事；词干不变，ny 表示 /ɲ/。这不是把不及物动词 berjumpa 直接变成‘见他’。输入的 Jawi 实际对应 berjumpa，未包含 -nya；按构形补写为 برجومڤاڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 相见、会面这一事件；由 berjumpa 加名词化成分 -nya 构成，具体参与者由上下文说明。
senses.en_definition: The event or fact of meeting, expressed by a nominalized form of berjumpa.
senses.ms_definition: Hal atau peristiwa berjumpa, dengan -nya berfungsi sebagai kata pembenda.
senses.nuances: 这是依构词与语法作出的分析，不是输入所附 DBP 定义的逐字释义。DBP 所释的是 berjumpa；-nya 的名词化功能另有语法依据。该形式偏书面，日常通常改用 perjumpaan 或普通 berjumpa 句式。不能孤立地把 berjumpanya 译成‘见到他／她’；会见某人通常说 berjumpa dengannya。以下搭配为构式示例，并非已核实的高频固定搭配。依据：[DBP：berjumpa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=berjumpa)、[DBP：-nya 的名词化功能](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=laju+nya)。

collocations.zh: 两位领导人相见这一事件
collocations.en: the meeting of the two leaders
the reunion of two old friends

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Apakah maksud 'berjumpanya' dalam ayat ini?

句末 ya 使提问更柔和。
目标形式较书面，因此口语场景采用自然的词义讨论。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)

messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah membaca ayat ini, tetapi apakah maksud 'berjumpanya'?

messages.ms_standard: Dalam ayat itu, perkataan tersebut hanya merujuk kepada peristiwa mereka berjumpa.
messages.zh: 在那句话里，就是指他们见面这件事。
messages.en: In that sentence, it just means the event of them meeting.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 向老师、上司或长辈提出会面请求，可说 Saya ingin berjumpa dengan cikgu／tuan／puan。berjumpanya 本身不表示敬意。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合分析书面叙述中的事件名词化。安排见面或发送邀请时，通常用 berjumpa 或 perjumpaan，表达更自然清楚。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 向老师、上司或长辈提出会面请求，可说 Saya ingin berjumpa dengan cikgu／tuan／puan。berjumpanya 本身不表示敬意。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合分析书面叙述中的事件名词化。安排见面或发送邀请时，通常用 berjumpa 或 perjumpaan，表达更自然清楚。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay word building rather than a separate borrowing. Jumpa supplies the meeting concept, ber- forms the verb berjumpa, and -nya can turn an event into something discussed as a noun. The packet documents berjumpa, not the complete extended form. Its interpretation therefore depends on grammar and context rather than an independently supplied dictionary definition.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分三步记：jumpa＝见面，berjumpa＝进行会面，berjumpanya＝会面这件事。这里的 -nya 不要机械记成‘他／她’。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接在 hujah 前构成表示提出论据的动词；h 保留，不发生鼻音同化，ber- 中的 e 读 /ə/。

word_family.gloss: 论据；有理由支持的观点

senses.zh_definition: 提出理由或证据，以支持或反对某种观点；进行论证或说理辩论。
senses.en_definition: To present reasons or evidence in support of or against a position.
senses.ms_definition: Mengemukakan atau memajukan hujah.
senses.nuances: 重点是提出理由，不必带有愤怒或争吵意味。通常用 berhujah bahawa 引出所论证的命题，用 berhujah tentang 引出议题，用 berhujah dengan 引出交谈对象或论证方式。[释义依据：DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=hujah)。

collocations.en: to argue on the basis of facts

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Wakil persatuan itu berhujah bahawa cadangan tersebut perlu dinilai berdasarkan bukti, bukan andaian semata-mata.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该协会代表提出，必须根据证据评估这项建议，不能仅凭假设。
dual_scenarios.en: The association's representative argued that the proposal should be assessed on evidence rather than assumptions alone.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kalau nak berhujah, bagi alasan yang jelas dulu, ya.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Jika mahu berhujah, berikan alasan yang jelas terlebih dahulu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 要讲道理的话，先把理由说清楚啊。
dual_scenarios.en: If you want to make your case, give clear reasons first.
spoken_features: kalau 是日常交流中常用的条件连接词，对应此处较正式的 jika。
nak 对应 mahu。
bagi 对应 berikan。
句末 ya 可使提醒语气较温和。

messages.speaker: Farah (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak berhujah yang waktu perpustakaan patut dipanjangkan. Alasan apa lagi boleh guna?
messages.ms_standard: Saya mahu berhujah bahawa waktu operasi perpustakaan patut dipanjangkan. Apakah alasan lain yang boleh saya gunakan?
messages.zh: 我想论证图书馆应该延长开放时间。还能用什么理由？
messages.en: I want to make the case for longer library hours. What other reasons could I use?

messages.ms_standard: Gunakan data tentang pelajar yang belajar di situ pada waktu malam. Jangan sekadar memberikan pendapat.
messages.zh: 用晚上在那里学习的学生数据啊，别光说自己的看法。
messages.en: Use data on students who study there at night. Don't just give your opinion.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 与长辈、上司或主持人意见不同时，可用 Dengan izin, saya ingin berhujah bahawa…（如蒙允许，我想提出……）开场；针对观点提出理由，并留出对方回应的空间。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合辩论、会议、课堂及有依据的讨论。不要把 berhujah 自动理解成吵架；但直接说 Jangan berhujah! 可能带有压制对方发言的强硬语气。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 与长辈、上司或主持人意见不同时，可用 Dengan izin, saya ingin berhujah bahawa…（如蒙允许，我想提出……）开场；针对观点提出理由，并留出对方回应的空间。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合辩论、会议、课堂及有依据的讨论。不要把 berhujah 自动理解成吵架；但直接说 Jangan berhujah! 可能带有压制对方发言的强硬语气。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies hujah as an Arabic borrowing. Malay adds its own prefix ber- to turn the noun for a supported position into the activity of presenting reasons. The word illustrates how borrowed vocabulary becomes productive within Malay grammar. In debates, a person can berhujah firmly while still observing courtesy, because reasoned disagreement does not inherently mean quarrelling. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=hujah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hujah 是论据，ber- 表示开展活动：berhujah，就是把论据讲出来。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 实为附着代词，本结构中不改变 bimbit 的词干；ny 表示 /ɲ/。在 telefon bimbitnya 中，领属关系作用于整个 telefon bimbit；在文学性动词结构中，-nya 可表示第三人称施事。所给 Jawi 为词基拼写，未包含 -nya。

senses.zh_definition: 用于复合词，表示可随身携带的；整个名词词组加 -nya 后表示他、她或它所属的便携物品。
senses.en_definition: Portable or hand-carried, within a compound whose final -nya marks the whole item as his, hers, or its.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam kata gabungan, menerangkan benda yang mudah dibawa; -nya pada hujung gabungan menyatakan hubungan kepunyaan dengan orang atau benda yang dirujuk.
senses.nuances: 常见于 telefon bimbitnya（他／她的手机）、beg bimbitnya（他／她的公文包）和 komputer bimbitnya（他／她的笔记本电脑）。此处为复合词内部的修饰用法，不宜把 bimbitnya 单独当作“他的手机”的完整标准表达。-nya 本身不区分性别。手机词义参见 [DBP：telefon bimbit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=telefon+bimbit)。

senses.zh_definition: 在书面叙事中，表示某物由他或她用手提着、拎着。
senses.en_definition: Carried by him or her in one hand, in a literary construction with a preceding object or patient.
senses.ms_definition: Dibawa atau dijinjing dengan tangan oleh orang yang dirujuk oleh -nya, dalam susunan ayat bersifat sastera.
senses.nuances: 例如 Beg kecil itu bimbitnya 可理解为“那个小包由他／她提着”。这种无 meN- 的形式带有文学色彩；日常中更自然的是 Dia membimbit beg kecil itu。词基的旧有“牵着、引领”义见所给词典材料，但不是现代 bimbitnya 的默认理解。

collocations.en: carry a bag in one hand
carry a basket in one hand

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pegawai itu menyerahkan telefon bimbitnya kepada pihak penganjur sebelum mesyuarat bermula.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Telefon bimbitnya tertinggal kat meja tadi lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Telefon bimbitnya tertinggal di atas meja tadi.

lah 在此强调提醒，语气取决于语调。
熟人对话也常用 telefon dia；telefon bimbitnya 较完整，略带书面感。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Amir dah keluar ke? Telefon bimbitnya tertinggal kat meja ni.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Amir sudah keluar? Telefon bimbitnya tertinggal di atas meja ini.

messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah keluar. Simpankan dahulu; dia akan datang mengambilnya nanti.

messages.en: Yes, he has. Just keep it safe for now; he'll come back for it.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式场合使用完整词组 telefon bimbitnya；若指向不清，可改用 telefon bimbit beliau 或人名，以兼顾尊重和清晰。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 讨论他人的手机或公文包时，-nya 只说明领属或关联，并不表示获准查看其中内容。文学性动词用法适合叙事，普通工作沟通宜用 membimbit 或 membawa。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 正式场合使用完整词组 telefon bimbitnya；若指向不清，可改用 telefon bimbit beliau 或人名，以兼顾尊重和清晰。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 讨论他人的手机或公文包时，-nya 只说明领属或关联，并不表示获准查看其中内容。文学性动词用法适合叙事，普通工作沟通宜用 membimbit 或 membawa。

etymology.historical_story: The semantic story of bimbit connects carrying something by hand with familiar portable objects. The supplied dictionary records membimbit for carrying a basket, while modern compounds include briefcases and mobile phones. In telefon bimbitnya, an ordinary carrying word belongs to a technology term, and -nya identifies whose phone it is. This explains the meaning without assuming an undocumented ancient origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bimbit 与“手提”绑定：beg bimbit 是手提公文包，telefon bimbit 是随身手机；最后的 -nya 再贴上“他／她的”标签。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接 sopan 时保留完整形式，词根不发生音位替换；构成表示表现出某种举止的不及物动词。

word_family.gloss: 使举止有礼；使合乎礼仪

senses.zh_definition: 言行有礼，待人文明得体；表现出良好的礼貌和教养。
senses.en_definition: To behave courteously and with good manners.
senses.ms_definition: Berbudi bahasa, beradab.
senses.nuances: 强调行为中表现出的礼貌，可用于提醒、要求或描述待人方式。sopan 侧重性质，bersopan 侧重表现或行事。常与 kepada、terhadap 或 ketika 连用，不直接把人当作宾语。词义参见 [DBP：bersopan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bersopan)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Semua petugas hendaklah bersopan ketika berurusan dengan orang awam.
dual_scenarios.zh: 所有工作人员在接待公众时都应保持礼貌。
dual_scenarios.en: All staff must behave courteously when dealing with members of the public.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Nanti jumpa mak dia, bersopan sikit ya.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Apabila berjumpa dengan ibunya nanti, pastikan kamu bersopan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 待会儿见他妈妈，记得有礼貌一点啊。
dual_scenarios.en: Mind your manners when you meet his mum later, okay?
spoken_features: mak 是 ibu 的常见口语称呼。
mak dia 对应较完整的 ibunya。
省略主语和 apabila，使提醒更简短。
sikit 与 ya 在此缓和提醒，但 bersopan sikit 也可能暗示对方先前不够礼貌。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau nak jumpa mak Amir nanti kan? Bersopan sikit ya.
messages.ms_standard: Kamu hendak berjumpa dengan ibu Amir nanti, bukan? Pastikan kamu bersopan.
messages.zh: 你待会儿要见 Amir 的妈妈，对吧？记得有礼貌一点啊。
messages.en: You're meeting Amir's mum later, right? Mind your manners, okay?

messages.speaker: Nadia (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Yalah, aku tahu. Aku nak ucap terima kasih je.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, aku tahu. Aku hanya hendak mengucapkan terima kasih.
messages.zh: 知道啦，我只是想跟她道个谢。
messages.en: Yes, I know. I just want to thank her.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 提醒晚辈或熟人时可说 bersopan；对客户、长辈或上级直接说 Bersopan sikit 容易像训话。需要提出意见时，宜针对具体表达或行为委婉说明。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于接待、服务、学校和家庭中的言行礼仪。礼貌要求应结合具体场合理解；平静表达不同意见，也可以是 bersopan 的表现。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 提醒晚辈或熟人时可说 bersopan；对客户、长辈或上级直接说 Bersopan sikit 容易像训话。需要提出意见时，宜针对具体表达或行为委婉说明。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于接待、服务、学校和家庭中的言行礼仪。礼貌要求应结合具体场合理解；平静表达不同意见，也可以是 bersopan 的表现。

etymology.historical_story: Bersopan makes courteous conduct explicit through the productive Malay prefix ber-. Its base, sopan, describes good manners, while bersopan presents those manners as behaviour. The dictionary places it alongside berbudi bahasa and beradab, connecting respectful speech with considerate conduct. This provides a cultural account of its meaning without claiming a particular borrowing route or date for the base word.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sopan 是“有礼貌”，ber- 把它带入行为：ber- + sopan，就是“以有礼的方式行事”。记住 bersopan kepada tetamu：礼貌待客。

morphology.pattern_note: 此处分析的是印尼语口语形式，词根辅音保留，接-an后可分为ba.ka.lan。资料包的باکل对应bakal，不能据此认定为bakalan的完整爪夷文拼写；本字段依要求保留原值。

word_family.gloss: 初步拟订；制作粗略形状
初步拟订或制作的过程

senses.zh_definition: 〔印尼语口语〕将会；将要成为或被选作某种身份。
senses.en_definition: In colloquial Indonesian, will or be going to; be going to become or be selected as something.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Indonesia percakapan, menandakan sesuatu yang akan berlaku, atau seseorang yang akan menjadi atau dijadikan sesuatu; padanan bahasa Melayu Malaysia ialah akan atau bakal.
senses.nuances: 资料包引用的是bakal的释义，不能直接视为bakalan的DBP释义。本义按句中的将来情态功能标为adverb；所引KBBI转载把bakalan标作口语动词，释为“将被选作”。马来西亚正式写作宜用akan或bakal。下列搭配属于印尼语口语。[KBBI释义转载](https://typoonline.com/kbbi/Bakal)

senses.zh_definition: 〔印尼语畜牧用语〕供进一步饲养或育肥的牲畜。
senses.en_definition: In Indonesian livestock terminology, an animal intended for further rearing or fattening.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan penternakan Indonesia, ternakan yang dipilih untuk dibesarkan atau digemukkan.
senses.nuances: 这是印尼语专业用法，不是资料包中bakal“将要”的直接释义。马来西亚读者可理解为ternakan untuk penggemukan；不能把此义推广到所有bakalan用例。[印尼教育部门畜牧教材](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/10382/1/Dasar%20Pembibitan%20Ternak%202.pdf)

collocations.zh: 育肥用牲畜的挑选〔印尼语〕

senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Jawa, orang yang menjadi tunang seseorang.

etymology.historical_story: Bakalan illustrates how related regional languages develop different uses around bakal, associated with what is prospective or not yet finished. Indonesian conversation uses bakalan for future events, while livestock terminology applies it to animals awaiting further rearing. An official Javanese dictionary also records the meaning betrothed person. These neighboring uses should remain clearly distinguished in a Malaysian Malay learning entry. [Javanese dictionary](https://kbji.kemendikdasmen.go.id/kata/bakal)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记bakal“将要”，再认出bakalan这个印尼口语形式：bakalan datang＝akan datang。别把它当成马来西亚公文用词。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接 keliling 时不发生词根首音脱落，两个 e 均读央元音 /ə/；词尾 ng 表示单个鼻音 /ŋ/。本词表示主体自行绕行或四处走动。

senses.zh_definition: 绕着某个物体或地点移动；沿其周边行进。
senses.en_definition: To move around an object or place, following a surrounding or circular course.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak melingkari atau di sekitar sesuatu tempat, benda dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 强调围绕参照物移动，不必表示原地自转，也不必每次都完成整圈。作为一般不及物活动动词使用；mengelilingi 则可直接突出所环绕的对象。义项依据：[DBP：keliling](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=keliling)。

senses.zh_definition: 在某一地区四处走动、巡行或到各处寻找，不限定为圆形路线。
senses.en_definition: To move from place to place within an area, as when exploring, searching, or making rounds.
senses.ms_definition: Berjalan berpusing-pusing ke merata arah dan tempat; berjalan dan sebagainya merata tempat.
senses.nuances: 可指有目的地寻人、巡查或游逛，不必含“迷路”或“漫无目的”的意思。日常马来西亚口语常省去 ber-，说 keliling。义项依据：[DBP：keliling](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=keliling)。

etymology.historical_story: Berkeliling is transparently formed from keliling, a noun referring to surrounding space or a perimeter. Dictionary examples place the verb in courtly processions as well as ordinary searching journeys. These settings illuminate its two established senses: following a course around something and moving through an area from place to place. [DBP: keliling](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=keliling)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: keliling 是“四周”，加上表示活动的 ber-：让脚步沿四周动起来，就是“绕行、四处走”。

morphology.pattern_note: 在古语固定表达 darah bali 中整体识记，无词缀变化。berdarah bali 的 ber- 加在 darah 上，不是 bali 的派生词，因此不列作其构词词族。

senses.zh_definition: 胆怯的；懦弱的：主要用于古老的米南加保来源表达 darah bali，形容人胆小。
senses.en_definition: Cowardly or timid, preserved in the archaic Minangkabau expression darah bali.
senses.ms_definition: Penakut, khususnya dalam ungkapan lama darah bali.
senses.nuances: Kamus Dewan 标注 Mn（米南加保）及 ark（古语）。词义依附于固定表达，不宜把 bali 当作现代常用形容词自由造句。它与大写地名 Bali（巴厘岛）须分开处理。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=36924&keyword=bali)

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan preserves bali with Minangkabau and archaic labels, specifically through darah bali, meaning cowardly. Malay idioms often use darah, literally blood, to describe temperament rather than bodily substance. This surviving expression records regional linguistic heritage, but the dictionary label alone does not establish an older root meaning or any historical connection with the island of Bali. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=36924&keyword=bali)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 darah bali 整块记作“胆小”；借 darah 的“血性”意象联想缺少胆气，不把 bali 单独拆解。

etymology.historical_story: Belicoff is documented as a character name in the official publicity material for the 2007 film Hitman. The cast list includes Belicoff and Udre Belicoff, establishing a fictional naming context rather than a Malay lexical meaning. This evidence does not establish the surname's deeper linguistic origin or any borrowing into Malay. Its presence in the supplied vocabulary list remains unexplained. Source: [Official Hitman press kit](https://medias.unifrance.org/medias/206/123/31694/presse/hitman-presskit-french.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Biadab combines Persian bi-, meaning 'without', with adab, a word of Arabic origin associated with manners and cultivated conduct. DBP explicitly records this analysis. The construction makes discourtesy a lack of adab, connecting everyday criticism with a wider vocabulary of proper behavior. Malay also uses the whole word as the base for kebiadaban. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=biadab)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 bi-＝“无”、adab＝“礼仪”：biadab 就是“无礼”。这是词源记忆法，不是可以随意套用的新词规则。

morphology.pattern_note: ber- 表示具有某种记录或处于某种状态；接 daftar 时词根不变，也不发生鼻音同化。

word_family.gloss: 为某人或某物办理登记

senses.zh_definition: 备有名册；已登记在名册或有关记录中，具有已注册的状态。
senses.en_definition: To have a register or be recorded in a register; to be registered.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai daftar atau termasuk dan tercatat dalam daftar.
senses.nuances: 常作状态谓语或名词后的修饰语，如 syarikat berdaftar。强调登记状态；要表达主动办理注册，通常用 mendaftar。已注册不必然等于已获执照、认证或政府担保。马来文释义据输入的《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》释义展开缩写。

senses.zh_definition: 指邮件已按挂号程序登记，以接受相应的特别投递处理。

senses.ms_definition: Tentang surat: telah dicatatkan dalam daftar untuk layanan istimewa dalam urusan pengirimannya.
senses.nuances: 这是 berdaftar 在邮政搭配中的专门用法。surat berdaftar 指挂号信；词义本身不保证具体送达时限。马来文释义据输入词典的 surat berdaftar 说明改写。

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here is morphological rather than a claimed ancient origin. Daftar names a register or list, while ber- presents something as having that record or belonging in it. The dictionary also preserves surat berdaftar, linking the same idea of recorded inclusion to the special handling of registered letters.

etymology.historical_story: Berdansa combines the Malay activity prefix ber- with dansa. Portuguese dança is documented as a source of dansa in research on European loans in regional Malay. The borrowing preserves a cultural distinction: dansa evokes Western dancing, while tari covers a broader field. A foreign cultural noun thus fits a productive Malay grammatical pattern. [Research source](https://openresearch-repository.anu.edu.au/server/api/core/bitstreams/f663304d-f64e-4093-a2d3-7baa3e258033/content)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dansa 联想到英语 dance，再加表示活动的 ber-：berdansa，就是去跳西式舞。
